/* * Calls the functions of <zephyr/drivers/display.h> that the sunxi display driver implements, and the * three functions of <zephyr/drivers/display/display_sunxi.h> for the scaling video plane. The panel * is the one named by zephyr,display in the board file: the MIPI DSI panel of the carrier board. */ #include <errno.h> #include <string.h> #include <zephyr/cache.h> #include <zephyr/device.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/display.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/display/display_sunxi.h> #include <zephyr/kernel.h> #include <zephyr/sys/printk.h> static const struct device *const disp = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_CHOSEN(zephyr_display)); static struct display_capabilities caps; static const char *err(int ret) { switch (ret) { case 0: return "0"; case -EINVAL: return "-EINVAL"; case -ENOTSUP: return "-ENOTSUP"; case -ENOSYS: return "-ENOSYS"; default: return "?"; } } /* RGB565 of an 8 bit colour */ #define RGB565(r, g, b) ((uint16_t)((((r) >> 3) << 11) | (((g) >> 2) << 5) | ((b) >> 3))) /* display_get_capabilities: the size of the frame buffer and its pixel format */ static void demo_get_capabilities(void) { display_get_capabilities(disp, &caps); printk("[caps] %ux%u, supported pixel formats 0x%x, current 0x%x (RGB_565 is 0x%x), orientation %d
", caps.x_resolution, caps.y_resolution, caps.supported_pixel_formats, caps.current_pixel_format, PIXEL_FORMAT_RGB_565, caps.current_orientation); } /* display_write: copy a rectangle of pixels into the frame buffer. Eight vertical colour bars over the * whole screen, one band of rows at a time. */ static uint16_t band[1024 * 16]; static void demo_write(void) { static const uint16_t bars[8] = { RGB565(255, 255, 255), RGB565(255, 255, 0), RGB565(0, 255, 255), RGB565(0, 255, 0), RGB565(255, 0, 255), RGB565(255, 0, 0), RGB565(0, 0, 255), RGB565(0, 0, 0), }; uint16_t w = caps.x_resolution, rows = 16; struct display_buffer_descriptor desc = { .buf_size = w * rows * 2, .width = w, .height = rows, .pitch = w, }; int ret = 0; for (int y = 0; y < rows; y++) { for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) { band[y * w + x] = bars[x * 8 / w]; } } for (uint16_t y = 0; y < caps.y_resolution && ret == 0; y += rows) { ret = display_write(disp, 0, y, &desc, band); } printk("[write] colour bars over the whole %ux%u frame buffer = %s
", w, caps.y_resolution, err(ret)); } /* display_write with a window: a 200x100 white block at (412, 334), with a pitch wider than the block */ static void demo_write_window(void) { static uint16_t block[256 * 100]; struct display_buffer_descriptor desc = { .buf_size = sizeof(block), .width = 200, .height = 100, .pitch = 256, }; int ret; for (int i = 0; i < 256 * 100; i++) { block[i] = 0xffff; } ret = display_write(disp, 412, 334, &desc, block); printk("[write] 200x100 block at (412,334), pitch 256 = %s
", err(ret)); desc.width = 300; ret = display_write(disp, 412, 334, &desc, block); printk("[write] a width larger than the pitch = %s
", err(ret)); desc.width = 200; ret = display_write(disp, caps.x_resolution - 100, 0, &desc, block); printk("[write] a block that sticks out on the right = %s
", err(ret)); ret = display_write(disp, 0, caps.y_resolution - 50, &desc, block); printk("[write] a block that sticks out at the bottom = %s
", err(ret)); } /* display_blanking_on and display_blanking_off: switch the picture off and on again */ static void demo_blanking_on(void) { int ret = display_blanking_on(disp); printk("[blank] display_blanking_on = %s
", err(ret)); k_msleep(1000); } static void demo_blanking_off(void) { int ret = display_blanking_off(disp); printk("[blank] display_blanking_off = %s
", err(ret)); k_msleep(1000); } /* display_set_brightness: the backlight, 0..255 */ static void demo_set_brightness(void) { static const uint8_t levels[] = { 255, 128, 32, 0, 96 }; for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(levels); i++) { int ret = display_set_brightness(disp, levels[i]); printk("[brightness] display_set_brightness(%3u) = %s
", levels[i], err(ret)); k_msleep(700); } } /* display_read: the frame buffer of this driver is write only */ static void demo_read(void) { uint8_t pixel[4]; struct display_buffer_descriptor desc = { .buf_size = 4, .width = 1, .height = 1, .pitch = 1 }; int ret = display_read(disp, 0, 0, &desc, pixel); printk("[unsupported] display_read = %s
", err(ret)); } /* display_set_pixel_format: the format is chosen at build time (CONFIG_DISPLAY_SUNXI_RGB565 or ARGB8888) */ static void demo_set_pixel_format(void) { int ret = display_set_pixel_format(disp, PIXEL_FORMAT_ARGB_8888); printk("[unsupported] display_set_pixel_format = %s
", err(ret)); } /* display_set_orientation: not implemented, rotate in software (or with the G2D) */ static void demo_set_orientation(void) { int ret = display_set_orientation(disp, DISPLAY_ORIENTATION_ROTATED_90); printk("[unsupported] display_set_orientation = %s
", err(ret)); } /* display_get_framebuffer: the driver does not hand out its frame buffer, it returns NULL */ static void demo_get_framebuffer(void) { printk("[unsupported] display_get_framebuffer = %p
", display_get_framebuffer(disp)); } /* display_sunxi_show_rgb: put a picture on the video plane under the frame buffer, scaled to fit the * screen. A 64x48 RGB565 picture of four coloured quarters, drawn on the screen four times as big as * the width of the panel allows. */ static uint16_t small[64 * 48] __aligned(64); static void demo_show_rgb(void) { struct display_sunxi_rgb img = { .data = small, .width = 64, .height = 48, .stride = 64 * 2, .xrgb8888 = false, .nonblock = false, }; int ret; for (int y = 0; y < 48; y++) { for (int x = 0; x < 64; x++) { small[y * 64 + x] = y < 24 ? (x < 32 ? RGB565(255, 0, 0) : RGB565(0, 255, 0)) : (x < 32 ? RGB565(0, 0, 255) : RGB565(255, 255, 0)); } } sys_cache_data_flush_range(small, sizeof(small)); ret = display_sunxi_show_rgb(disp, &img); printk("[rgb] display_sunxi_show_rgb 64x48 = %s
", err(ret)); k_msleep(2000); } /* display_sunxi_show_yuv: the same for a YCbCr 4:2:0 picture (NV12: a luma plane and an interleaved * chroma plane). A grey ramp from black to white, 128x96. */ static uint8_t luma[128 * 96] __aligned(64); static uint8_t chroma[128 * 48] __aligned(64); static void demo_show_yuv(void) { struct display_sunxi_yuv img = { .y = luma, .uv = chroma, .nv21 = false, .width = 128, .height = 96, .stride_y = 128, .stride_uv = 128, .full_range = false, .bt709 = false, .nonblock = false, }; int ret; for (int y = 0; y < 96; y++) { for (int x = 0; x < 128; x++) { luma[y * 128 + x] = 16 + x * 219 / 127; } } memset(chroma, 128, sizeof(chroma)); /* no colour */ sys_cache_data_flush_range(luma, sizeof(luma)); sys_cache_data_flush_range(chroma, sizeof(chroma)); ret = display_sunxi_show_yuv(disp, &img); printk("[yuv] display_sunxi_show_yuv 128x96 = %s
", err(ret)); k_msleep(2000); } /* display_sunxi_hide_yuv: stop the video plane and bring the frame buffer back */ static void demo_hide_yuv(void) { int ret = display_sunxi_hide_yuv(disp); printk("[hide] display_sunxi_hide_yuv = %s
", err(ret)); k_msleep(1000); } int main(void) { if (!device_is_ready(disp)) { printk("display not ready
"); return 0; } demo_get_capabilities(); demo_write(); k_msleep(1500); demo_write_window(); k_msleep(1500); demo_blanking_on(); demo_blanking_off(); demo_set_brightness(); demo_read(); demo_set_pixel_format(); demo_set_orientation(); demo_get_framebuffer(); demo_show_rgb(); demo_show_yuv(); demo_hide_yuv(); printk("display_api done
"); return 0; }

G2D 是 F101 的 2D 图形加速器：不经过 CPU，在内存缓冲区之间做矩形填充、搬运（可同时转换像素格式、缩放、旋转、翻转）和 Alpha 混合。Zephyr 里把它做成 g2d 设备，接口是 <zephyr/drivers/g2d.h>，驱动在 drivers/g2d/。 操作先进队列，由驱动的线程一个个交给硬件，按提交的顺序完成。 项目 内容 操作 填充（G2D_OP_FILL）、搬运（G2D_OP_BLIT）、混合（G2D_OP_BLEND） 像素格式（可写） ARGB8888、ABGR8888、RGBA8888、BGRA8888、XRGB8888、XBGR8888、RGB888、BGR888、RGB565、BGR565、ARGB4444、ARGB1555 像素格式（只读） 上面所有，加 NV12、NV21、I420、YUYV 最大尺寸 8192×8192 队列深度 设备树 queue-depth，默认 8 缓存 驱动在操作前清并失效（clean and invalidate）目的区域，清（clean）源区域和混合的背景区域；操作后使目的区域失效（invalidate）。带 G2D_FLAG_NO_CACHE_OPS 则都不做 限制 目的格式不能是 YUV；旋转要求源和目的同格式、同尺寸（转后）、地址 4 字节对齐、目的行距 8 字节对齐；混合的背景必须是 RGB 且和目的区域一样大
文件 作用 dts/bindings/g2d/allwinner,sunxi-g2d.yaml 绑定 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 设备树：g2d 节点，默认 disabled boards/yuzukihd/yuzukineko/yuzukineko.dts 板级设备树：把 g2d 改成 okay

g2d: g2d@5410000 { /* 匹配驱动 g2d_sunxi.c 里的 DT_DRV_COMPAT allwinner_sunxi_g2d */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-g2d"; /* 寄存器窗口：基址 0x05410000，长度 0x40000 */ reg = <0x05410000 0x40000>; /* 中断：PLIC 的 111 号，优先级 1 */ interrupts = <111 1>; interrupt-parent = <&plic>; /* 三个时钟门：模块时钟、总线时钟、MBUS 时钟，顺序和 clock-names 对应 */ clocks = <&cctl CLK_G2D>, <&cctl CLK_BUS_G2D>, <&cctl CLK_BUS_G2D_M>; clock-names = "mod", "bus", "mbus"; resets = <&rctl RST_BUS_G2D>; /* 驱动自己设模块时钟：CCU 的基址，和模块时钟寄存器的偏移。 * 时钟源选 PLL_PERI_2X，分频按 clock-frequency 算 */ ccu-base = <0x02001000>; mod-clk-reg = <0x630>; clock-frequency = <300000000>; status = "disabled"; };
/* 2D 图形加速器 */ &g2d { status = "okay"; };

属性 必填 含义 reg、interrupts 是 寄存器窗口、中断 clocks、clock-names 是 三个时钟门：mod、bus、mbus，按这个顺序 resets 是 总线复位 ccu-base 是 CCU 的基址 mod-clk-reg 是 G2D 模块时钟寄存器在 CCU 里的偏移（选择 26:24、分频 4:0、门控 31）；驱动把时钟源设成 PLL_PERI_2X，分频按 clock-frequency 算 clock-frequency 否，300000000 模块时钟，单位 Hz queue-depth 否，8 队列里可以排几个操作

选项 默认 含义 CONFIG_G2D 板级 defconfig 里是 y 打开 G2D 接口和驱动 CONFIG_G2D_INIT_PRIORITY 41 驱动的初始化优先级（POST_KERNEL） CONFIG_G2D_SHELL y（依赖 SHELL，且不是 minimal libc） shell 命令 `g2d info CONFIG_G2D_SUNXI y（依赖 DT_HAS_ALLWINNER_SUNXI_G2D_ENABLED） 编译这个驱动，并选中 CACHE_MANAGEMENT。驱动的许可证是 GPL-2.0-or-later CONFIG_G2D_SUNXI_THREAD_STACK_SIZE 2048 驱动工作线程的栈大小 CONFIG_G2D_SUNXI_THREAD_PRIORITY 5 驱动工作线程的优先级 CONFIG_G2D_SUNXI_TIMEOUT_MS 100 一个操作最多允许运行多久（毫秒），超时返回 -ETIMEDOUT

演示在 yuzukineko 上运行。每个结果都和 CPU 对同样像素的计算结果比较，对了打印 ok。公共的写法如下： static const struct device *const g2d = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(g2d)); 缓冲区由调用者提供。G2D 读写的是物理内存，所以缓冲区要对齐到缓存行（64 字节），CPU 写完要把缓存写回去（sys_cache_data_flush_range），G2D 才读得到。演示用下面这些辅助函数： /* A buffer for a surface: 64 byte aligned, which is the cache line size of the C907. */ static struct g2d_surface surface(enum g2d_format fmt, uint16_t w, uint16_t h) { struct g2d_surface s = { .format = fmt, .width = w, .height = h }; size_t size = (size_t)w * h * g2d_format_bytes_per_pixel(fmt); s.plane[0] = aligned_alloc(64, ROUND_UP(size, 64)); __ASSERT_NO_MSG(s.plane[0] != NULL); memset(s.plane[0], 0, size); sys_cache_data_flush_range(s.plane[0], size); return s; } static void release(struct g2d_surface *s) { free(s->plane[0]); } static uint32_t *px32(const struct g2d_surface *s, int x, int y) { return (uint32_t *)((uint8_t *)s->plane[0] + ((size_t)y * s->width + x) * 4); } static uint16_t *px16(const struct g2d_surface *s, int x, int y) { return (uint16_t *)((uint8_t *)s->plane[0] + ((size_t)y * s->width + x) * 2); } /* the CPU wrote the pixels: push them out of the cache before the G2D reads them */ static void flush(const struct g2d_surface *s) { sys_cache_data_flush_range(s->plane[0], (size_t)s->width * s->height * g2d_format_bytes_per_pixel(s->format)); } /* |a - b| of every colour channel is at most `tol` */ static bool near(uint32_t a, uint32_t b, int tol) { for (int shift = 0; shift < 32; shift += 8) { int d = (int)((a >> shift) & 0xff) - (int)((b >> shift) & 0xff); if (d > tol || d < -tol) { return false; } } return true; }

struct g2d_surface { enum g2d_format format; uint16_t width, height; /* 缓冲区的像素尺寸 */ void *plane[3]; /* 各平面的基址；NV12/NV21 用 2 个，I420 用 3 个 */ uint32_t pitch[3]; /* 各平面的行距（字节）；0 表示紧密排列 */ }; struct g2d_rect { uint16_t x, y, width, height; /* 像素 */ }; g2d_surface 描述整块缓冲区，g2d_rect 是缓冲区里要操作的区域。YUV 的区域不能切开色度采样：x 和宽度要是偶数，4:2:0 的 y 和高度也要是偶数。

int g2d_get_capabilities(const struct device *dev, struct g2d_capabilities *caps); 读设备的能力：能读、能写的像素格式（每一位对应 enum g2d_format 的一个值）、支持的操作、最大尺寸、旋转的对齐要求和队列深度。 /* g2d_get_capabilities: which formats and operations the device has */ static void demo_capabilities(void) { struct g2d_capabilities caps; int ret = g2d_get_capabilities(g2d, &caps); printk("[caps] g2d_get_capabilities = %s
", err(ret)); printk("[caps] source formats 0x%x, destination formats 0x%x (bit n = enum g2d_format n)
", caps.src_formats, caps.dst_formats); printk("[caps] operations 0x%x (fill, blit, blend), up to %ux%u pixels
", caps.ops, caps.max_width, caps.max_height); printk("[caps] rotation needs %u byte aligned addresses and %u byte aligned pitch, queue depth %u
", caps.rotate_addr_align, caps.rotate_pitch_align, caps.queue_depth); } [caps] g2d_get_capabilities = 0 [caps] source formats 0xffff, destination formats 0xfff (bit n = enum g2d_format n) [caps] operations 0x7 (fill, blit, blend), up to 8192x8192 pixels [caps] rotation needs 4 byte aligned addresses and 8 byte aligned pitch, queue depth 8
static inline unsigned int g2d_format_bytes_per_pixel(enum g2d_format format); 返回格式的第一个平面每个像素占几个字节；平面格式（NV12 等）返回 0。上面的 surface() 用它算缓冲区大小。

int g2d_fill(const struct device *dev, const struct g2d_surface *dst, const struct g2d_rect *dst_rect, uint32_t color); 用一种颜色填充目的缓冲区的一个矩形，等操作完成才返回。颜色永远是 ARGB8888，目的是别的格式时由驱动转换。 /* g2d_fill: a rectangle of one colour. The colour is always ARGB8888; the driver converts it. */ static void demo_fill(void) { struct g2d_surface d = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 128, 96); struct g2d_rect r = { 16, 8, 64, 48 }; int ret; ret = g2d_fill(g2d, &d, &r, 0xff3366cc); printk("[fill] ARGB8888 64x48 at (16,8) = %s: inside %08x, outside %08x, %s\n", err(ret), *px32(&d, 20, 10), *px32(&d, 2, 2), verdict(*px32(&d, 16, 8) == 0xff3366cc && *px32(&d, 79, 55) == 0xff3366cc && *px32(&d, 80, 56) == 0 && *px32(&d, 15, 7) == 0)); release(&d); d = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_RGB565, 128, 96); ret = g2d_fill(g2d, &d, &r, 0xff3366cc); printk("[fill] RGB565 64x48 at (16,8) = %s: inside %04x (0xff3366cc is %04x), %s\n", err(ret), *px16(&d, 20, 10), ((0x33 >> 3) << 11) | ((0x66 >> 2) << 5) | (0xcc >> 3), verdict(*px16(&d, 20, 10) == (uint16_t)(((0x33 >> 3) << 11) | ((0x66 >> 2) << 5) | (0xcc >> 3)))); release(&d); } [fill] ARGB8888 64x48 at (16,8) = 0: inside ff3366cc, outside 00000000, ok [fill] RGB565 64x48 at (16,8) = 0: inside 3339 (0xff3366cc is 3339), ok

int g2d_blit(const struct device *dev, const struct g2d_surface *src, const struct g2d_rect *src_rect, const struct g2d_surface *dst, const struct g2d_rect *dst_rect, enum g2d_rotation rotation, uint32_t flags); 把源矩形搬到目的矩形，等完成才返回。源和目的矩形大小不同就缩放；格式不同就转换；rotation 和 flags 里的 G2D_FLIP_H、G2D_FLIP_V 做旋转和翻转（先旋转后翻转）。 示例：复制、缩放、转换格式​ /* g2d_blit: copy a rectangle, converting the format, scaling to the size of the destination * rectangle and rotating */ static void demo_blit(void) { struct g2d_surface s = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 128, 96); struct g2d_surface d = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 128, 96); struct g2d_rect sr = { 10, 6, 80, 60 }, dr = { 30, 20, 80, 60 }; int ret; for (int y = 0; y < 96; y++) { for (int x = 0; x < 128; x++) { *px32(&s, x, y) = 0xff000000 | (x << 16) | (y << 8) | 0x80; } } flush(&s); /* copy */ ret = g2d_blit(g2d, &s, &sr, &d, &dr, G2D_ROTATE_0, 0); printk("[blit] copy 80x60 to (30,20) = %s: %s
", err(ret), verdict(*px32(&d, 30, 20) == *px32(&s, 10, 6) && *px32(&d, 109, 79) == *px32(&s, 89, 65))); /* scale up to twice the size */ struct g2d_surface big = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 256, 192); struct g2d_rect small = { 0, 0, 64, 48 }, twice = { 0, 0, 128, 96 }; ret = g2d_blit(g2d, &s, &small, &big, &twice, G2D_ROTATE_0, 0); printk("[blit] scale 64x48 to 128x96 = %s: corner %08x -> %08x
", err(ret), *px32(&s, 0, 0), *px32(&big, 0, 0)); /* convert to RGB565 */ struct g2d_surface c = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_RGB565, 128, 96); struct g2d_rect all = { 0, 0, 128, 96 }; ret = g2d_blit(g2d, &s, &all, &c, &all, G2D_ROTATE_0, 0); uint32_t p = *px32(&s, 100, 50); uint16_t want = (((p >> 16) & 0xff) >> 3) << 11 | (((p >> 8) & 0xff) >> 2) << 5 | ((p & 0xff) >> 3); printk("[blit] ARGB8888 to RGB565 = %s: %08x -> %04x (wanted %04x), %s
", err(ret), p, *px16(&c, 100, 50), want, verdict(near(*px16(&c, 100, 50), want, 0))); release(&s); release(&d); release(&big); release(&c); } [blit] copy 80x60 to (30,20) = 0: ok [blit] scale 64x48 to 128x96 = 0: corner ff000080 -> ff000080 [blit] ARGB8888 to RGB565 = 0: ff643280 -> 6190 (wanted 6190), ok 示例：旋转和翻转​ 源图四个角各有一种颜色，检查旋转后它们落到的位置。90 度和 270 度旋转的目的缓冲区是源的宽高互换。旋转要求源和目的同格式，目的行距 8 字节对齐，缓冲区地址 4 字节对齐。 /* g2d_blit with a rotation and flips. The source has four coloured corners; the rotation moves * them. The destination of a 90 or 270 degree rotation is as high as the source is wide. */ static void demo_rotate(void) { static const struct { const char *name; enum g2d_rotation rot; uint32_t flags; int tl, tr, bl, br; /* which source corner lands in each destination corner */ } cases[] = { /* corners are numbered 0 TL, 1 TR, 2 BL, 3 BR in the source */ { "flip horizontal", G2D_ROTATE_0, G2D_FLIP_H, 1, 0, 3, 2 }, { "flip vertical ", G2D_ROTATE_0, G2D_FLIP_V, 2, 3, 0, 1 }, { "rotate 90 ", G2D_ROTATE_90, 0, 2, 0, 3, 1 }, { "rotate 180 ", G2D_ROTATE_180, 0, 3, 2, 1, 0 }, { "rotate 270 ", G2D_ROTATE_270, 0, 1, 3, 0, 2 }, }; static const uint32_t corner[4] = { 0xffff0000, 0xff00ff00, 0xff0000ff, 0xffffff00 }; for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(cases); i++) { bool swap = cases[i].rot == G2D_ROTATE_90 || cases[i].rot == G2D_ROTATE_270; struct g2d_surface s = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 64, 48); struct g2d_surface d = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, swap ? 48 : 64, swap ? 64 : 48); struct g2d_rect sr = { 0, 0, 64, 48 }, dr = { 0, 0, d.width, d.height }; *px32(&s, 0, 0) = corner[0]; *px32(&s, 63, 0) = corner[1]; *px32(&s, 0, 47) = corner[2]; *px32(&s, 63, 47) = corner[3]; flush(&s); int ret = g2d_blit(g2d, &s, &sr, &d, &dr, cases[i].rot, cases[i].flags); bool ok = *px32(&d, 0, 0) == corner[cases[i].tl] && *px32(&d, d.width - 1, 0) == corner[cases[i].tr] && *px32(&d, 0, d.height - 1) == corner[cases[i].bl] && *px32(&d, d.width - 1, d.height - 1) == corner[cases[i].br]; printk("[rotate] %s %2ux%-2u -> %2ux%-2u = %s: %s
", cases[i].name, s.width, s.height, d.width, d.height, err(ret), verdict(ok)); release(&s); release(&d); } } [rotate] flip horizontal 64x48 -> 64x48 = 0: ok [rotate] flip vertical 64x48 -> 64x48 = 0: ok [rotate] rotate 90 64x48 -> 48x64 = 0: ok [rotate] rotate 180 64x48 -> 64x48 = 0: ok [rotate] rotate 270 64x48 -> 48x64 = 0: ok 示例：YUV 源转 RGB​ NV12 的两个平面各给一个基址和行距。默认是 BT.601、限幅（16…235）；G2D_FLAG_YUV_FULL_RANGE 用全幅，G2D_FLAG_YUV_BT709 用 BT.709。Y 81、U 90、V 240 在默认设置下是红色。 /* g2d_blit from a YUV source: NV12 is a Y plane followed by an interleaved U/V plane. * Y 81, U 90, V 240 is red in BT.601 with the limited range 16..235 (the defaults). */ static void demo_yuv(void) { struct g2d_surface s = { .format = G2D_PIXFMT_NV12, .width = 64, .height = 48 }; struct g2d_surface d = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 64, 48); struct g2d_rect all = { 0, 0, 64, 48 }; uint8_t *y = aligned_alloc(64, 64 * 48); uint8_t *uv = aligned_alloc(64, 64 * 24); int ret; memset(y, 81, 64 * 48); for (int i = 0; i < 64 * 24; i += 2) { uv[i] = 90; uv[i + 1] = 240; } sys_cache_data_flush_range(y, 64 * 48); sys_cache_data_flush_range(uv, 64 * 24); s.plane[0] = y; s.plane[1] = uv; s.pitch[0] = 64; s.pitch[1] = 64; ret = g2d_blit(g2d, &s, &all, &d, &all, G2D_ROTATE_0, 0); printk("[yuv] NV12 (81, 90, 240) to ARGB8888 = %s: %08x, %s
", err(ret), *px32(&d, 10, 10), verdict(near(*px32(&d, 10, 10), 0xffff0000, 3))); /* the same Y with a different matrix and range gives a different red */ ret = g2d_blit(g2d, &s, &all, &d, &all, G2D_ROTATE_0, G2D_FLAG_YUV_FULL_RANGE | G2D_FLAG_YUV_BT709); printk("[yuv] same data, full range, BT.709 = %s: %08x
", err(ret), *px32(&d, 10, 10)); free(y); free(uv); release(&d); } [yuv] NV12 (81, 90, 240) to ARGB8888 = 0: fffe0000, ok [yuv] same data, full range, BT.709 = 0: fff11300

int g2d_blend(const struct device *dev, const struct g2d_surface *fg, const struct g2d_rect *fg_rect, const struct g2d_surface *bg, const struct g2d_rect *bg_rect, const struct g2d_surface *dst, const struct g2d_rect *dst_rect, const struct g2d_blend *blend, uint32_t flags); 把前景叠在背景上，结果写到目的；目的可以就是背景。struct g2d_blend 选混合模式（Porter-Duff：G2D_BLEND_SRC_OVER、SRC、DST_OVER、SRC_IN 等 12 种）和前后景的 Alpha 来源： g2d_alpha_mode Alpha 的取法 G2D_ALPHA_PIXEL 像素自己的 Alpha 通道 G2D_ALPHA_GLOBAL 整层统一的 fg_alpha / bg_alpha（0…255） G2D_ALPHA_MIXED 像素的 Alpha 乘以整层的 Alpha 前景和目的区域大小不同时前景被缩放；背景必须是 RGB，并且和目的区域一样大。 /* g2d_blend: the foreground over the background. A red foreground with a layer alpha of 128 over * an opaque blue background is about half red and half blue. */ static void demo_blend(void) { struct g2d_surface fg = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 64, 48); struct g2d_surface bg = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 64, 48); struct g2d_surface d = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 64, 48); struct g2d_rect all = { 0, 0, 64, 48 }; struct g2d_blend b = { .mode = G2D_BLEND_SRC_OVER, .fg_alpha_mode = G2D_ALPHA_GLOBAL, .fg_alpha = 128, .bg_alpha_mode = G2D_ALPHA_PIXEL, }; int ret; for (int i = 0; i < 64 * 48; i++) { ((uint32_t *)fg.plane[0])[i] = 0xffff0000; ((uint32_t *)bg.plane[0])[i] = 0xff0000ff; } flush(&fg); flush(&bg); ret = g2d_blend(g2d, &fg, &all, &bg, &all, &d, &all, &b, 0); printk("[blend] src-over, layer alpha 128 = %s: %08x, %s
", err(ret), *px32(&d, 5, 5), verdict(near(*px32(&d, 5, 5), 0xff800080, 3))); /* the pixels' own alpha: a foreground of alpha 64 (a quarter) */ for (int i = 0; i < 64 * 48; i++) { ((uint32_t *)fg.plane[0])[i] = 0x40ff0000; } flush(&fg); b.fg_alpha_mode = G2D_ALPHA_PIXEL; ret = g2d_blend(g2d, &fg, &all, &bg, &all, &d, &all, &b, 0); printk("[blend] src-over, pixel alpha 64 = %s: %08x
", err(ret), *px32(&d, 5, 5)); /* a different Porter-Duff mode: G2D_BLEND_SRC replaces the background */ b.mode = G2D_BLEND_SRC; b.fg_alpha_mode = G2D_ALPHA_GLOBAL; b.fg_alpha = 255; ret = g2d_blend(g2d, &fg, &all, &bg, &all, &d, &all, &b, 0); printk("[blend] G2D_BLEND_SRC = %s: %08x
", err(ret), *px32(&d, 5, 5)); release(&fg); release(&bg); release(&d); } [blend] src-over, layer alpha 128 = 0: ff80007f, ok [blend] src-over, pixel alpha 64 = 0: ff4100be [blend] G2D_BLEND_SRC = 0: ffff0000 红色前景以整层 Alpha 128 盖在不透明蓝色上，得到一半红一半蓝；像素 Alpha 64 的红色约占四分之一。

int g2d_submit(const struct device *dev, const struct g2d_op *op); 把一个操作放进队列，不等它完成。struct g2d_op 描述操作的全部（类型、缓冲区、矩形、颜色、混合参数、回调），驱动会复制它，但操作用到的缓冲区要保持有效到操作完成。 返回 含义 0 已入队 -EINVAL 设备不支持这些参数（格式、矩形、对齐等） -ENOMEM 队列满了 完成后驱动在自己的线程里调用 op->callback，status 是 0 或负的错误码；回调里不能阻塞。操作按提交的顺序完成。 演示一次提交 12 个填充，队列装得下 7 个，其余 5 个被拒绝。 static K_SEM_DEFINE(done_sem, 0, 64); static volatile int completed, failed; static volatile int order_ok = 1, last_tag = -1; static void on_done(const struct device *dev, const struct g2d_op *op, int status, void *user_data) { int tag = (int)(intptr_t)user_data; if (status != 0) { failed++; } if (tag != last_tag + 1) { order_ok = 0; } last_tag = tag; completed++; k_sem_give(&done_sem); } static void demo_submit(void) { struct g2d_surface d = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 512, 384); struct g2d_op op = { .type = G2D_OP_FILL, .dst = d, .dst_rect = { 0, 0, 512, 384 }, .callback = on_done, }; int queued = 0, full = 0; /* more operations than the queue holds, without waiting in between */ for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) { int ret; op.color = 0xff000000 | (i * 20); op.user_data = (void *)(intptr_t)queued; ret = g2d_submit(g2d, &op); if (ret == 0) { queued++; } else if (ret == -ENOMEM) { full++; } } printk("[submit] 12 fills of 512x384 submitted: %d queued, %d refused with -ENOMEM\n", queued, full); for (int i = 0; i < queued; i++) { k_sem_take(&done_sem, K_SECONDS(2)); } printk("[submit] %d callbacks, %d failed, in submission order: %s; last pixel %08x\n", completed, failed, order_ok ? "yes" : "NO", *px32(&d, 100, 100)); release(&d); } [submit] 12 fills of 512x384 submitted: 7 queued, 5 refused with -ENOMEM [submit] 7 callbacks, 0 failed, in submission order: yes; last pixel ff000078

int g2d_run(const struct device *dev, const struct g2d_op *op, k_timeout_t timeout); 提交一个操作并等它完成。g2d_fill、g2d_blit、g2d_blend 就是它的包装。超时返回 -EAGAIN，操作本身仍会继续执行完。 /* g2d_run: submit and wait. A timeout shorter than the operation returns -EAGAIN, the operation * still finishes. */ static void demo_run(void) { struct g2d_surface d = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 1024, 768); struct g2d_op op = { .type = G2D_OP_FILL, .color = 0xff112233, .dst = d, .dst_rect = { 0, 0, 1024, 768 }, }; int64_t t0; int ret; t0 = k_uptime_ticks(); ret = g2d_run(g2d, &op, K_SECONDS(1)); printk("[run] fill 1024x768, wait up to 1 s = %s, %lld us, pixel %08x\n", err(ret), k_ticks_to_us_near64(k_uptime_ticks() - t0), *px32(&d, 500, 500)); ret = g2d_run(g2d, &op, K_NO_WAIT); printk("[run] the same with K_NO_WAIT = %s\n", err(ret)); k_msleep(50); release(&d); } [run] fill 1024x768, wait up to 1 s = 0, 5700 us, pixel ff112233 [run] the same with K_NO_WAIT = -EAGAIN

/* what the driver refuses */ static void demo_errors(void) { struct g2d_surface rgb = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 64, 48); struct g2d_surface yuv = { .format = G2D_PIXFMT_NV12, .width = 64, .height = 48 }; struct g2d_rect all = { 0, 0, 64, 48 }; struct g2d_rect outside = { 40, 40, 64, 48 }; struct g2d_rect empty = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }; struct g2d_rect small = { 0, 0, 32, 32 }; int ret; ret = g2d_fill(g2d, &rgb, &outside, 0xffffffff); printk("[error] rectangle outside the surface = %s
", err(ret)); ret = g2d_fill(g2d, &rgb, &empty, 0xffffffff); printk("[error] empty rectangle = %s
", err(ret)); ret = g2d_fill(g2d, &yuv, &all, 0xffffffff); printk("[error] destination in NV12 = %s
", err(ret)); ret = g2d_blit(g2d, &rgb, &all, &rgb, &small, G2D_ROTATE_90, 0); printk("[error] rotation to a different size = %s
", err(ret)); rgb.plane[0] = NULL; ret = g2d_fill(g2d, &rgb, &all, 0xffffffff); printk("[error] surface without a buffer = %s
", err(ret)); } [error] rectangle outside the surface = -EINVAL [error] empty rectangle = -EINVAL [error] destination in NV12 = -EINVAL [error] rotation to a different size = -EINVAL [error] surface without a buffer = -EINVAL

填充和复制一整屏（1024×768 ARGB8888，3 MiB）： /* the G2D against the CPU filling a 1024x768 buffer, which is a full screen */ static void demo_speed(void) { struct g2d_surface d = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 1024, 768); struct g2d_surface s = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 1024, 768); struct g2d_rect all = { 0, 0, 1024, 768 }; size_t size = 1024 * 768 * 4; int64_t t0; int ret; t0 = k_uptime_ticks(); for (size_t i = 0; i < size / 4; i++) { ((uint32_t *)d.plane[0])[i] = 0xff445566; } sys_cache_data_flush_range(d.plane[0], size); printk("[speed] CPU fill 1024x768 : %lld us
", k_ticks_to_us_near64(k_uptime_ticks() - t0)); t0 = k_uptime_ticks(); ret = g2d_fill(g2d, &d, &all, 0xff445566); printk("[speed] g2d_fill 1024x768 = %s: %lld us
", err(ret), k_ticks_to_us_near64(k_uptime_ticks() - t0)); t0 = k_uptime_ticks(); memcpy(s.plane[0], d.plane[0], size); sys_cache_data_flush_range(s.plane[0], size); printk("[speed] CPU copy 1024x768 : %lld us
", k_ticks_to_us_near64(k_uptime_ticks() - t0)); t0 = k_uptime_ticks(); ret = g2d_blit(g2d, &s, &all, &d, &all, G2D_ROTATE_0, 0); printk("[speed] g2d_blit 1024x768 = %s: %lld us
", err(ret), k_ticks_to_us_near64(k_uptime_ticks() - t0)); release(&s); release(&d); } [speed] CPU fill 1024x768 : 11300 us [speed] g2d_fill 1024x768 = 0: 5700 us [speed] CPU copy 1024x768 : 13400 us [speed] g2d_blit 1024x768 = 0: 10900 us CPU 的耗时包含把结果写回缓存。G2D 的优势是 CPU 在这段时间里可以做别的事（用 g2d_submit）。

用 G2D 在一个 320×240 的缓冲区里画几个色块，把一条白色半透明的条混合上去，再把这条转 90 度混到右侧，最后用显示接口写到屏幕的 (100, 100)。屏幕的帧缓冲层是 ARGB8888，写入窗口最大 400×400。 /* make a picture with the G2D and show it. The frame buffer plane of the display is ARGB8888 * and can be written in a window of at most 400x400 pixels. */ static void demo_show(void) { const struct device *disp = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_CHOSEN(zephyr_display)); struct g2d_surface scene = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 320, 240); struct g2d_surface bar = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 160, 32); struct g2d_surface tall = surface(G2D_PIXFMT_ARGB8888, 32, 160); struct g2d_rect all = { 0, 0, 320, 240 }; struct g2d_blend b = { .mode = G2D_BLEND_SRC_OVER, .fg_alpha_mode = G2D_ALPHA_GLOBAL, .fg_alpha = 160, .bg_alpha_mode = G2D_ALPHA_PIXEL }; if (!device_is_ready(disp)) { printk("[show] no display\n"); return; } /* a dark background, then three bars, the last one blended over the others */ g2d_fill(g2d, &scene, &all, 0xff102030); g2d_fill(g2d, &scene, &(struct g2d_rect){ 20, 20, 120, 80 }, 0xffe04040); g2d_fill(g2d, &scene, &(struct g2d_rect){ 100, 70, 120, 80 }, 0xff40e040); g2d_fill(g2d, &scene, &(struct g2d_rect){ 180, 120, 120, 80 }, 0xff4040e0); g2d_fill(g2d, &bar, &(struct g2d_rect){ 0, 0, 160, 32 }, 0xffffffff); g2d_blend(g2d, &bar, &(struct g2d_rect){ 0, 0, 160, 32 }, &scene, &(struct g2d_rect){ 80, 40, 160, 32 }, &scene, &(struct g2d_rect){ 80, 40, 160, 32 }, &b, 0); /* the bar turned to stand up, put over the right side */ g2d_blit(g2d, &bar, &(struct g2d_rect){ 0, 0, 160, 32 }, &tall, &(struct g2d_rect){ 0, 0, 32, 160 }, G2D_ROTATE_90, 0); g2d_blend(g2d, &tall, &(struct g2d_rect){ 0, 0, 32, 160 }, &scene, &(struct g2d_rect){ 260, 40, 32, 160 }, &scene, &(struct g2d_rect){ 260, 40, 32, 160 }, &b, 0); struct display_buffer_descriptor desc = { .buf_size = 320 * 240 * 4, .width = 320, .height = 240, .pitch = 320, }; int ret = display_write(disp, 100, 100, &desc, scene.plane[0]); sys_cache_data_flush_range(scene.plane[0], desc.buf_size); display_blanking_off(disp); printk("[show] display_write 320x240 at (100,100) = %s\n", err(ret)); release(&scene); release(&bar); release(&tall); } [show] display_write 320x240 at (100,100) = 0
上面所有示例和日志都来自这一个程序。建一个目录，放进下面的文件，就可以像其他 Zephyr 应用一样编译。 g2d_api/ ├── CMakeLists.txt ├── prj.conf └── src/ └── main.c
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0) find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE}) project(g2d_api) target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)

CONFIG_G2D=y CONFIG_DISPLAY=y CONFIG_PRINTK=y CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=8192 CONFIG_HEAP_MEM_POOL_SIZE=65536 # the buffers come from the libc heap, which takes all RAM above the image CONFIG_COMMON_LIBC_MALLOC_ARENA_SIZE=-1 CONFIG_SHELL=n CONFIG_DEVMEM_SHELL=n CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n CONFIG_COMMON_LIBC_MALLOC_ARENA_SIZE=-1 让 libc 的堆占用镜像之后的全部 RAM，演示里 1024×768 的缓冲区都从这里分配；把一个大堆放进系统堆（CONFIG_HEAP_MEM_POOL_SIZE）会让它成为 zephyr.bin 的一部分。

/* * Calls every function of <zephyr/drivers/g2d.h>: fill, copy with format conversion, scaling, * rotation and flips, YUV sources and alpha blending. Each result is checked against what the CPU * computes for the same pixels, then a picture made with the G2D is put on the display. */ #include <errno.h> #include <stdlib.h> #include <string.h> #include <zephyr/cache.h> #include <zephyr/device.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/display.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/g2d.h> #include <zephyr/kernel.h> #include <zephyr/sys/printk.h> static const struct device *const g2d = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(g2d)); static const char *err(int ret) { switch (ret) { case 0: return "0"; case -EINVAL: return "-EINVAL"; case -ENOMEM: return "-ENOMEM"; case -EAGAIN: return "-EAGAIN"; case -EIO: return "-EIO"; case -ETIMEDOUT: return "-ETIMEDOUT"; default: return "?"; } } /* A buffer for a surface: 64 byte aligned, which is the cache line size of the C907. */ static struct g2d_surface surface(enum g2d_format fmt, uint16_t w, uint16_t h) { struct g2d_surface s = { .format = fmt, .width = w, .height = h }; F101 的 GPIO 和引脚复用（pinctrl）在同一个 PIO 模块里：6 个 bank（PA…PF），每个 bank 32 根线，每个 bank 一个中断。Zephyr 里把每个 bank 做成一个 GPIO 设备（gpioa…gpiof），接口是标准的 <zephyr/drivers/gpio.h>，驱动是 drivers/gpio/gpio_sunxi.c。 项目 内容 设备 gpioa、gpiob、gpioc、gpiod、gpioe、gpiof，每个 bank 32 个引脚 方向 输入、输出，可选内部上拉或下拉 中断 上升沿、下降沿、双沿、高电平、低电平 不支持 开漏、开源输出（-ENOTSUP），gpio_pin_get_config

GPIO 涉及三个文件，从下到上依次是： 文件 作用 dts/bindings/gpio/allwinner,sunxi-gpio.yaml 绑定：规定 allwinner,sunxi-gpio 节点的属性 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 设备树：6 个 bank 的节点，默认都是 okay boards/yuzukihd/yuzukineko/yuzukineko.dts 板级设备树：用 gpio-leds、cd-gpios 这类属性引用具体的引脚

下面是 PB bank 的节点，其余 5 个 bank 只有寄存器地址、allwinner,bank 和中断号不同： gpiob: gpio@2000030 { /* 匹配驱动 gpio_sunxi.c 里的 DT_DRV_COMPAT allwinner_sunxi_gpio */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-gpio"; /* 这个 bank 的寄存器：基址 0x02000030，长度 0x30 */ reg = <0x02000030 0x30>; /* PIO 寄存器布局类型。F1xx 系列用类型 0：bank 间隔 0x30 字节，中断寄存器在 0x200 之后 */ allwinner,pio-hw-type = <ALLWINNER_PIO_HW_TYPE0>; /* bank 号：PA = 0，PB = 1，……，PF = 5。驱动靠它算出这个 bank 的中断寄存器位置 */ allwinner,bank = <1>; /* 这是一个 GPIO 控制器，引用它的 gpios 属性有 2 个格子：引脚号、标志 */ gpio-controller; #gpio-cells = <2>; /* 引脚个数 */ ngpios = <32>; /* 这个 bank 的中断：PLIC 的 69 号，优先级 1 */ interrupts = <69 1>; interrupt-parent = <&plic>; status = "okay"; }; 六个 bank 的差别： 节点 标签 寄存器 allwinner,bank PLIC 中断号 gpio@2000000 gpioa 0x02000000 0 67 gpio@2000030 gpiob 0x02000030 1 69 gpio@2000060 gpioc 0x02000060 2 71 gpio@2000090 gpiod 0x02000090 3 73 gpio@20000c0 gpioe 0x020000c0 4 75 gpio@20000f0 gpiof 0x020000f0 5 77

板级文件用 GPIO 的地方有两处。一处是 LED，另一处是 TF 卡的插卡检测： / { aliases { /* 应用里用 DT_ALIAS(led0) 取到 LED */ led0 = &led0; }; leds { compatible = "gpio-leds"; led0: led_0 { /* &gpiod：PD bank；5：第 5 根线，即 PD5；高电平点亮 */ gpios = <&gpiod 5 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>; }; }; }; &smhc0 { /* PF6 是 TF 卡插卡检测，低电平表示有卡，所以是 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW */ cd-gpios = <&gpiof 6 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>; }; gpios = <&gpiod 5 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH> 里 &gpiod 后面的两个数就是 #gpio-cells = <2> 规定的“引脚号”和“标志”。标志可以用的位在 include/zephyr/dt-bindings/gpio/gpio.h：GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW、GPIO_PULL_UP、GPIO_PULL_DOWN 等。

引脚不用作普通 GPIO，而是给外设用时，由 pinctrl 设定功能。yuzukineko.dts 里每个外设都有一组 pinctrl-0： &pio { /* UART1 控制台：PB00 是 TX，PB01 是 RX，复用功能 4 */ uart1_pins: uart1_pins { uart1_tx_rx { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PB, 0, 4) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PB, 1, 4)>; }; }; }; &uart1 { pinctrl-0 = <&uart1_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; }; ALLWINNER_PINMUX(bank, 引脚号, 复用功能) 的复用功能：0 是输入，1 是输出，2…15 是外设功能，14 是外部中断。每个引脚各功能是什么，见引脚复用表。可以写在同一个组里的属性： 属性 含义 pinmux 引脚和复用功能，每个格子一个引脚 bias-pull-up 打开内部上拉 bias-pull-down 打开内部下拉 bias-disable 关闭上下拉 allwinner,drive-level 驱动能力，0…3，不写就保持复位值

# Copyright (c) 2026 Yuzuki Tsuru # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 description: | Allwinner sunxi PIO GPIO controller. Each DT gpio node covers one PIO bank (PA..PF), identified by the 'allwinner,bank' property. The 'allwinner,pio-hw-type' property selects the PIO register layout used by the driver (see include/zephyr/drivers/pinctrl/pinctrl_sunxi.h). Bank interrupts are exposed as interrupt specifiers. compatible: "allwinner,sunxi-gpio" include: [gpio-controller.yaml, base.yaml] properties: reg: required: true interrupts: required: true allwinner,pio-hw-type: required: true type: int description: | PIO hardware layout type. See include/zephyr/drivers/pinctrl/pinctrl_sunxi.h for the register layout description of each type. allwinner,bank: required: true type: int description: | PIO bank number of this controller (PA = 0, PB = 1, ...). "#gpio-cells": const: 2 gpio-cells: - pin - flags 属性 必填 含义 reg 是 这个 bank 的寄存器 interrupts 是 这个 bank 的中断 allwinner,pio-hw-type 是 PIO 寄存器布局，F101 是 ALLWINNER_PIO_HW_TYPE0 allwinner,bank 是 bank 号，PA = 0 … PF = 5 ngpios 来自 gpio-controller.yaml 引脚个数，32 #gpio-cells 是，固定为 2 引脚号、标志
选项 默认 含义 CONFIG_GPIO 板级 defconfig 里是 y 打开 GPIO 子系统。自己的应用里要写在 prj.conf CONFIG_GPIO_SUNXI y（依赖 DT_HAS_ALLWINNER_SUNXI_GPIO_ENABLED） 编译这个驱动，不用手动设置 CONFIG_GPIO_INIT_PRIORITY Zephyr 默认 GPIO 驱动的初始化优先级

下面每个接口一个小标题：原型、驱动的行为、一个完整的示例函数和它在板子上的输出。示例来自文末的完整演示程序，里面的 err() 把返回值转成名字。接口里的“电平”都是逻辑电平：设备树里写了 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW 的引脚，gpio_pin_set_dt(spec, 1) 输出的是低电平。带 _raw 的接口不看这个标志。 演示用到 3 个引脚： 引脚 位置 用途 PD5 板上的 LED（led0） 输出 PB2 排针上悬空的引脚 输出，用 gpio_port_* 操作 PB3 排针上悬空的引脚 输入，用内部上下拉改变电平，触发中断 PB2 和 PB3 在演示的 app.overlay 里通过 zephyr,user 节点引用。这是应用自己给引脚取名字的标准办法，不用改板级文件。

int gpio_pin_configure_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec, gpio_flags_t extra_flags); 配置方向、初始电平和上下拉。 标志 驱动的行为 GPIO_INPUT 复用功能设为输入 GPIO_OUTPUT、GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE、GPIO_OUTPUT_ACTIVE 复用功能设为输出，并按初始电平先写数据寄存器再切成输出，输出口不会有毛刺 GPIO_PULL_UP、GPIO_PULL_DOWN 打开对应的内部上拉或下拉；两个都不写则关闭上下拉 GPIO_OPEN_DRAIN、GPIO_OPEN_SOURCE 返回 -ENOTSUP /* gpio_pin_configure_dt: direction, initial level and pull resistor */ static void demo_pin_configure_dt(void) { int ret; ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&led, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); printk("[configure] PD5 output, low = %s
", err(ret)); ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_UP); printk("[configure] PB3 input with pull up = %s
", err(ret)); ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_DOWN); printk("[configure] PB3 input with pull down = %s
", err(ret)); ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&out, GPIO_OUTPUT | GPIO_OPEN_DRAIN); printk("[configure] PB2 open drain output = %s
", err(ret)); ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&out, GPIO_OUTPUT | GPIO_OPEN_SOURCE); printk("[configure] PB2 open source output = %s
", err(ret)); } [configure] PD5 output, low = 0 [configure] PB3 input with pull up = 0 [configure] PB3 input with pull down = 0 [configure] PB2 open drain output = -ENOTSUP [configure] PB2 open source output = -ENOTSUP

int gpio_pin_set_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec, int value); 设置输出的逻辑电平，1 是有效电平。 /* gpio_pin_set_dt: the logical level of an output */ static void demo_pin_set_dt(void) { int ret; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&led, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); ret = gpio_pin_set_dt(&led, 1); printk("[set] gpio_pin_set_dt(PD5, 1) = %s, register bit %d\n", err(ret), gpio_pin_get_raw(led.port, led.pin)); ret = gpio_pin_set_dt(&led, 0); printk("[set] gpio_pin_set_dt(PD5, 0) = %s, register bit %d\n", err(ret), gpio_pin_get_raw(led.port, led.pin)); } [set] gpio_pin_set_dt(PD5, 1) = 0, register bit 1 [set] gpio_pin_set_dt(PD5, 0) = 0, register bit 0

int gpio_pin_toggle_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec); 把输出的电平翻转。 /* gpio_pin_toggle_dt: invert an output; six calls make the LED blink three times */ static void demo_pin_toggle_dt(void) { int ret = gpio_pin_toggle_dt(&led); printk("[toggle] gpio_pin_toggle_dt(PD5) = %s, register bit %d\n", err(ret), gpio_pin_get_raw(led.port, led.pin)); for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { k_msleep(100); gpio_pin_toggle_dt(&led); } printk("[toggle] blinked the LED 3 times\n"); } [toggle] gpio_pin_toggle_dt(PD5) = 0, register bit 1 [toggle] blinked the LED 3 times 最后一行对应 LED 闪烁 3 次。

int gpio_pin_get_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec); 读引脚的逻辑电平。输出引脚读回的是写进去的值，不是引脚上的实际电平。 /* gpio_pin_get_dt: the logical level of a pin. For an output pin it is the level that was written. */ static void demo_pin_get_dt(void) { int level; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&led, GPIO_OUTPUT_ACTIVE); level = gpio_pin_get_dt(&led); printk("[get] PD5 written active, gpio_pin_get_dt = %d\n", level); gpio_pin_configure_dt(&led, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); level = gpio_pin_get_dt(&led); printk("[get] PD5 written inactive, gpio_pin_get_dt = %d\n", level); } [get] PD5 written active, gpio_pin_get_dt = 1 [get] PD5 written inactive, gpio_pin_get_dt = 0

int gpio_pin_get_raw(const struct device *port, gpio_pin_t pin); 读引脚上的实际电平，不看 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW。PB3 悬空，所以打开上拉读到 1，打开下拉读到 0，这也是后面中断演示制造边沿的办法。 /* gpio_pin_get_raw: the level of the pin, not looking at GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW. PB3 is not connected, * so the pull resistor decides. */ static void demo_pin_get_raw(void) { gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_UP); k_msleep(1); printk("[get_raw] PB3 with pull up = %d\n", gpio_pin_get_raw(in.port, in.pin)); gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_DOWN); k_msleep(1); printk("[get_raw] PB3 with pull down = %d\n", gpio_pin_get_raw(in.port, in.pin)); } [get_raw] PB3 with pull up = 1 [get_raw] PB3 with pull down = 0

int gpio_port_get_raw(const struct device *port, gpio_port_value_t *value); 一次读整个 bank 的 32 根线，value 的每一位对应一个引脚。 /* gpio_port_get_raw: all 32 pins of the bank at once */ static void demo_port_get_raw(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_UP); k_msleep(1); ret = gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[port_get] gpio_port_get_raw(PB) = %s, PB2 %d, PB3 %d\n", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin)), !!(v & BIT(in.pin))); } [port_get] gpio_port_get_raw(PB) = 0, PB2 0, PB3 1

int gpio_port_set_bits_raw(const struct device *port, gpio_port_pins_t pins); 把掩码里的引脚都拉高，一次寄存器写入完成。 /* gpio_port_set_bits_raw: drive the pins of the mask high */ static void demo_port_set_bits_raw(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&out, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); ret = gpio_port_set_bits_raw(gpiob, BIT(out.pin)); gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[set_bits] gpio_port_set_bits_raw(PB2) = %s, PB2 %d\n", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin))); } [set_bits] gpio_port_set_bits_raw(PB2) = 0, PB2 1

int gpio_port_clear_bits_raw(const struct device *port, gpio_port_pins_t pins); 把掩码里的引脚都拉低。 /* gpio_port_clear_bits_raw: drive the pins of the mask low */ static void demo_port_clear_bits_raw(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret = gpio_port_clear_bits_raw(gpiob, BIT(out.pin)); gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[clear_bits] gpio_port_clear_bits_raw(PB2) = %s, PB2 %d\n", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin))); } [clear_bits] gpio_port_clear_bits_raw(PB2) = 0, PB2 0

int gpio_port_toggle_bits(const struct device *port, gpio_port_pins_t pins); 把掩码里的引脚都翻转。 /* gpio_port_toggle_bits: invert the pins of the mask */ static void demo_port_toggle_bits(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret = gpio_port_toggle_bits(gpiob, BIT(out.pin)); gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[toggle_bits] gpio_port_toggle_bits(PB2) = %s, PB2 %d\n", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin))); } [toggle_bits] gpio_port_toggle_bits(PB2) = 0, PB2 1

int gpio_port_set_masked_raw(const struct device *port, gpio_port_pins_t mask, gpio_port_value_t value); 掩码里的引脚设成 value 里对应的位，其余引脚不变。 /* gpio_port_set_masked_raw: set the pins of the mask to the matching bits of value, leave the others */ static void demo_port_set_masked_raw(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret = gpio_port_set_masked_raw(gpiob, BIT(out.pin), 0); gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[set_masked] gpio_port_set_masked_raw(PB2, 0) = %s, PB2 %d\n", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin))); } [set_masked] gpio_port_set_masked_raw(PB2, 0) = 0, PB2 0

void gpio_init_callback(struct gpio_callback *callback, gpio_callback_handler_t handler, gpio_port_pins_t pin_mask); 把处理函数和它关心的引脚掩码绑在一个 struct gpio_callback 上。回调在 PLIC 中断里执行，pins 参数是这个 bank 上本次待处理的所有引脚的位掩码，回调里不要做耗时的事。下面三个演示共用的变量和回调函数： static struct gpio_callback cb; static volatile int fired; static volatile uint32_t last_pins; static void on_edge(const struct device *port, struct gpio_callback *callback, uint32_t pins) { fired++; last_pins = pins; } /* gpio_init_callback: bind a handler and the mask of the pins it wants */ static void demo_init_callback(void) { gpio_init_callback(&cb, on_edge, BIT(in.pin)); printk("[init_callback] handler for pin mask 0x%x\n", (unsigned int)cb.pin_mask); } [init_callback] handler for pin mask 0x8

int gpio_add_callback(const struct device *port, struct gpio_callback *callback); 把回调注册到 bank 上。 /* gpio_add_callback: register it with the bank */ static void demo_add_callback(void) { int ret = gpio_add_callback(in.port, &cb); printk("[add_callback] gpio_add_callback = %s\n", err(ret)); } [add_callback] gpio_add_callback = 0

int gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(const struct gpio_dt_spec *spec, gpio_flags_t flags); flags 驱动的行为 GPIO_INT_EDGE_RISING、GPIO_INT_EDGE_FALLING、GPIO_INT_EDGE_BOTH 边沿触发 GPIO_INT_LEVEL_HIGH、GPIO_INT_LEVEL_LOW 电平触发 GPIO_INT_DISABLE 关掉这个引脚的中断；如果引脚还在中断功能上，把复用功能恢复为打开中断前的值 警告 打开引脚中断时驱动把这个引脚切到外部中断功能（复用功能 14），原来的功能存下来；已经打开中断的引脚再次打开时不会覆盖存下来的功能。之后再对同一个引脚调用 gpio_pin_configure，复用功能会被写成“输入”或“输出”，中断就收不到了。所以改过引脚配置以后，要再调用一次 gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt。 演示：PB3 先下拉，装载上升沿；改成上拉制造一个上升沿，回调触发 1 次；改回下拉是下降沿，不是装载的上升沿，回调次数是 0。 /* gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt: arm the pin. The pull resistor is part of the pin configuration, * so after every gpio_pin_configure the interrupt is armed again. */ static void demo_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(void) { int ret; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_DOWN); k_msleep(1); ret = gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INT_EDGE_RISING); printk("[interrupt] arm EDGE_RISING = %s
", err(ret)); fired = 0; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_UP); gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INT_EDGE_RISING); k_msleep(20); printk("[interrupt] pull up after arming rising : %d callback(s), pins 0x%x
", fired, last_pins); fired = 0; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_DOWN); gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INT_EDGE_RISING); k_msleep(20); printk("[interrupt] pull down after arming rising : %d callback(s)
", fired); ret = gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INT_DISABLE); printk("[interrupt] GPIO_INT_DISABLE = %s
", err(ret)); } [interrupt] arm EDGE_RISING = 0 [interrupt] pull up after arming rising : 1 callback(s), pins 0x8 [interrupt] pull down after arming rising : 0 callback(s) [interrupt] GPIO_INT_DISABLE = 0 pins 0x8 就是 PB3（第 3 位）。

int gpio_get_pending_int(const struct device *dev); 读这个 bank 的中断状态寄存器，每个引脚一位。中断处理函数会清掉已经处理的位，所以没有待处理的中断时读到 0。 /* gpio_get_pending_int: the interrupt status register of the bank, one bit per pin */ static void demo_get_pending_int(void) { printk("[pending] gpio_get_pending_int(PB) = 0x%x\n", gpio_get_pending_int(gpiob)); } [pending] gpio_get_pending_int(PB) = 0x0

int gpio_remove_callback(const struct device *port, struct gpio_callback *callback); 把回调从 bank 上取下来。 /* gpio_remove_callback: take the handler out again */ static void demo_remove_callback(void) { int ret = gpio_remove_callback(in.port, &cb); printk("[remove_callback] gpio_remove_callback = %s\n", err(ret)); } [remove_callback] gpio_remove_callback = 0
上面所有示例和日志都来自这一个程序。建一个目录，放进下面的文件，就可以像其他 Zephyr 应用一样编译。 gpio_api/ ├── CMakeLists.txt ├── prj.conf ├── app.overlay └── src/ └── main.c
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0) find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE}) project(gpio_api) target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)

CONFIG_GPIO=y CONFIG_PRINTK=y CONFIG_SHELL=n CONFIG_DEVMEM_SHELL=n CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096 CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096 不能省：默认的主线程栈只有 1024 字节，printk 就会把它用完，程序在显示初始化的时候就会因为 Instruction Access fault 停下来。
/* PB2 and PB3 are free pins of the board (the UART1 flow control signals, not used) */ / { zephyr,user { out-gpios = <&gpiob 2 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>; in-gpios = <&gpiob 3 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>; }; };

/* * Calls the functions of <zephyr/drivers/gpio.h> that the sunxi GPIO driver * implements, one function per call, and prints what each call returns. */ #include <errno.h> #include <zephyr/device.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/gpio.h> #include <zephyr/kernel.h> #include <zephyr/sys/printk.h> /* PD5, the LED of the board (alias led0 in yuzukineko.dts) */ static const struct gpio_dt_spec led = GPIO_DT_SPEC_GET(DT_ALIAS(led0), gpios); /* PB2 and PB3, from the zephyr,user node of app.overlay */ static const struct gpio_dt_spec out = GPIO_DT_SPEC_GET(DT_PATH(zephyr_user), out_gpios); static const struct gpio_dt_spec in = GPIO_DT_SPEC_GET(DT_PATH(zephyr_user), in_gpios); static const struct device *const gpiob = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(gpiob)); static const char *err(int ret) { switch (ret) { case 0: return "0"; case -ENOTSUP: return "-ENOTSUP"; case -EINVAL: return "-EINVAL"; case -EIO: return "-EIO"; default: return "?"; } } /* gpio_pin_configure_dt: direction, initial level and pull resistor */ static void demo_pin_configure_dt(void) { int ret; ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&led, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); printk("[configure] PD5 output, low = %s
", err(ret)); ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_UP); printk("[configure] PB3 input with pull up = %s
", err(ret)); ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_DOWN); printk("[configure] PB3 input with pull down = %s
", err(ret)); ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&out, GPIO_OUTPUT | GPIO_OPEN_DRAIN); printk("[configure] PB2 open drain output = %s
", err(ret)); ret = gpio_pin_configure_dt(&out, GPIO_OUTPUT | GPIO_OPEN_SOURCE); printk("[configure] PB2 open source output = %s
", err(ret)); } /* gpio_pin_set_dt: the logical level of an output */ static void demo_pin_set_dt(void) { int ret; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&led, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); ret = gpio_pin_set_dt(&led, 1); printk("[set] gpio_pin_set_dt(PD5, 1) = %s, register bit %d
", err(ret), gpio_pin_get_raw(led.port, led.pin)); ret = gpio_pin_set_dt(&led, 0); printk("[set] gpio_pin_set_dt(PD5, 0) = %s, register bit %d
", err(ret), gpio_pin_get_raw(led.port, led.pin)); } /* gpio_pin_toggle_dt: invert an output; six calls make the LED blink three times */ static void demo_pin_toggle_dt(void) { int ret = gpio_pin_toggle_dt(&led); printk("[toggle] gpio_pin_toggle_dt(PD5) = %s, register bit %d
", err(ret), gpio_pin_get_raw(led.port, led.pin)); for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { k_msleep(100); gpio_pin_toggle_dt(&led); } printk("[toggle] blinked the LED 3 times
"); } /* gpio_pin_get_dt: the logical level of a pin. For an output pin it is the level that was written. */ static void demo_pin_get_dt(void) { int level; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&led, GPIO_OUTPUT_ACTIVE); level = gpio_pin_get_dt(&led); printk("[get] PD5 written active, gpio_pin_get_dt = %d
", level); gpio_pin_configure_dt(&led, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); level = gpio_pin_get_dt(&led); printk("[get] PD5 written inactive, gpio_pin_get_dt = %d
", level); } /* gpio_pin_get_raw: the level of the pin, not looking at GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW. PB3 is not connected, * so the pull resistor decides. */ static void demo_pin_get_raw(void) { gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_UP); k_msleep(1); printk("[get_raw] PB3 with pull up = %d
", gpio_pin_get_raw(in.port, in.pin)); gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_DOWN); k_msleep(1); printk("[get_raw] PB3 with pull down = %d
", gpio_pin_get_raw(in.port, in.pin)); } /* gpio_port_get_raw: all 32 pins of the bank at once */ static void demo_port_get_raw(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_UP); k_msleep(1); ret = gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[port_get] gpio_port_get_raw(PB) = %s, PB2 %d, PB3 %d
", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin)), !!(v & BIT(in.pin))); } /* gpio_port_set_bits_raw: drive the pins of the mask high */ static void demo_port_set_bits_raw(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&out, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); ret = gpio_port_set_bits_raw(gpiob, BIT(out.pin)); gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[set_bits] gpio_port_set_bits_raw(PB2) = %s, PB2 %d
", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin))); } /* gpio_port_clear_bits_raw: drive the pins of the mask low */ static void demo_port_clear_bits_raw(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret = gpio_port_clear_bits_raw(gpiob, BIT(out.pin)); gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[clear_bits] gpio_port_clear_bits_raw(PB2) = %s, PB2 %d
", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin))); } /* gpio_port_toggle_bits: invert the pins of the mask */ static void demo_port_toggle_bits(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret = gpio_port_toggle_bits(gpiob, BIT(out.pin)); gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[toggle_bits] gpio_port_toggle_bits(PB2) = %s, PB2 %d
", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin))); } /* gpio_port_set_masked_raw: set the pins of the mask to the matching bits of value, leave the others */ static void demo_port_set_masked_raw(void) { gpio_port_value_t v; int ret = gpio_port_set_masked_raw(gpiob, BIT(out.pin), 0); gpio_port_get_raw(gpiob, &v); printk("[set_masked] gpio_port_set_masked_raw(PB2, 0) = %s, PB2 %d
", err(ret), !!(v & BIT(out.pin))); } /* interrupts. The edge is made by switching the pull resistor of the unconnected pin PB3. */ static struct gpio_callback cb; static volatile int fired; static volatile uint32_t last_pins; static void on_edge(const struct device *port, struct gpio_callback *callback, uint32_t pins) { fired++; last_pins = pins; } /* gpio_init_callback: bind a handler and the mask of the pins it wants */ static void demo_init_callback(void) { gpio_init_callback(&cb, on_edge, BIT(in.pin)); printk("[init_callback] handler for pin mask 0x%x
", (unsigned int)cb.pin_mask); } /* gpio_add_callback: register it with the bank */ static void demo_add_callback(void) { int ret = gpio_add_callback(in.port, &cb); printk("[add_callback] gpio_add_callback = %s
", err(ret)); } /* gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt: arm the pin. The pull resistor is part of the pin configuration, * so after every gpio_pin_configure the interrupt is armed again. */ static void demo_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(void) { int ret; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_DOWN); k_msleep(1); ret = gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INT_EDGE_RISING); printk("[interrupt] arm EDGE_RISING = %s
", err(ret)); fired = 0; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_UP); gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INT_EDGE_RISING); k_msleep(20); printk("[interrupt] pull up after arming rising : %d callback(s), pins 0x%x
", fired, last_pins); fired = 0; gpio_pin_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INPUT | GPIO_PULL_DOWN); gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INT_EDGE_RISING); k_msleep(20); printk("[interrupt] pull down after arming rising : %d callback(s)
", fired); ret = gpio_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(&in, GPIO_INT_DISABLE); printk("[interrupt] GPIO_INT_DISABLE = %s
", err(ret)); } /* gpio_get_pending_int: the interrupt status register of the bank, one bit per pin */ static void demo_get_pending_int(void) { printk("[pending] gpio_get_pending_int(PB) = 0x%x
", gpio_get_pending_int(gpiob)); } /* gpio_remove_callback: take the handler out again */ static void demo_remove_callback(void) { int ret = gpio_remove_callback(in.port, &cb); printk("[remove_callback] gpio_remove_callback = %s
", err(ret)); } int main(void) { if (!gpio_is_ready_dt(&led) || !gpio_is_ready_dt(&out) || !gpio_is_ready_dt(&in)) { printk("gpio not ready
"); return 0; } demo_pin_configure_dt(); demo_pin_set_dt(); demo_pin_toggle_dt(); demo_pin_get_dt(); demo_pin_get_raw(); demo_port_get_raw(); demo_port_set_bits_raw(); demo_port_clear_bits_raw(); demo_port_toggle_bits(); demo_port_set_masked_raw(); demo_init_callback(); demo_add_callback(); demo_pin_interrupt_configure_dt(); demo_get_pending_int(); demo_remove_callback(); printk("gpio_api done
"); return 0; }

F101 有 3 个两线接口控制器（TWI），在 Zephyr 里是 i2c0、i2c1、i2c2，接口是标准的 <zephyr/drivers/i2c.h>，驱动是 drivers/i2c/i2c_sunxi.c。 项目 内容 设备 i2c0、i2c1、i2c2 角色 只做主机（controller） 速度 标准 100 kHz、快速 400 kHz；设备树里还可以写 200 kHz 地址 7 位；10 位地址返回 -ENOTSUP 传输方式 轮询，不用中断；传输期间持有一把互斥锁 不支持 快速+（1 MHz）、从机模式、i2c_get_config

文件 作用 dts/bindings/i2c/allwinner,sunxi-twi.yaml 绑定：规定 allwinner,sunxi-twi 节点的属性 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 设备树：i2c0、i2c1、i2c2，默认 disabled boards/yuzukihd/yuzukineko/yuzukineko.dts 板级设备树：打开要用的控制器，指定引脚和速度，挂上从设备

三个节点只有寄存器地址、中断号、时钟和复位不同。下面是 i2c1： i2c1: i2c@2502400 { /* 匹配驱动 i2c_sunxi.c 里的 DT_DRV_COMPAT allwinner_sunxi_twi */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-twi"; /* 子节点（从设备）用 1 个格子的地址，没有大小 */ #address-cells = <1>; #size-cells = <0>; /* 寄存器窗口：基址 0x02502400，长度 0x400 */ reg = <0x02502400 0x400>; /* 中断：PLIC 的 10 号，优先级 1（驱动用轮询，不使用） */ interrupts = <10 1>; interrupt-parent = <&plic>; /* 总线时钟的开关和总线复位 */ clocks = <&cctl CLK_BUS_TWI1>; resets = <&rctl RST_BUS_TWI1>; /* 总线速度，板级文件可以改：100000、200000 或 400000 */ clock-frequency = <100000>; /* 默认关闭，由板级打开 */ status = "disabled"; }; 节点 标签 寄存器 PLIC 中断号 时钟宏 复位宏 i2c@2502000 i2c0 0x02502000 9 CLK_BUS_TWI0 RST_BUS_TWI0 i2c@2502400 i2c1 0x02502400 10 CLK_BUS_TWI1 RST_BUS_TWI1 i2c@2502800 i2c2 0x02502800 11 CLK_BUS_TWI2 RST_BUS_TWI2

板级文件做三件事：定义引脚组，打开控制器并绑定引脚，把从设备挂在控制器下面。 &pio { /* TWI0 在 PE08/PE09；TWI1 在 PD0/PD1（触摸屏）；TWI2 在 PD10/PD11。复用功能都是 4，打开上拉 */ twi1_pins: twi1_pins { twi1_pins_group { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 0, 4) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 1, 4)>; bias-pull-up; }; }; }; /* TWI0 的 PE8/PE9 是蓝牙 UART2 的 RTS/CTS，所以关闭 */ &i2c0 { status = "disabled"; pinctrl-0 = <&twi0_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; }; /* 载板触摸屏控制器 GT967：SCL 在 PD0，SDA 在 PD1，INT 在 PD2，RST 在 PD3 */ &i2c1 { status = "okay"; /* 400 kHz。I2C_BITRATE_FAST 来自 <zephyr/dt-bindings/i2c/i2c.h> */ clock-frequency = <I2C_BITRATE_FAST>; pinctrl-0 = <&twi1_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; /* 从设备：节点名里 @ 后面和 reg 是 7 位地址 */ touch: touch@5d { compatible = "goodix,gt967"; reg = <0x5d>; screen-width = <1024>; screen-height = <768>; irq-gpios = <&gpiod 2 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>; reset-gpios = <&gpiod 3 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>; }; }; i2c2 在板级文件里没有打开；用它时在应用的 overlay 里写 &i2c2 { status = "okay"; pinctrl-0 = <&twi2_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; };，twi2_pins 已经在板级文件里定义好。

# Copyright (c) 2026 Yuzuki Tsuru # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 description: Allwinner sunxi two-wire interface controller compatible: "allwinner,sunxi-twi" include: [i2c-controller.yaml, pinctrl-device.yaml] properties: reg: required: true clocks: required: true resets: type: phandle-array required: true clock-frequency: required: true 属性 必填 含义 reg 是 寄存器窗口 clocks 是 总线时钟 resets 是 总线复位 clock-frequency 是 总线速度，只接受 100000、200000、400000，别的值驱动初始化返回 -ENOTSUP pinctrl-0、pinctrl-names 来自 pinctrl-device.yaml 引脚，见 GPIO 页的 pinctrl 一节 interrupts 否 驱动不使用
选项 默认 含义 CONFIG_I2C 板级 defconfig 里是 y 打开 I2C 子系统 CONFIG_I2C_SUNXI y（依赖 DT_HAS_ALLWINNER_SUNXI_TWI_ENABLED） 编译这个驱动，并选中 CONFIG_PINCTRL CONFIG_I2C_SUNXI_INIT_PRIORITY 81 驱动的初始化优先级

下面每个接口一个小标题：原型、驱动的行为、一个完整的示例函数和它在板子上的输出。演示在 i2c1 上，对载板的触摸控制器 GT967 做所有这些调用；示例来自文末的完整演示程序，里面的 err() 把返回值转成名字。 GT967 的寄存器地址是 16 位、大端的，产品 ID 寄存器 0x8140 里是 4 字节 ASCII，"967" 加一个 0。它在复位释放的瞬间看 INT 引脚的电平选地址：INT 为低是 0x5d，为高是 0x14。演示程序先用 touch_reset() 做这件事，真正的触摸驱动 drivers/input/input_gt967.c 也这么做；这个函数只用到 GPIO 的接口： /* The controller takes its address from the level of INT at the moment RST is released: * INT low gives 0x5d, INT high gives 0x14. A real touch driver does this once at start. */ static void touch_reset(void) { gpio_pin_configure_dt(&rst, GPIO_OUTPUT_ACTIVE); /* RST is active low in the DT: held in reset */ k_msleep(12); gpio_pin_configure_dt(&irq, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); /* INT low selects 0x5d */ k_msleep(2); gpio_pin_set_dt(&rst, 0); /* released */ k_msleep(6); gpio_pin_configure_dt(&irq, GPIO_INPUT); k_msleep(60); printk("[reset] released RST with INT low, the controller should answer at 0x%02x\n", ADDR); }

int i2c_configure(const struct device *dev, uint32_t dev_config); 运行中改变总线速度。dev_config 必须带 I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER。 参数 返回 I2C_SPEED_STANDARD（100 kHz） 0 I2C_SPEED_FAST（400 kHz） 0 其他速度（快速+、高速、超高速） -ENOTSUP 带 I2C_ADDR_10_BITS -ENOTSUP 没有 I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER -ENOTSUP 每次调用都会复位控制器、重新设置分频。 /* i2c_configure: the speed can be changed at run time */ static void demo_configure(void) { int ret; ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_STANDARD) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER); printk("[configure] standard, 100 kHz = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_FAST) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER); printk("[configure] fast, 400 kHz = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_FAST_PLUS) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER); printk("[configure] fast plus, 1 MHz = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_STANDARD) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER | I2C_ADDR_10_BITS); printk("[configure] 10 bit addresses = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_STANDARD)); printk("[configure] without I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_FAST) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER); printk("[configure] back to fast = %s
", err(ret)); } [configure] standard, 100 kHz = 0 [configure] fast, 400 kHz = 0 [configure] fast plus, 1 MHz = -ENOTSUP [configure] 10 bit addresses = -ENOTSUP [configure] without I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER = -ENOTSUP [configure] back to fast = 0

int i2c_get_config(const struct device *dev, uint32_t *dev_config); 读当前的配置。驱动没有实现这个接口，返回 -ENOSYS。 /* i2c_get_config is not implemented by this driver */ static void demo_get_config(void) { uint32_t cfg; int ret = i2c_get_config(bus, &cfg); printk("[configure] i2c_get_config = %s\n", err(ret)); } [configure] i2c_get_config = -ENOSYS

int i2c_read(const struct device *dev, uint8_t *buf, uint32_t num_bytes, uint16_t addr); 从 addr 读 num_bytes 个字节，是一次完整的传输，结尾有停止条件。设备不应答返回 -EIO，所以对每个地址读 1 个字节就可以扫描总线： /* A read of one byte finds out whether a device acknowledges its address. */ static void demo_scan(void) { uint8_t b; int found = 0; for (uint16_t a = 0x08; a <= 0x77; a++) { if (i2c_read(bus, &b, 1, a) == 0) { printk("[scan] device at 0x%02x
", a); found++; } } printk("[scan] %d device(s) found
", found); } [scan] device at 0x5d [scan] 1 device(s) found 读寄存器时，先用 i2c_write 设好寄存器地址，再 i2c_read，两次之间有停止条件；GT967 接受这种写法，有的芯片不接受，要用 i2c_write_read。下面读 0x8047（配置版本）的 1 个字节，前提是上一步 i2c_write 已经设了这个地址： /* i2c_read: reads the register that the write above selected */ static void demo_read(void) { uint8_t val = 0; int ret = i2c_read(bus, &val, 1, ADDR); printk("[write+read] i2c_read(1 byte) = %s: 0x%02x
", err(ret), val); } [write+read] i2c_read(1 byte) = 0: 0x69

int i2c_write(const struct device *dev, const uint8_t *buf, uint32_t num_bytes, uint16_t addr); 向 addr 写 num_bytes 个字节，是一次完整的传输。这里写的是 2 个字节的寄存器地址。 /* i2c_write: one complete transfer with a stop at the end. Here it sets the register address. */ static void demo_write(void) { uint8_t reg[2] = { REG_CONFIG_VER >> 8, REG_CONFIG_VER & 0xff }; int ret = i2c_write(bus, reg, sizeof(reg), ADDR); printk("[write+read] i2c_write(register address) = %s\n", err(ret)); } [write+read] i2c_write(register address) = 0 （日志里 i2c_write 在 i2c_read 之前，因为读依赖写设好的寄存器地址。）

int i2c_write_read(const struct device *dev, uint16_t addr, const void *write_buf, size_t num_write, void *read_buf, size_t num_read); 先写再读，两段之间是重复起始（restart），中间没有停止条件。这是读 16 位地址寄存器的标准办法。 /* i2c_write_read: write the 16 bit register address, restart, read the value */ static void demo_write_read(void) { uint8_t reg[2] = { REG_PRODUCT_ID >> 8, REG_PRODUCT_ID & 0xff }; uint8_t id[4] = { 0 }; int ret; ret = i2c_write_read(bus, ADDR, reg, sizeof(reg), id, sizeof(id)); printk("[write_read] product id register 0x%04x = %s: %02x %02x %02x %02x \"%c%c%c\"\n", REG_PRODUCT_ID, err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2], id[3], id[0], id[1], id[2]); } [write_read] product id register 0x8140 = 0: 39 36 37 00 "967"

int i2c_burst_read(const struct device *dev, uint16_t dev_addr, uint8_t start_addr, uint8_t *buf, uint32_t num_bytes); 写 1 个字节的起始地址，再连续读 num_bytes 个字节。GT967 的寄存器地址是 16 位，所以这个演示只说明调用能通；16 位地址的芯片用 i2c_write_read。 /* i2c_burst_read: writes a one byte start address, then reads. The GT967 registers have 16 bit * addresses, so this only shows that the call goes through; use i2c_write_read for this chip. */ static void demo_burst(void) { uint8_t buf[4]; int ret; ret = i2c_burst_read(bus, ADDR, 0x81, buf, sizeof(buf)); printk("[burst] i2c_burst_read(0x81, 4) = %s\n", err(ret)); } [burst] i2c_burst_read(0x81, 4) = 0

int i2c_transfer(const struct device *dev, struct i2c_msg *msgs, uint8_t num_msgs, uint16_t addr); 自己组织消息。flags 决定起始、重复起始、停止： 标志 驱动的行为 I2C_MSG_WRITE、I2C_MSG_READ 方向 I2C_MSG_RESTART 这条消息前发重复起始并重新发地址 I2C_MSG_STOP 这条消息后发停止条件；最后一条消息无论如何都会发 I2C_MSG_ADDR_10_BITS -ENOTSUP 地址超过 7 位返回 -EINVAL。连续的写消息合并成同一次传输。 /* i2c_transfer: the messages by hand, flags decide start, restart and stop */ static void demo_transfer(void) { uint8_t reg[2] = { REG_PRODUCT_ID >> 8, REG_PRODUCT_ID & 0xff }; uint8_t id[4] = { 0 }; struct i2c_msg msgs[2]; int ret; msgs[0].buf = reg; msgs[0].len = sizeof(reg); msgs[0].flags = I2C_MSG_WRITE; /* no stop: the next message restarts */ msgs[1].buf = id; msgs[1].len = sizeof(id); msgs[1].flags = I2C_MSG_READ | I2C_MSG_RESTART | I2C_MSG_STOP; ret = i2c_transfer(bus, msgs, 2, ADDR); printk("[transfer] write + restart + read = %s: "%c%c%c"
", err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); /* a 10 bit address is refused */ msgs[1].flags |= I2C_MSG_ADDR_10_BITS; ret = i2c_transfer(bus, msgs, 2, ADDR); printk("[transfer] 10 bit address = %s
", err(ret)); /* an address above 7 bits */ msgs[1].flags &= ~I2C_MSG_ADDR_10_BITS; ret = i2c_transfer(bus, msgs, 2, 0x100); printk("[transfer] address 0x100 = %s
", err(ret)); } [transfer] write + restart + read = 0: "967" [transfer] 10 bit address = -ENOTSUP [transfer] address 0x100 = -EINVAL

地址发出去没有设备应答，驱动返回 -EIO，并且发出停止条件让总线回到空闲。 /* a device that is not there does not acknowledge */ static void demo_nack(void) { uint8_t b; int ret; ret = i2c_read(bus, &b, 1, 0x50); printk("[nack] read from 0x50 = %s\n", err(ret)); ret = i2c_write(bus, &b, 1, 0x50); printk("[nack] write to 0x50 = %s\n", err(ret)); } [nack] read from 0x50 = -EIO [nack] write to 0x50 = -EIO
上面所有示例和日志都来自这一个程序。建一个目录，放进下面的文件，就可以像其他 Zephyr 应用一样编译。 i2c_api/ ├── CMakeLists.txt ├── prj.conf └── src/ └── main.c
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0) find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE}) project(i2c_api) target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)
CONFIG_I2C=y CONFIG_GPIO=y CONFIG_PRINTK=y CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096 CONFIG_SHELL=n CONFIG_DEVMEM_SHELL=n CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n

/* * Calls the functions of <zephyr/drivers/i2c.h> on I2C1 of the YuzukiNeko, * where the touch controller GT967 of the carrier board sits at 0x5d. */ #include <errno.h> #include <zephyr/device.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/gpio.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/i2c.h> #include <zephyr/kernel.h> #include <zephyr/sys/printk.h> static const struct device *const bus = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(i2c1)); /* the touch controller node of yuzukineko.dts: address and reset/interrupt pins */ #define TOUCH DT_NODELABEL(touch) static const struct gpio_dt_spec rst = GPIO_DT_SPEC_GET(TOUCH, reset_gpios); static const struct gpio_dt_spec irq = GPIO_DT_SPEC_GET(TOUCH, irq_gpios); #define ADDR DT_REG_ADDR(TOUCH) /* GT967 registers (16 bit addresses, big endian) */ #define REG_PRODUCT_ID 0x8140 /* "967" in ASCII, 4 bytes */ #define REG_CONFIG_VER 0x8047 /* 1 byte */ static const char *err(int ret) { switch (ret) { case 0: return "0"; case -EIO: return "-EIO"; case -ENOTSUP: return "-ENOTSUP"; case -EINVAL: return "-EINVAL"; case -EAGAIN: return "-EAGAIN"; case -ENOSYS: return "-ENOSYS"; case -ETIMEDOUT: return "-ETIMEDOUT"; default: return "?"; } } /* The controller takes its address from the level of INT at the moment RST is released: * INT low gives 0x5d, INT high gives 0x14. A real touch driver does this once at start. */ static void touch_reset(void) { gpio_pin_configure_dt(&rst, GPIO_OUTPUT_ACTIVE); /* RST is active low in the DT: held in reset */ k_msleep(12); gpio_pin_configure_dt(&irq, GPIO_OUTPUT_INACTIVE); /* INT low selects 0x5d */ k_msleep(2); gpio_pin_set_dt(&rst, 0); /* released */ k_msleep(6); gpio_pin_configure_dt(&irq, GPIO_INPUT); k_msleep(60); printk("[reset] released RST with INT low, the controller should answer at 0x%02x
", ADDR); } /* i2c_configure: the speed can be changed at run time */ static void demo_configure(void) { int ret; ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_STANDARD) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER); printk("[configure] standard, 100 kHz = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_FAST) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER); printk("[configure] fast, 400 kHz = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_FAST_PLUS) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER); printk("[configure] fast plus, 1 MHz = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_STANDARD) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER | I2C_ADDR_10_BITS); printk("[configure] 10 bit addresses = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_STANDARD)); printk("[configure] without I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_configure(bus, I2C_SPEED_SET(I2C_SPEED_FAST) | I2C_MODE_CONTROLLER); printk("[configure] back to fast = %s
", err(ret)); } /* i2c_get_config is not implemented by this driver */ static void demo_get_config(void) { uint32_t cfg; int ret = i2c_get_config(bus, &cfg); printk("[configure] i2c_get_config = %s
", err(ret)); } /* A read of one byte finds out whether a device acknowledges its address. */ static void demo_scan(void) { uint8_t b; int found = 0; for (uint16_t a = 0x08; a <= 0x77; a++) { if (i2c_read(bus, &b, 1, a) == 0) { printk("[scan] device at 0x%02x
", a); found++; } } printk("[scan] %d device(s) found
", found); } /* i2c_write_read: write the 16 bit register address, restart, read the value */ static void demo_write_read(void) { uint8_t reg[2] = { REG_PRODUCT_ID >> 8, REG_PRODUCT_ID & 0xff }; uint8_t id[4] = { 0 }; int ret; ret = i2c_write_read(bus, ADDR, reg, sizeof(reg), id, sizeof(id)); printk("[write_read] product id register 0x%04x = %s: %02x %02x %02x %02x "%c%c%c"
", REG_PRODUCT_ID, err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2], id[3], id[0], id[1], id[2]); } /* i2c_write: one complete transfer with a stop at the end. Here it sets the register address. */ static void demo_write(void) { uint8_t reg[2] = { REG_CONFIG_VER >> 8, REG_CONFIG_VER & 0xff }; int ret = i2c_write(bus, reg, sizeof(reg), ADDR); printk("[write+read] i2c_write(register address) = %s
", err(ret)); } /* i2c_read: reads the register that the write above selected */ static void demo_read(void) { uint8_t val = 0; int ret = i2c_read(bus, &val, 1, ADDR); printk("[write+read] i2c_read(1 byte) = %s: 0x%02x
", err(ret), val); } /* i2c_burst_read: writes a one byte start address, then reads. The GT967 registers have 16 bit * addresses, so this only shows that the call goes through; use i2c_write_read for this chip. */ static void demo_burst(void) { uint8_t buf[4]; int ret; ret = i2c_burst_read(bus, ADDR, 0x81, buf, sizeof(buf)); printk("[burst] i2c_burst_read(0x81, 4) = %s
", err(ret)); } /* i2c_transfer: the messages by hand, flags decide start, restart and stop */ static void demo_transfer(void) { uint8_t reg[2] = { REG_PRODUCT_ID >> 8, REG_PRODUCT_ID & 0xff }; uint8_t id[4] = { 0 }; struct i2c_msg msgs[2]; int ret; msgs[0].buf = reg; msgs[0].len = sizeof(reg); msgs[0].flags = I2C_MSG_WRITE; /* no stop: the next message restarts */ msgs[1].buf = id; msgs[1].len = sizeof(id); msgs[1].flags = I2C_MSG_READ | I2C_MSG_RESTART | I2C_MSG_STOP; ret = i2c_transfer(bus, msgs, 2, ADDR); printk("[transfer] write + restart + read = %s: "%c%c%c"
", err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); /* a 10 bit address is refused */ msgs[1].flags |= I2C_MSG_ADDR_10_BITS; ret = i2c_transfer(bus, msgs, 2, ADDR); printk("[transfer] 10 bit address = %s
", err(ret)); /* an address above 7 bits */ msgs[1].flags &= ~I2C_MSG_ADDR_10_BITS; ret = i2c_transfer(bus, msgs, 2, 0x100); printk("[transfer] address 0x100 = %s
", err(ret)); } /* a device that is not there does not acknowledge */ static void demo_nack(void) { uint8_t b; int ret; ret = i2c_read(bus, &b, 1, 0x50); printk("[nack] read from 0x50 = %s
", err(ret)); ret = i2c_write(bus, &b, 1, 0x50); printk("[nack] write to 0x50 = %s
", err(ret)); } int main(void) { if (!device_is_ready(bus) || !gpio_is_ready_dt(&rst) || !gpio_is_ready_dt(&irq)) { printk("i2c or gpio not ready
"); return 0; } touch_reset(); demo_configure(); demo_get_config(); demo_scan(); demo_write_read(); demo_write(); demo_read(); demo_burst(); demo_transfer(); demo_nack(); printk("i2c_api done
"); return 0; }
