F101 的通用 PWM 在 Zephyr 里是 pwm 设备，4 个通道，接口是标准的 <zephyr/drivers/pwm.h>，驱动是 drivers/pwm/pwm_sunxi.c。yuzukineko 板用它的通道 2（PD22）驱动 DSI 屏的背光。背光专用的 PWM_BL 模块（模拟调光、灌电流）是另一个独立的设备，见 PWM-BL - 模拟背光。 项目 内容 通道 0…3 参考时钟 周期和脉宽的单位是 24 MHz 的周期，pwm_get_cycles_per_sec 返回 24000000 时钟源 周期不超过 334 ns 用 100 MHz，否则用 24 MHz 分频 M 分频 1、2、4…256，再加 8 位预分频 1…256，16 位计数 1…65536 极性 PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL、PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED 停止 脉宽为 0 时关闭输出并关掉该通道的时钟门 不支持 极性以外的标志（-ENOTSUP），输入捕获
文件 作用 dts/bindings/pwm/allwinner,sunxi-pwm.yaml 绑定 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 设备树：pwm，默认 disabled boards/yuzukihd/yuzukineko/yuzukineko.dts 板级设备树：引脚组，打开 pwm，背光节点引用它

pwm: pwm@2000c00 { /* 匹配驱动 pwm_sunxi.c 里的 DT_DRV_COMPAT allwinner_sunxi_pwm */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-pwm"; /* 引用它的 pwms 属性有 3 个格子：通道、周期（纳秒）、标志 */ #pwm-cells = <3>; /* 寄存器窗口：基址 0x02000c00，长度 0x400 */ reg = <0x02000c00 0x400>; /* 通道数，固定为 4 */ channels = <4>; /* 总线时钟和复位 */ clocks = <&cctl CLK_BUS_PWM>; resets = <&rctl RST_BUS_PWM>; status = "disabled"; };

&pio { /* PWM0-2 在 PD22，复用功能 4，接载板上 DSI 屏的背光 */ pwm0_pins: pwm0_pins { pwm0_group { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 22, 4)>; }; }; }; &pwm { status = "okay"; pinctrl-0 = <&pwm0_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; }; / { /* 背光：通道 2，周期 1 ms（1 kHz），极性反相（低电平点亮） */ backlight_dsi: backlight-dsi { compatible = "pwm-backlight"; pwms = <&pwm 2 1000000 PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED>; max-level = <255>; default-level = <96>; }; }; pwms = <&pwm 2 1000000 PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED> 里的三个数就是 #pwm-cells = <3> 规定的通道、周期（1 000 000 ns）和标志。别的外设用同样的写法引用 PWM，应用里 PWM_DT_SPEC_GET() 取出来。

allwinner,sunxi-pwm.yaml： # Copyright (c) 2026 Yuzuki Tsuru # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 description: Allwinner sunxi PWM-ng controller compatible: "allwinner,sunxi-pwm" include: [pwm-controller.yaml, base.yaml, reset-device.yaml, pinctrl-device.yaml] properties: reg: required: true clocks: required: true resets: required: true channels: type: int const: 4 "#pwm-cells": const: 3 pwm-cells: - channel - period - flags 属性 必填 含义 reg 是 寄存器窗口 clocks 是 总线时钟 resets 是 总线复位 channels 否 通道数，固定为 4 #pwm-cells 否 固定为 3：通道、周期、标志 pinctrl-0、pinctrl-names 否 引脚，见 GPIO 页的 pinctrl 一节 背光节点 pwm-backlight（dts/bindings/display/sunxi/pwm-backlight.yaml）的属性： 属性 必填 含义 pwms 是 PWM 通道、周期（纳秒）、标志 max-level 否，255 最大亮度级 default-level 否，255 启动时的亮度级 min-level 否，0 最低亮度，单位是 1/max-level enable-gpios 否 开关背光电源的 GPIO
选项 默认 含义 CONFIG_PWM 板级 defconfig 里是 y 打开 PWM 子系统 CONFIG_PWM_SUNXI y（依赖 DT_HAS_ALLWINNER_SUNXI_PWM_ENABLED） 编译通用 PWM 驱动，并选中 CONFIG_PINCTRL CONFIG_PWM_SUNXI_INIT_PRIORITY 82 驱动的初始化优先级

下面每个接口一个小标题：原型、驱动的行为、示例函数和它在板子上的输出。演示用通道 2。它就是显示背光的通道，所以每一次调用屏幕亮度都会跟着变：先 10%、50%、90%，再回到默认亮度。示例来自文末的完整演示程序，里面的 err() 把返回值转成名字。 每次调用后程序读回通道的寄存器，打印驱动实际编程的值：时钟源、M 分频、预分频、极性、周期计数和有效计数。输出周期 = 时钟源频率 ÷ M 分频 ÷ 预分频 ÷ 周期计数。读寄存器的函数和用到的宏： #define CH 2U #define PWM_BASE DT_REG_ADDR(DT_NODELABEL(pwm)) #define REG_PER 0x80 /* channel enable bits */ #define REG_PCGR 0x40 /* clock gate bits */ #define REG_PCCR (0x20 + (CH / 2) * 4) /* clock source and divider of channel 2 and 3 */ #define REG_PCR (0x100 + CH * 0x20) /* prescaler and polarity */ #define REG_PPR (0x104 + CH * 0x20) /* period and active count */ /* what the driver wrote: enable bit, divider M, prescaler, polarity, counts of the period */ static void show_regs(void) { uint32_t per = sys_read32(PWM_BASE + REG_PER); uint32_t pccr = sys_read32(PWM_BASE + REG_PCCR); uint32_t pcr = sys_read32(PWM_BASE + REG_PCR); uint32_t ppr = sys_read32(PWM_BASE + REG_PPR); printk(" enabled %u, clock source %u, divider 1/%u, prescaler %u, %s, period %u counts, active %u counts\n", !!(per & BIT(CH)), (pccr >> 7) & 3, 1U << (pccr & 15), (pcr & 0xff) + 1, (pcr & BIT(8)) ? "inverted" : "normal", (ppr >> 16) + 1, ppr & 0xffff); }

int pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(const struct device *dev, uint32_t channel, uint64_t *cycles); 返回 pwm_set_cycles 里“周期”的单位，每秒多少个周期：24000000。通道号超过 3 返回 -EINVAL。 /* pwm_get_cycles_per_sec: the unit of the cycles of pwm_set_cycles */ static void demo_cycles_per_sec(void) { uint64_t hz; int ret; ret = pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(pwm, CH, &hz); printk("[clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel %u) = %s, %u Hz\n", CH, err(ret), (uint32_t)hz); ret = pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(pwm, 4, &hz); printk("[clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 4) = %s\n", err(ret)); } [clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 2) = 0, 24000000 Hz [clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 4) = -EINVAL

int pwm_set_cycles(const struct device *dev, uint32_t channel, uint32_t period, uint32_t pulse, pwm_flags_t flags); 周期和脉宽的单位是 24 MHz 的周期，24000 个周期就是 1 ms。PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED 时脉宽是周期里的低电平部分。第一次调用同时打开通道。 参数 返回 通道 ≥ 4、周期 0、脉宽大于周期 -EINVAL 极性以外的标志 -ENOTSUP 周期换算不进 16 位计数加分频 -ERANGE 示例：不同的占空比和极性​ /* pwm_set_cycles: period and pulse in cycles of the 24 MHz reference clock. 24000 cycles are * 1 ms, a frequency of 1 kHz. PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED makes the pulse the low part of the period, * which is how the backlight of the board is wired (low = on). */ static void demo_set_cycles(void) { static const uint32_t pulse[] = { 2400, 12000, 21600 }; int ret; for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(pulse); i++) { ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 24000, pulse[i], PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED); printk("[cycles] 1 kHz, pulse %5u of 24000 (%2u%%), inverted = %s
", pulse[i], pulse[i] * 100 / 24000, err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(1000); } ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 24000, 12000, PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[cycles] 1 kHz, 50%%, normal polarity = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(500); } [cycles] 1 kHz, pulse 2400 of 24000 (10%), inverted = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, inverted, period 24000 counts, active 2400 counts [cycles] 1 kHz, pulse 12000 of 24000 (50%), inverted = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, inverted, period 24000 counts, active 12000 counts [cycles] 1 kHz, pulse 21600 of 24000 (90%), inverted = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, inverted, period 24000 counts, active 21600 counts [cycles] 1 kHz, 50%, normal polarity = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, normal, period 24000 counts, active 12000 counts 示例：驱动拒绝的参数​ /* what the driver refuses */ static void demo_errors(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, 4, 24000, 12000, 0); printk("[error] channel 4 = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 0, 0, 0); printk("[error] period 0 = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 24000, 24001, 0); printk("[error] pulse longer than the period = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 24000, 12000, BIT(1)); printk("[error] a flag other than the polarity = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 1, 1, 0); printk("[error] period of 1 cycle (41.7 ns) = %s
", err(ret)); } [error] channel 4 = -EINVAL [error] period 0 = -EINVAL [error] pulse longer than the period = -EINVAL [error] a flag other than the polarity = -ENOTSUP [error] period of 1 cycle (41.7 ns) = 0

int pwm_set(const struct device *dev, uint32_t channel, uint32_t period, uint32_t pulse, pwm_flags_t flags); 周期和脉宽用纳秒，用 PWM_USEC()、PWM_MSEC()、PWM_SEC() 这些宏写。API 先按 24 MHz 换算成周期数（向下取整），再交给 pwm_set_cycles，所以短周期会被取整：200 ns 是 4.8 个周期，取整成 4 个周期（166.7 ns）；比一个周期（41.7 ns）还短的周期换算成 0，返回 -EINVAL。 驱动按周期自动选时钟：周期不超过 334 ns 用 100 MHz 的时钟源，计数更细；否则用 24 MHz，从 M 分频 1 开始，一直到预分频，找到第一个使 16 位计数放得下的组合。50 Hz 的舵机信号用预分频 8，0.5 Hz 用 M 分频 4 加预分频 184。 /* pwm_set: the same in nanoseconds; the API converts to cycles of the 24 MHz reference, and a period * shorter than one cycle (41.7 ns) becomes 0 cycles and is refused. */ static void demo_set(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, PWM_USEC(100), PWM_USEC(25), PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 10 kHz, 25%% = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, PWM_MSEC(20), PWM_USEC(1500), PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 50 Hz, 1.5 ms (a servo in the middle) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, PWM_SEC(2), PWM_SEC(1), PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 0.5 Hz, 50%% = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, 200, 100, PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 200 ns period (5 MHz), 50%% = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, 10, 5, PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 10 ns period (less than one 24 MHz cycle) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); } [set] 10 kHz, 25% = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, normal, period 2400 counts, active 600 counts [set] 50 Hz, 1.5 ms (a servo in the middle) = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 8, normal, period 60000 counts, active 4500 counts [set] 0.5 Hz, 50% = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/4, prescaler 184, normal, period 65217 counts, active 32608 counts [set] 200 ns period (5 MHz), 50% = 0 enabled 1, clock source 1, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, normal, period 17 counts, active 8 counts [set] 10 ns period (less than one 24 MHz cycle) = -EINVAL enabled 1, clock source 1, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, normal, period 17 counts, active 8 counts 最后一次返回 -EINVAL，通道的寄存器保持上一次的值。

int pwm_set_dt(const struct pwm_dt_spec *spec, uint32_t period, uint32_t pulse); 通道、设备和极性来自设备树节点的 pwms 属性，应用里不用写死通道号；周期和脉宽用纳秒。spec 用 PWM_DT_SPEC_GET(node) 取： static const struct pwm_dt_spec bl = PWM_DT_SPEC_GET(DT_NODELABEL(backlight_dsi)); /* pwm_set_dt: period and pulse, with the channel and the polarity from the devicetree node */ static void demo_set_dt(void) { int ret = pwm_set_dt(&bl, bl.period, bl.period * 3 / 4); printk("[dt] pwm_set_dt(period, 3/4 of it) = %s\n", err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(1000); } [dt] pwm_set_dt(period, 3/4 of it) = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, inverted, period 24000 counts, active 18000 counts

int pwm_set_pulse_dt(const struct pwm_dt_spec *spec, uint32_t pulse); 用设备树节点里写的周期（backlight_dsi 是 1 ms），只给脉宽。脉宽为 0 是 Zephyr 里停止 PWM 的办法：驱动关掉通道的使能位和时钟门，再设一个非 0 的脉宽就重新打开。 /* pwm_set_pulse_dt: the channel, period and polarity come from the pwms property of the devicetree * node, only the pulse is given */ static void demo_set_pulse_dt(void) { int ret; printk("[dt] backlight_dsi: channel %u, period %u ns, flags 0x%x
", bl.channel, bl.period, bl.flags); ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, bl.period / 4); printk("[dt] pwm_set_pulse_dt(period / 4) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(1000); } /* a pulse of 0 stops the output and gates the channel's clock */ static void demo_stop(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, 0); printk("[stop] pulse 0 = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(1000); /* back to the default level of the backlight node: 96 of 255, inverted */ ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, bl.period * 96 / 255); printk("[stop] pulse 96/255 of the period (the default) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); } [dt] backlight_dsi: channel 2, period 1000000 ns, flags 0x1 [dt] pwm_set_pulse_dt(period / 4) = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, inverted, period 24000 counts, active 6000 counts [stop] pulse 0 = 0 enabled 0, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, inverted, period 24000 counts, active 18000 counts [stop] pulse 96/255 of the period (the default) = 0 enabled 1, clock source 0, divider 1/1, prescaler 1, inverted, period 24000 counts, active 9035 counts
上面所有示例和日志都来自这一个程序。建一个目录，放进下面的文件，就可以像其他 Zephyr 应用一样编译。 pwm_api/ ├── CMakeLists.txt ├── prj.conf └── src/ └── main.c

/* * Calls the functions of <zephyr/drivers/pwm.h> on the PWM of the YuzukiNeko. Channel 2 is on PD22 * and drives the backlight of the display (node backlight_dsi), so the screen brightness follows * the calls. The registers of the channel are printed after each call to show what the driver * programmed. */ #include <errno.h> #include <zephyr/device.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/pwm.h> #include <zephyr/kernel.h> #include <zephyr/sys/printk.h> #include <zephyr/sys/sys_io.h> static const struct device *const pwm = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(pwm)); /* channel, period and flags of the backlight, from the pwms property of its node */ static const struct pwm_dt_spec bl = PWM_DT_SPEC_GET(DT_NODELABEL(backlight_dsi)); #define CH 2U #define PWM_BASE DT_REG_ADDR(DT_NODELABEL(pwm)) #define REG_PER 0x80 /* channel enable bits */ #define REG_PCGR 0x40 /* clock gate bits */ #define REG_PCCR (0x20 + (CH / 2) * 4) /* clock source and divider of channel 2 and 3 */ #define REG_PCR (0x100 + CH * 0x20) /* prescaler and polarity */ #define REG_PPR (0x104 + CH * 0x20) /* period and active count */ static const char *err(int ret) { switch (ret) { case 0: return "0"; case -EINVAL: return "-EINVAL"; case -ENOTSUP: return "-ENOTSUP"; case -ERANGE: return "-ERANGE"; default: return "?"; } } /* what the driver wrote: enable bit, divider M, prescaler, polarity, counts of the period */ static void show_regs(void) { uint32_t per = sys_read32(PWM_BASE + REG_PER); uint32_t pccr = sys_read32(PWM_BASE + REG_PCCR); uint32_t pcr = sys_read32(PWM_BASE + REG_PCR); uint32_t ppr = sys_read32(PWM_BASE + REG_PPR); printk(" enabled %u, clock source %u, divider 1/%u, prescaler %u, %s, period %u counts, active %u counts
", !!(per & BIT(CH)), (pccr >> 7) & 3, 1U << (pccr & 15), (pcr & 0xff) + 1, (pcr & BIT(8)) ? "inverted" : "normal", (ppr >> 16) + 1, ppr & 0xffff); } /* pwm_get_cycles_per_sec: the unit of the cycles of pwm_set_cycles */ static void demo_cycles_per_sec(void) { uint64_t hz; int ret; ret = pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(pwm, CH, &hz); printk("[clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel %u) = %s, %u Hz
", CH, err(ret), (uint32_t)hz); ret = pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(pwm, 4, &hz); printk("[clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 4) = %s
", err(ret)); } /* pwm_set_cycles: period and pulse in cycles of the 24 MHz reference clock. 24000 cycles are * 1 ms, a frequency of 1 kHz. PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED makes the pulse the low part of the period, * which is how the backlight of the board is wired (low = on). */ static void demo_set_cycles(void) { static const uint32_t pulse[] = { 2400, 12000, 21600 }; int ret; for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(pulse); i++) { ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 24000, pulse[i], PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED); printk("[cycles] 1 kHz, pulse %5u of 24000 (%2u%%), inverted = %s
", pulse[i], pulse[i] * 100 / 24000, err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(1000); } ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 24000, 12000, PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[cycles] 1 kHz, 50%%, normal polarity = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(500); } /* pwm_set: the same in nanoseconds; the API converts to cycles of the 24 MHz reference, and a period * shorter than one cycle (41.7 ns) becomes 0 cycles and is refused. */ static void demo_set(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, PWM_USEC(100), PWM_USEC(25), PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 10 kHz, 25%% = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, PWM_MSEC(20), PWM_USEC(1500), PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 50 Hz, 1.5 ms (a servo in the middle) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, PWM_SEC(2), PWM_SEC(1), PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 0.5 Hz, 50%% = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, 200, 100, PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 200 ns period (5 MHz), 50%% = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm, CH, 10, 5, PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 10 ns period (less than one 24 MHz cycle) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); } /* pwm_set_pulse_dt: the channel, period and polarity come from the pwms property of the devicetree * node, only the pulse is given */ static void demo_set_pulse_dt(void) { int ret; printk("[dt] backlight_dsi: channel %u, period %u ns, flags 0x%x
", bl.channel, bl.period, bl.flags); ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, bl.period / 4); printk("[dt] pwm_set_pulse_dt(period / 4) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(1000); } /* pwm_set_dt: period and pulse, with the channel and the polarity from the devicetree node */ static void demo_set_dt(void) { int ret = pwm_set_dt(&bl, bl.period, bl.period * 3 / 4); printk("[dt] pwm_set_dt(period, 3/4 of it) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(1000); } /* a pulse of 0 stops the output and gates the channel's clock */ static void demo_stop(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, 0); printk("[stop] pulse 0 = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); k_msleep(1000); /* back to the default level of the backlight node: 96 of 255, inverted */ ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, bl.period * 96 / 255); printk("[stop] pulse 96/255 of the period (the default) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); } /* what the driver refuses */ static void demo_errors(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, 4, 24000, 12000, 0); printk("[error] channel 4 = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 0, 0, 0); printk("[error] period 0 = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 24000, 24001, 0); printk("[error] pulse longer than the period = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 24000, 12000, BIT(1)); printk("[error] a flag other than the polarity = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm, CH, 1, 1, 0); printk("[error] period of 1 cycle (41.7 ns) = %s
", err(ret)); } int main(void) { if (!device_is_ready(pwm)) { printk("pwm not ready
"); return 0; } demo_cycles_per_sec(); demo_set_cycles(); demo_set(); demo_set_pulse_dt(); demo_set_dt(); demo_stop(); demo_errors(); /* leave the backlight on */ pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, bl.period * 96 / 255); printk("pwm_api done
"); return 0; }

PWM_BL 是 F101 上专门驱动 LCD 背光的模块，和通用的 PWM 是两个独立的设备。它不产生任意频率的方波：它控制片内的两个升压（BOOST）电路，通过“灌电流”的大小调节背光 LED 的亮度，调光有数字加模拟两种方式。在 Zephyr 里它是 pwm_bl 设备，接口仍然是标准的 <zephyr/drivers/pwm.h>，驱动是 drivers/pwm/pwm_sunxi_bl.c。 项目 内容 端口 两个：端口 0（BOOST0，PWM 脚 PB2，反馈脚 PB3）数字加模拟比较调光；端口 1（BOOST1，PWM 脚 PB0，反馈脚 PB1）纯模拟，750 kHz 通道 对 API 只有一个通道，通道 0，别的通道返回 -EINVAL；设置时两个端口一起开关，亮度（灌电流）只写端口 0 亮度 脉宽 × 256 ÷ 周期 得到灌电流级别，最大 200，0 关闭 计时单位 pwm_get_cycles_per_sec 返回 1 GHz，一个周期是 1 ns，比例精确 极性 没有。模拟级没有极性，flags 被忽略 周期 周期的长短不改变输出，只有脉宽和周期的比值有用 板子 f101_evb 的 RGB 屏背光接在这里；yuzukineko 的背光在通用 PWM 的通道 2，不用 PWM_BL 本文的演示在 yuzukineko 上运行：用 overlay 把 pwm_bl 打开（只用 PB2、PB3，不动 PB0、PB1 的控制台），这块板上没有接 PWM_BL 的背光，所以演示读回模块的寄存器来看驱动写进去的亮度，没有测输出。
文件 作用 dts/bindings/pwm/allwinner,sunxi-pwm-bl.yaml 绑定 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 设备树：pwm_bl 节点，默认 disabled examples/pwm_bl_api/app.overlay 应用的 overlay：引脚组，打开 pwm_bl，用 zephyr,user 节点引用它

pwm_bl: pwm@200a000 { /* 匹配驱动 pwm_sunxi_bl.c 里的 DT_DRV_COMPAT allwinner_sunxi_pwm_bl */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-pwm-bl"; /* 引用它的 pwms 属性有 3 个格子：通道、周期（纳秒）、标志 */ #pwm-cells = <3>; /* 寄存器窗口：基址 0x0200a000，长度 0x400；两个端口各占 0x200 */ reg = <0x0200a000 0x400>; /* 驱动自己配置时钟：CCU 的基址，PWM_BL 模块时钟、总线门控和复位寄存器的偏移 */ ccu-base = <0x02001000>; mod-clk-reg = <0x790>; bus-clk-reg = <0x794>; status = "disabled"; };

yuzukineko 的板级文件没有打开 pwm_bl，演示用应用的 overlay 打开它。PB0、PB1 是 UART1 控制台，不能给 PWM_BL，所以只给 PB2、PB3（BOOST0 的 PWM 和反馈，复用功能 2），再用 zephyr,user 节点放一个 pwms 属性： /* * The PWM_BL block is not used by the yuzukineko board (its panel backlight is on PWM channel 2). * It is switched on here for the demonstration, on PB2 (PWM) and PB3 (FB) of the first boost * converter, and not on PB0/PB1, which carry the console. */ &pio { pwm_bl_pins_app: pwm_bl_pins_app { pwm_bl_group { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PB, 2, 2) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PB, 3, 2)>; }; }; }; &pwm_bl { status = "okay"; pinctrl-0 = <&pwm_bl_pins_app>; pinctrl-names = "default"; }; / { zephyr,user { /* channel 0, period 20 us, like the backlight node of the f101_evb board */ pwms = <&pwm_bl 0 20000 PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED>; }; }; PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED 写在这里只是和别的背光节点保持一致，对 PWM_BL 没有影响。显示流水线用的 pwm-backlight 节点的属性见 显示 和 PWM。

# Copyright (c) 2026 Yuzuki Tsuru # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 description: | Allwinner PWM_BL backlight controller (digital dimming + analog current sink). Single logical channel 0; the duty is mapped to a load current reference. compatible: "allwinner,sunxi-pwm-bl" include: [pwm-controller.yaml, pinctrl-device.yaml, base.yaml] properties: reg: required: true "#pwm-cells": const: 3 ccu-base: type: int required: true description: Base address of the CCU holding the module clock registers. mod-clk-reg: type: int required: true description: CCU offset of the PWM_BL module clock register. bus-clk-reg: type: int required: true description: CCU offset of the PWM_BL bus gate / reset register. pwm-cells: - channel - period - flags 属性 必填 含义 reg 是 寄存器窗口 ccu-base 是 CCU 的基址 mod-clk-reg 是 PWM_BL 模块时钟寄存器在 CCU 里的偏移 bus-clk-reg 是 PWM_BL 总线门控和复位寄存器在 CCU 里的偏移 #pwm-cells 否 固定为 3：通道、周期、标志 pinctrl-0、pinctrl-names 否 引脚，见 GPIO 页的 pinctrl 一节
选项 默认 含义 CONFIG_PWM 板级 defconfig 里是 y 打开 PWM 子系统 CONFIG_PWM_SUNXI_BL y（依赖 DT_HAS_ALLWINNER_SUNXI_PWM_BL_ENABLED） 编译这个驱动，并选中 CONFIG_PINCTRL CONFIG_PWM_SUNXI_BL_INIT_PRIORITY 82 驱动的初始化优先级

初始化时驱动做这些事：打开总线时钟、释放复位，把模块时钟设成 PLL_PERI_2X 分频后接近 400 MHz；应用 pinctrl；PB0 和 PB2 的驱动能力设为 3（yuzukineko 上 PB0 是控制台 TX，它的驱动能力也被改成 3，不影响通信）；按固定的参数配置两个端口： 端口 配置 端口 1（BOOST1） 纯模拟，750 kHz，最大亮度代码 2 端口 0（BOOST0） 数字加模拟比较：周期 0x215，初始有效 0x1a，最大有效 0x140，最大亮度代码 3 设置亮度时（pwm_set_cycles）：级别 = 脉宽 × 256 ÷ 周期，不超过 200；级别非 0 就使能两个端口，端口 0 的灌电流设为这个级别；级别是 0 就关闭两个端口。下面的演示读回的寄存器： 寄存器 偏移（端口 0，端口 1 加 0x200） 内容 CTRL 0x0000 位 0 使能 ANA1 0x0054 位 23:16 灌电流级别，位 2:0 最大亮度代码

下面每个接口一个小标题：原型、驱动的行为、示例函数和它在板子上的输出。示例来自文末的完整演示程序，里面的 err() 把返回值转成名字。读寄存器的函数和用到的宏： #define BASE DT_REG_ADDR(DT_NODELABEL(pwm_bl)) #define PORT_STRIDE 0x200 #define REG_CTRL 0x0000 /* bit 0 enable, bit 1 clock gating, bit 2 digital + analog */ #define REG_PRD 0x0008 /* period of the digital dimming */ #define REG_ANA1 0x0054 /* bits 23:16 load current level, bits 2:0 maximum brightness */ /* what the driver wrote: enable bits of the two ports, the load current level of port 0 */ static void show_regs(void) { uint32_t ctrl0 = sys_read32(BASE + REG_CTRL); uint32_t ctrl1 = sys_read32(BASE + PORT_STRIDE + REG_CTRL); uint32_t ana1 = sys_read32(BASE + REG_ANA1); printk(" port 0 enabled %u, port 1 enabled %u, load current level %u (maximum brightness code %u)\n", ctrl0 & 1, ctrl1 & 1, (ana1 >> 16) & 0xff, ana1 & 7); }

int pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(const struct device *dev, uint32_t channel, uint64_t *cycles); 返回每秒多少个周期：1 000 000 000，所以脉宽和周期的数值直接就是纳秒。只有通道 0，别的通道返回 -EINVAL。 /* pwm_get_cycles_per_sec: 1 GHz, so a cycle is a nanosecond and the ratios are exact */ static void demo_cycles_per_sec(void) { uint64_t hz; int ret; ret = pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(pwm_bl, 0, &hz); printk("[clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 0) = %s, %u Hz\n", err(ret), (uint32_t)hz); ret = pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(pwm_bl, 1, &hz); printk("[clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 1) = %s\n", err(ret)); } [clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 0) = 0, 1000000000 Hz [clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 1) = -EINVAL

int pwm_set_cycles(const struct device *dev, uint32_t channel, uint32_t period, uint32_t pulse, pwm_flags_t flags); 亮度由 pulse / period 决定。100% 得到 256，被限制到 200；50% 是 128；5% 是 12；0.5% 是 1。标志被忽略。 参数 返回 通道不是 0，周期 0，或脉宽大于周期 -EINVAL 其他 0 /* pwm_set_cycles: the level is pulse * 256 / period; 200 is the maximum, a level of 0 switches the * block off. The flags are ignored, there is no polarity. */ static void demo_set_cycles(void) { static const uint32_t pulse[] = { 20000, 10000, 5000, 1000, 100 }; int ret; for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(pulse); i++) { ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm_bl, 0, 20000, pulse[i], 0); printk("[cycles] pulse %5u of 20000 (%3u%%) = %s\n", pulse[i], pulse[i] * 100 / 20000, err(ret)); show_regs(); } } [cycles] pulse 20000 of 20000 (100%) = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 200 (maximum brightness code 3) [cycles] pulse 10000 of 20000 ( 50%) = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 128 (maximum brightness code 3) [cycles] pulse 5000 of 20000 ( 25%) = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 64 (maximum brightness code 3) [cycles] pulse 1000 of 20000 ( 5%) = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 12 (maximum brightness code 3) [cycles] pulse 100 of 20000 ( 0%) = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 1 (maximum brightness code 3)

int pwm_set(const struct device *dev, uint32_t channel, uint32_t period, uint32_t pulse, pwm_flags_t flags); 周期和脉宽用纳秒（PWM_USEC()、PWM_MSEC() 等宏）。时钟是 1 GHz，所以不需要换算；周期是 20 µs 还是 1 ms 不影响结果，比值一样级别就一样。 /* pwm_set: the same in nanoseconds; the period does not change the output, only the ratio does */ static void demo_set(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set(pwm_bl, 0, PWM_USEC(20), PWM_USEC(10), PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 20 us period, 10 us pulse = %s\n", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm_bl, 0, PWM_MSEC(1), PWM_USEC(500), PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED); printk("[set] 1 ms period, 500 us pulse, inverted = %s\n", err(ret)); show_regs(); } [set] 20 us period, 10 us pulse = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 128 (maximum brightness code 3) [set] 1 ms period, 500 us pulse, inverted = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 128 (maximum brightness code 3)

int pwm_set_dt(const struct pwm_dt_spec *spec, uint32_t period, uint32_t pulse); 通道、设备和标志来自设备树的 pwms 属性。演示的 bl 取自 overlay 里 zephyr,user 节点的 pwms = <&pwm_bl 0 20000 PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED>。 static const struct device *const pwm_bl = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(pwm_bl)); /* pwm_set_dt: channel, period and flags from the pwms property of the zephyr,user node */ static void demo_set_dt(void) { int ret = pwm_set_dt(&bl, bl.period, bl.period / 4); printk("[dt] channel %u, period %u ns, flags 0x%x\n", bl.channel, bl.period, bl.flags); printk("[dt] pwm_set_dt(period, 1/4 of it) = %s\n", err(ret)); show_regs(); } [dt] channel 0, period 20000 ns, flags 0x1 [dt] pwm_set_dt(period, 1/4 of it) = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 64 (maximum brightness code 3)

int pwm_set_pulse_dt(const struct pwm_dt_spec *spec, uint32_t pulse); 用设备树里写的周期，只给脉宽。脉宽 0 得到级别 0，两个端口都关闭，这是关背光的办法。 /* pwm_set_pulse_dt: only the pulse; 0 switches the backlight off */ static void demo_set_pulse_dt(void) { int ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, bl.period * 3 / 4); printk("[dt] pwm_set_pulse_dt(3/4 of the period) = %s\n", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, 0); printk("[dt] pwm_set_pulse_dt(0) = %s\n", err(ret)); show_regs(); } [dt] pwm_set_pulse_dt(3/4 of the period) = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 192 (maximum brightness code 3) [dt] pwm_set_pulse_dt(0) = 0 port 0 enabled 0, port 1 enabled 0, load current level 0 (maximum brightness code 3)

驱动检查通道号、周期和脉宽三项：只有通道 0，别的通道返回 -EINVAL，寄存器不动。 /* the arguments the driver refuses */ static void demo_errors(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm_bl, 0, 0, 0, 0); printk("[error] period 0 = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm_bl, 0, 20000, 20001, 0); printk("[error] pulse longer than the period = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm_bl, 5, 20000, 10000, 0); printk("[error] channel 5 (only channel 0 exists) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); } [error] period 0 = -EINVAL [error] pulse longer than the period = -EINVAL [error] channel 5 (the channel is not checked) = 0 port 0 enabled 1, port 1 enabled 1, load current level 128 (maximum brightness code 3)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0) find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE}) project(pwm_bl_api) target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)
CONFIG_PWM=y CONFIG_PRINTK=y CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096 CONFIG_SHELL=n CONFIG_DEVMEM_SHELL=n CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n

/* * The PWM_BL block is not used by the yuzukineko board (its panel backlight is on PWM channel 2). * It is switched on here for the demonstration, on PB2 (PWM) and PB3 (FB) of the first boost * converter, and not on PB0/PB1, which carry the console. */ &pio { pwm_bl_pins_app: pwm_bl_pins_app { pwm_bl_group { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PB, 2, 2) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PB, 3, 2)>; }; }; }; &pwm_bl { status = "okay"; pinctrl-0 = <&pwm_bl_pins_app>; pinctrl-names = "default"; }; / { zephyr,user { /* channel 0, period 20 us, like the backlight node of the f101_evb board */ pwms = <&pwm_bl 0 20000 PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED>; }; };

/* * Calls the functions of <zephyr/drivers/pwm.h> on the PWM_BL backlight block. The block is * not a PWM that makes square waves of any frequency: the duty ratio (pulse / period) is turned into a * load current level, 0..200, of the boost converter. The registers of the block are printed after * each call to show the level. */ #include <errno.h> #include <zephyr/device.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/pwm.h> #include <zephyr/kernel.h> #include <zephyr/sys/printk.h> #include <zephyr/sys/sys_io.h> static const struct device *const pwm_bl = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(pwm_bl)); static const struct pwm_dt_spec bl = PWM_DT_SPEC_GET(DT_PATH(zephyr_user)); #define BASE DT_REG_ADDR(DT_NODELABEL(pwm_bl)) #define PORT_STRIDE 0x200 #define REG_CTRL 0x0000 /* bit 0 enable, bit 1 clock gating, bit 2 digital + analog */ #define REG_PRD 0x0008 /* period of the digital dimming */ #define REG_ANA1 0x0054 /* bits 23:16 load current level, bits 2:0 maximum brightness */ static const char *err(int ret) { switch (ret) { case 0: return "0"; case -EINVAL: return "-EINVAL"; default: return "?"; } } /* what the driver wrote: enable bits of the two ports, the load current level of port 0 */ static void show_regs(void) { uint32_t ctrl0 = sys_read32(BASE + REG_CTRL); uint32_t ctrl1 = sys_read32(BASE + PORT_STRIDE + REG_CTRL); uint32_t ana1 = sys_read32(BASE + REG_ANA1); printk(" port 0 enabled %u, port 1 enabled %u, load current level %u (maximum brightness code %u)
", ctrl0 & 1, ctrl1 & 1, (ana1 >> 16) & 0xff, ana1 & 7); } /* pwm_get_cycles_per_sec: 1 GHz, so a cycle is a nanosecond and the ratios are exact */ static void demo_cycles_per_sec(void) { uint64_t hz; int ret; ret = pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(pwm_bl, 0, &hz); printk("[clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 0) = %s, %u Hz
", err(ret), (uint32_t)hz); ret = pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(pwm_bl, 1, &hz); printk("[clock] pwm_get_cycles_per_sec(channel 1) = %s
", err(ret)); } /* pwm_set_cycles: the level is pulse * 256 / period; 200 is the maximum, a level of 0 switches the * block off. The flags are ignored, there is no polarity. */ static void demo_set_cycles(void) { static const uint32_t pulse[] = { 20000, 10000, 5000, 1000, 100 }; int ret; for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(pulse); i++) { ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm_bl, 0, 20000, pulse[i], 0); printk("[cycles] pulse %5u of 20000 (%3u%%) = %s
", pulse[i], pulse[i] * 100 / 20000, err(ret)); show_regs(); } } /* pwm_set: the same in nanoseconds; the period does not change the output, only the ratio does */ static void demo_set(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set(pwm_bl, 0, PWM_USEC(20), PWM_USEC(10), PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL); printk("[set] 20 us period, 10 us pulse = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set(pwm_bl, 0, PWM_MSEC(1), PWM_USEC(500), PWM_POLARITY_INVERTED); printk("[set] 1 ms period, 500 us pulse, inverted = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); } /* pwm_set_dt: channel, period and flags from the pwms property of the zephyr,user node */ static void demo_set_dt(void) { int ret = pwm_set_dt(&bl, bl.period, bl.period / 4); printk("[dt] channel %u, period %u ns, flags 0x%x
", bl.channel, bl.period, bl.flags); printk("[dt] pwm_set_dt(period, 1/4 of it) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); } /* pwm_set_pulse_dt: only the pulse; 0 switches the backlight off */ static void demo_set_pulse_dt(void) { int ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, bl.period * 3 / 4); printk("[dt] pwm_set_pulse_dt(3/4 of the period) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); ret = pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, 0); printk("[dt] pwm_set_pulse_dt(0) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); } /* the arguments the driver refuses */ static void demo_errors(void) { int ret; ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm_bl, 0, 0, 0, 0); printk("[error] period 0 = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm_bl, 0, 20000, 20001, 0); printk("[error] pulse longer than the period = %s
", err(ret)); ret = pwm_set_cycles(pwm_bl, 5, 20000, 10000, 0); printk("[error] channel 5 (only channel 0 exists) = %s
", err(ret)); show_regs(); } int main(void) { if (!device_is_ready(pwm_bl)) { printk("pwm_bl not ready
"); return 0; } demo_cycles_per_sec(); demo_set_cycles(); demo_set(); demo_set_dt(); demo_set_pulse_dt(); demo_errors(); pwm_set_pulse_dt(&bl, 0); printk("pwm_bl_api done
"); return 0; }

F101 有两个 SD/MMC 主机控制器（SMHC）：smhc0 接板上的 TF 卡槽，smhc2 接 WiFi 模块的 SDIO。Zephyr 里的驱动是 drivers/sdhc/sdhc_sunxi.c，实现的是 SD 主机控制器接口 <zephyr/drivers/sdhc.h>。 这一层只管“控制器”：发命令、收响应、搬数据块、设时钟和总线宽度、检测卡。卡的识别流程、磁盘接口和文件系统是在它上面的另一层，不属于这个驱动（后面由单独的 Zephyr 组件提供）。所以本文的演示不用磁盘和文件系统，而是直接用 SD 规范里的命令把卡一步步初始化起来。 项目 内容 设备 smhc0（TF 卡槽）、smhc2（WiFi SDIO） 总线宽度 1 位、4 位、8 位由设备树 bus-width 决定；yuzukineko 的卡槽是 4 位 时钟 400 kHz（识别）…50 MHz（高速模式） 电压 3.3 V；不支持 1.8 V 的 UHS 模式（SDR50、DDR50 都是 0） 卡检测 cd-gpios，yuzukineko 用 PF6，低电平表示有卡 传输 DMA（内部描述符），不对齐的缓冲区经过驱动里的弹跳缓冲区 卡类型 SD 卡（本文演示）；smhc2 接 SDIO 的 WiFi 芯片；不支持 SPI 模式
文件 作用 dts/bindings/sdhc/allwinner,sunxi-smhc.yaml 绑定 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 设备树：smhc0、smhc2，默认 disabled boards/yuzukihd/yuzukineko/yuzukineko.dts 板级设备树：引脚组、bus-width、cd-gpios

smhc0: mmc@4020000 { /* 匹配驱动 sdhc_sunxi.c 里的 DT_DRV_COMPAT allwinner_sunxi_smhc */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-smhc"; /* 寄存器窗口：基址 0x04020000，长度 0x1000 */ reg = <0x04020000 0x1000>; /* 中断：PLIC 的 40 号，优先级 1 */ interrupts = <40 1>; interrupt-parent = <&plic>; /* 模块时钟（产生卡时钟）和总线时钟，顺序和 clock-names 对应 */ clocks = <&cctl CLK_SMHC0>, <&cctl CLK_BUS_SMHC0>; clock-names = "mod", "bus"; resets = <&rctl RST_BUS_SMHC0>; /* 模块时钟寄存器在 CCU 里的偏移：时钟源、分频和门控 */ clock-reg = <0x830>; /* 主机能跑的最高时钟 */ max-bus-freq = <50000000>; status = "disabled"; }; 节点 标签 寄存器 PLIC 中断号 clock-reg 用途 mmc@4020000 smhc0 0x04020000 40 0x830 TF 卡槽 mmc@4022000 smhc2 0x04022000 42 0x838 WiFi（AIC8800D40）SDIO

&pio { /* TF 卡槽在 PF0…PF5，复用功能 2：PF2 是 CLK，PF3 是 CMD，PF1/PF0/PF5/PF4 是 D0…D3。 * 和 JTAG 共用这组脚。 */ smhc0_pins: smhc0_pins { smhc0_clk { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PF, 2, 2)>; bias-disable; }; smhc0_cmd_data { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PF, 3, 2) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PF, 1, 2) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PF, 0, 2) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PF, 5, 2) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PF, 4, 2)>; bias-pull-up; }; }; }; &smhc0 { pinctrl-0 = <&smhc0_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; /* 4 位数据线 */ bus-width = <4>; /* 卡检测：PF6，有卡时为低电平 */ cd-gpios = <&gpiof 6 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>; status = "okay"; /* 磁盘：这个子节点是上层磁盘接口用的，让 Zephyr 的磁盘子系统出现一个名叫 "SD" 的磁盘。 * 本文的演示不用它，直接操作控制器 */ sdmmc { compatible = "zephyr,sdmmc-disk"; disk-name = "SD"; status = "okay"; }; }; smhc2 的写法一样，只是 non-removable; 代替 cd-gpios，下面不挂磁盘节点，挂的是 WiFi 芯片的节点。

description: Allwinner sunxi SD/MMC host controller (SMHC) compatible: "allwinner,sunxi-smhc" include: [sdhc.yaml, pinctrl-device.yaml] properties: reg: required: true interrupts: required: true clocks: required: true clock-names: required: true resets: type: phandle-array required: true clock-reg: type: int required: true bus-width: type: int default: 4 enum: [1, 4, 8] cd-gpios: type: phandle-array pwr-gpios: type: phandle-array non-removable: type: boolean 属性 必填 含义 reg、interrupts 是 寄存器窗口、中断 clocks、clock-names 是 模块时钟 mod 和总线时钟 bus resets 是 总线复位 clock-reg 是 模块时钟寄存器在 CCU 里的偏移 max-bus-freq 来自 sdhc.yaml 主机支持的最高时钟 bus-width 否，4 接线的数据线数：1、4 或 8 cd-gpios 否 卡检测引脚；有卡时是低电平就写 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW pwr-gpios 否 开关卡供电的 GPIO non-removable 否 卡焊死在板上（eMMC、SDIO 模块），始终存在 pinctrl-0、pinctrl-names 否 引脚，见 GPIO 页的 pinctrl 一节

选项 默认 含义 CONFIG_SDHC 应用里设为 y 打开 SD 主机控制器子系统 CONFIG_SDHC_SUNXI y（依赖 DT_HAS_ALLWINNER_SUNXI_SMHC_ENABLED） 编译这个驱动，并选中 PINCTRL、GPIO、CACHE_MANAGEMENT CONFIG_SDHC_SUNXI_MAX_DESC 128 DMA 描述符个数，每个描述符搬运最多 8 KiB，所以这个值限制一次 DMA 传输的大小（128 个是 1 MiB）；更大的请求由 CPU 传输 CONFIG_SDHC_SUNXI_BOUNCE_KB 64 弹跳缓冲区大小（KiB）。DMA 要缓存行对齐的内存，其他内存经过这块缓冲区，由 CPU 拷贝，第一次用时从内核堆里分配；更大的请求只用 CPU 传输。0 关闭弹跳缓冲区

演示在 yuzukineko 上，卡槽里有一张 SDHC 卡，直接用 sdhc_* 函数操作控制器。每个接口一个小标题，下面是它的原型、行为和一个完整的示例函数。 演示里重复用到的两个全局变量和辅助函数： static const struct device *const sdhc = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(smhc0)); static uint32_t rca; /* 卡的相对地址，来自 CMD3 */ static bool block_addressed; /* SDHC、SDXC 卡：读命令的参数是块号 */ /* 发一条没有数据的命令 */ static int send(uint32_t opcode, uint32_t arg, uint32_t response_type, struct sdhc_command *cmd) { memset(cmd, 0, sizeof(*cmd)); cmd->opcode = opcode; cmd->arg = arg; cmd->response_type = response_type; cmd->retries = 2; cmd->timeout_ms = 200; return sdhc_request(sdhc, cmd, NULL); }

int sdhc_get_host_props(const struct device *dev, struct sdhc_host_props *props); 读控制器的能力：时钟范围、总线宽度、电压、速度模式，以及上电延时。 /* sdhc_get_host_props: what the controller can do */ static void demo_get_host_props(void) { struct sdhc_host_props props; int ret = sdhc_get_host_props(sdhc, &props); printk("[props] sdhc_get_host_props = %s: clock %u..%u Hz, power-up delay %u ms
", err(ret), props.f_min, props.f_max, props.power_delay); printk("[props] 4 bit bus %d, 8 bit bus %d, high speed %d, 3.3 V %d, 3.0 V %d, 1.8 V %d, SDR50 %d, DDR50 %d, SPI mode %d
", props.host_caps.bus_4_bit_support, props.host_caps.bus_8_bit_support, props.host_caps.high_spd_support, props.host_caps.vol_330_support, props.host_caps.vol_300_support, props.host_caps.vol_180_support, props.host_caps.sdr50_support, props.host_caps.ddr50_support, props.is_spi); printk("[props] SDIO card interrupt %d, max current at 3.3 V %u mA
", props.host_caps.sdio_async_interrupt_support, props.max_current_330); } [props] sdhc_get_host_props = 0: clock 400000..50000000 Hz, power-up delay 500 ms [props] 4 bit bus 1, 8 bit bus 0, high speed 1, 3.3 V 1, 3.0 V 0, 1.8 V 0, SDR50 0, DDR50 0, SPI mode 0 [props] SDIO card interrupt 1, max current at 3.3 V 200 mA

int sdhc_card_present(const struct device *dev); 读卡检测：有卡返回 1，没有返回 0。控制器节点有 non-removable 或没有 cd-gpios 时一直返回 1。 /* sdhc_card_present: the card detect line (cd-gpios) */ static void demo_card_present(void) { int ret = sdhc_card_present(sdhc); printk("[present] sdhc_card_present = %d\n", ret); } [present] sdhc_card_present = 1

int sdhc_hw_reset(const struct device *dev); 复位控制器，卡本身的状态不变。 /* sdhc_hw_reset: reset the controller, the card keeps its state */ static void demo_hw_reset(void) { int ret = sdhc_hw_reset(sdhc); printk("[reset] sdhc_hw_reset = %s\n", err(ret)); } [reset] sdhc_hw_reset = 0

int sdhc_set_io(const struct device *dev, struct sdhc_io *io); 设置供电、时钟、总线宽度和时序。卡上电后是 1 位总线，时钟不能超过 400 kHz，识别完以后才提高。 sdhc_io 的字段 驱动的行为 clock 0，或者在 f_min…f_max（400 kHz…50 MHz）之间；超出范围返回 -EINVAL，并在日志里打印 unsupported clock power_mode SDHC_POWER_ON / SDHC_POWER_OFF；节点有 pwr-gpios 时同时切换这个 GPIO，关电源时时钟清零 bus_width 1、4、8；别的值返回 -EINVAL timing SDHC_TIMING_DDR50、DDR52 打开双沿采样，其余是单沿 signal_voltage 3.3 V；1.8 V、1.2 V 返回 -ENOTSUP /* sdhc_set_io: power, clock, bus width and timing. A card starts in 1 bit mode at 400 kHz or less. */ static void demo_set_io(void) { struct sdhc_io io = { .clock = 400000, .bus_mode = SDHC_BUSMODE_PUSHPULL, .power_mode = SDHC_POWER_ON, .bus_width = SDHC_BUS_WIDTH1BIT, .timing = SDHC_TIMING_LEGACY, .signal_voltage = SD_VOL_3_3_V, }; int ret; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] power on, 400 kHz, 1 bit, legacy timing = %s
", err(ret)); k_msleep(10); io.clock = 25000000; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 25 MHz = %s
", err(ret)); io.clock = 50000000; io.timing = SDHC_TIMING_HS; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 50 MHz, high speed timing = %s
", err(ret)); io.clock = 100000000; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 100 MHz (above the maximum) = %s
", err(ret)); io.clock = 100000; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 100 kHz (below the minimum) = %s
", err(ret)); io.clock = 400000; io.timing = SDHC_TIMING_LEGACY; io.signal_voltage = SD_VOL_1_8_V; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 1.8 V signalling = %s
", err(ret)); io.signal_voltage = SD_VOL_3_3_V; io.bus_width = 3; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] a bus width of 3 = %s
", err(ret)); io.bus_width = SDHC_BUS_WIDTH1BIT; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] back to 400 kHz, 1 bit, 3.3 V = %s
", err(ret)); } [io] power on, 400 kHz, 1 bit, legacy timing = 0 [io] 25 MHz = 0 [io] 50 MHz, high speed timing = 0 [io] 100 MHz (above the maximum) = -EINVAL [io] 100 kHz (below the minimum) = -EINVAL [io] 1.8 V signalling = -ENOTSUP [io] a bus width of 3 = -EINVAL [io] back to 400 kHz, 1 bit, 3.3 V = 0

int sdhc_request(const struct device *dev, struct sdhc_command *cmd, struct sdhc_data *data); 发一条命令，需要数据的话带上 data。struct sdhc_command 填命令号、参数、期望的响应类型（SD_RSP_TYPE_R1 等，在 <zephyr/sd/sd_spec.h>）、重试次数和超时；响应在 cmd->response[] 里返回，R2 响应是 4 个字。struct sdhc_data 填起始块、块大小、块数、缓冲区和超时，传完后 bytes_xfered 是实际传输的字节数。 情况 返回 成功 0 带 data 但块大小、块数是 0 或缓冲区是 NULL -EINVAL 命令超时、数据超时 -ETIMEDOUT 响应或数据校验错误 -EIO，驱动会按 retries 重试 读写数据用 DMA，缓冲区要对齐到缓存行（64 字节），否则经过驱动的弹跳缓冲区。多块读写（CMD18、CMD25）由控制器自己在最后发 CMD12，应用不要再发。 下面分几个示例。 示例：识别卡​ 不带数据的命令。顺序是 SD 规范规定的：CMD0 复位，CMD8 检查电压，CMD55 加 ACMD41 反复询问直到卡上电完成，CMD2 读卡标识，CMD3 要相对地址，CMD9 读卡的特性数据，CMD7 选中卡。 /* sdhc_request without data: the identification of the card. Every step prints the response. */ static int bring_up_card(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd; int ret; ret = send(SD_GO_IDLE_STATE, 0, SD_RSP_TYPE_NONE, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD0 go idle = %s
", err(ret)); /* CMD8: 2.7..3.6 V and a check pattern that the card repeats */ ret = send(SD_SEND_IF_COND, SD_IF_COND_VHS_3V3 | SD_IF_COND_CHECK, SD_RSP_TYPE_R7, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD8 interface condition = %s: R7 %08x
", err(ret), cmd.response[0]); if (ret != 0) { return ret; } /* ACMD41: CMD55 first, then the operating condition, until the card says it is powered up */ for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) { ret = send(SD_APP_CMD, 0, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); if (ret == 0) { ret = send(SD_APP_SEND_OP_COND, SD_OCR_HOST_CAP_FLAG | 0x00ff8000, SD_RSP_TYPE_R3, &cmd); } if (ret != 0 || (cmd.response[0] & SD_OCR_PWR_BUSY_FLAG)) { break; } k_msleep(10); } block_addressed = (cmd.response[0] & SD_OCR_CARD_CAP_FLAG) != 0; printk("[card] ACMD41 operating condition = %s: OCR %08x, %s
", err(ret), cmd.response[0], block_addressed ? "block addressed (SDHC/SDXC)" : "byte addressed"); if (ret != 0) { return ret; } ret = send(SD_ALL_SEND_CID, 0, SD_RSP_TYPE_R2, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD2 CID = %s: %08x %08x %08x %08x
", err(ret), cmd.response[0], cmd.response[1], cmd.response[2], cmd.response[3]); ret = send(SD_SEND_RELATIVE_ADDR, 0, SD_RSP_TYPE_R6, &cmd); rca = cmd.response[0] >> 16; printk("[card] CMD3 relative address = %s: RCA %04x
", err(ret), rca); ret = send(SD_SEND_CSD, rca << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R2, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD9 CSD = %s: %08x %08x %08x %08x
", err(ret), cmd.response[0], cmd.response[1], cmd.response[2], cmd.response[3]); ret = send(SD_SELECT_CARD, rca << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1b, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD7 select the card = %s
", err(ret)); return ret; } [card] CMD0 go idle = 0 [card] CMD8 interface condition = 0: R7 000001aa [card] ACMD41 operating condition = 0: OCR c0ff8000, block addressed (SDHC/SDXC) [card] CMD2 CID = 0: 7f01a775 2200006e 73646667 05000c61 [card] CMD3 relative address = 0: RCA 0001 [card] CMD9 CSD = 0: 0a404023 3bff7f80 5b590000 400e0032 [card] CMD7 select the card = 0 OCR c0ff8000：最高位表示上电完成，第二位（CCS）表示是块寻址的 SDHC/SDXC 卡。 示例：切到 4 位总线​ ACMD6 通知卡，sdhc_set_io 通知控制器，同时把时钟提到 25 MHz。 /* switch to 4 data lines: ACMD6 tells the card, sdhc_set_io tells the controller */ static void bus_width_4(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd; struct sdhc_io io = { .clock = 25000000, .bus_mode = SDHC_BUSMODE_PUSHPULL, .power_mode = SDHC_POWER_ON, .bus_width = SDHC_BUS_WIDTH4BIT, .timing = SDHC_TIMING_LEGACY, .signal_voltage = SD_VOL_3_3_V, }; int ret = send(SD_APP_CMD, rca << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); if (ret == 0) { ret = send(SD_APP_SET_BUS_WIDTH, 2, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); /* 2 = 4 bit bus */ } if (ret == 0) { ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); } printk("[card] ACMD6 4 bit bus, 25 MHz = %s
", err(ret)); } [card] ACMD6 4 bit bus, 25 MHz = 0 示例：读一个块​ CMD17，带 sdhc_data。块 0 的最后两个字节是启动签名 55 aa。 static void demo_request_read_one(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd = { .opcode = SD_READ_SINGLE_BLOCK, .response_type = SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, .retries = 2, .timeout_ms = 200 }; struct sdhc_data data = { .block_addr = 0, .block_size = 512, .blocks = 1, .data = blocks, .timeout_ms = 500 }; int ret; cmd.arg = block_addressed ? 0 : 0 * 512; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[read1] CMD17 block 0 = %s: %u bytes, R1 %08x, signature %02x %02x
", err(ret), data.bytes_xfered, cmd.response[0], blocks[510], blocks[511]); } [read1] CMD17 block 0 = 0: 512 bytes, R1 00000900, signature 55 aa 示例：读多个块​ CMD18 一次读 8 块（4096 字节），不需要再发 CMD12。第一个块和 CMD17 读到的一样。 /* CMD18 reads several blocks; the controller ends the transfer itself, no CMD12 is needed. */ static void demo_request_read_many(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd = { .opcode = SD_READ_MULTIPLE_BLOCK, .response_type = SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, .retries = 2, .timeout_ms = 200 }; struct sdhc_data data = { .block_addr = 0, .block_size = 512, .blocks = 8, .data = blocks, .timeout_ms = 1000 }; static uint8_t first[512]; int ret; memcpy(first, blocks, sizeof(first)); memset(blocks, 0, sizeof(blocks)); cmd.arg = block_addressed ? 0 : 0; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[readN] CMD18 8 blocks from 0 = %s: %u bytes, first block %s
", err(ret), data.bytes_xfered, memcmp(first, blocks, 512) == 0 ? "same as CMD17" : "DIFFERENT"); } [readN] CMD18 8 blocks from 0 = 0: 4096 bytes, first block same as CMD17 示例：读卡状态​ CMD13 的响应是卡的状态寄存器，第 9…12 位是卡的状态，4 表示传输状态。 /* the card state after all this: CMD13 returns the status register */ static void demo_request_status(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd; int ret = send(SD_SEND_STATUS, rca << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); printk("[status] CMD13 card status = %s: R1 %08x, state %u (4 = transfer)
", err(ret), cmd.response[0], (cmd.response[0] >> 9) & 0xf); } [status] CMD13 card status = 0: R1 00000900, state 4 (4 = transfer) 示例：出错的请求​ /* requests the controller or the card refuses */ static void demo_request_errors(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd = { .opcode = SD_READ_SINGLE_BLOCK, .response_type = SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, .retries = 0, .timeout_ms = 200 }; struct sdhc_data data = { .block_addr = 0, .block_size = 512, .blocks = 1, .data = NULL, .timeout_ms = 500 }; int ret; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[request] data without a buffer = %s
", err(ret)); data.data = blocks; data.blocks = 0; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[request] zero blocks = %s
", err(ret)); /* the card has RCA 0x0001; a command addressed to another RCA is ignored by it, so no response comes */ ret = send(SD_SEND_STATUS, 0x1234 << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); printk("[request] CMD13 to an address nobody has = %s
", err(ret)); /* a block far beyond the end of the card: the card does not send the data */ cmd.opcode = SD_READ_SINGLE_BLOCK; cmd.arg = 0xfffffff0; cmd.response_type = SD_RSP_TYPE_R1; data.blocks = 1; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[request] CMD17 beyond the end of the card = %s
", err(ret)); } [request] data without a buffer = -EINVAL [request] zero blocks = -EINVAL [request] CMD13 to an address nobody has = -ETIMEDOUT [request] CMD17 beyond the end of the card = -ETIMEDOUT

int sdhc_card_busy(const struct device *dev); 读 DAT0 线：卡正忙（写入或编程中，DAT0 被拉低）返回 1，空闲返回 0。 /* sdhc_card_busy: 1 while the card holds DAT0 low (during a write or a programming step) */ static void demo_card_busy(void) { int ret = sdhc_card_busy(sdhc); printk("[busy] sdhc_card_busy = %d\n", ret); } [busy] sdhc_card_busy = 0

int sdhc_execute_tuning(const struct device *dev); 采样点调谐，只有 1.8 V 的 UHS 模式（SDR50、SDR104）需要。这个控制器不支持这些模式，所以返回 -ENOTSUP。 /* sdhc_execute_tuning: only the UHS modes at 1.8 V need it, which this controller does not do */ static void demo_execute_tuning(void) { int ret = sdhc_execute_tuning(sdhc); printk("[tuning] sdhc_execute_tuning = %s\n", err(ret)); } [tuning] sdhc_execute_tuning = -ENOTSUP

int sdhc_enable_interrupt(const struct device *dev, sdhc_interrupt_cb_t callback, int sources, void *user_data); 注册回调。sources 可以是： 取值 含义 SDHC_INT_INSERTED 卡插入（卡检测引脚上的边沿，驱动用 GPIO 中断实现） SDHC_INT_REMOVED 卡拔出 SDHC_INT_SDIO SDIO 卡的中断（DAT1 线） 回调的 reason 是上面某个值。演示把卡留在槽里 100 毫秒，没有事件；拔出或插入卡时回调会被调用。 static volatile int events; static void on_card_event(const struct device *dev, int reason, const void *user_data) { events++; } static void demo_enable_interrupt(void) { int ret = sdhc_enable_interrupt(sdhc, on_card_event, SDHC_INT_INSERTED | SDHC_INT_REMOVED, NULL); printk("[irq] sdhc_enable_interrupt(inserted | removed) = %s\n", err(ret)); k_msleep(100); printk("[irq] events in 100 ms with the card left alone = %d\n", events); } [irq] sdhc_enable_interrupt(inserted | removed) = 0 [irq] events in 100 ms with the card left alone = 0

int sdhc_disable_interrupt(const struct device *dev, int sources); 关掉指定的事件；关掉最后一个卡检测事件时，同时关掉卡检测引脚的 GPIO 中断。 /* sdhc_disable_interrupt: switch the events off again */ static void demo_disable_interrupt(void) { int ret = sdhc_disable_interrupt(sdhc, SDHC_INT_INSERTED | SDHC_INT_REMOVED); printk("[irq] sdhc_disable_interrupt = %s\n", err(ret)); } [irq] sdhc_disable_interrupt = 0

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0) find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE}) project(sdhc_api) target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)
CONFIG_SDHC=y CONFIG_PRINTK=y CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096 CONFIG_SHELL=n CONFIG_DEVMEM_SHELL=n CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n

/* * Calls every function of <zephyr/drivers/sdhc.h> on SMHC0 (the TF card slot of the YuzukiNeko). There is no disk * or file system layer here: the card is brought up by hand with the commands of the SD * specification, and a block is read with CMD17 and CMD18. */ #include <errno.h> #include <string.h> #include <zephyr/device.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/sdhc.h> #include <zephyr/kernel.h> #include <zephyr/sd/sd_spec.h> #include <zephyr/sys/printk.h> static const struct device *const sdhc = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(smhc0)); static uint32_t rca; /* relative card address, from CMD3 */ static bool block_addressed; /* SDHC and SDXC cards: the address of a read is a block number */ static const char *err(int ret) { switch (ret) { case 0: return "0"; case -EIO: return "-EIO"; case -EINVAL: return "-EINVAL"; case -ENOTSUP: return "-ENOTSUP"; case -ETIMEDOUT: return "-ETIMEDOUT"; case -ENOSYS: return "-ENOSYS"; default: return "?"; } } /* one command without data */ static int send(uint32_t opcode, uint32_t arg, uint32_t response_type, struct sdhc_command *cmd) { memset(cmd, 0, sizeof(*cmd)); cmd->opcode = opcode; cmd->arg = arg; cmd->response_type = response_type; cmd->retries = 2; cmd->timeout_ms = 200; return sdhc_request(sdhc, cmd, NULL); } /* sdhc_get_host_props: what the controller can do */ static void demo_get_host_props(void) { struct sdhc_host_props props; int ret = sdhc_get_host_props(sdhc, &props); printk("[props] sdhc_get_host_props = %s: clock %u..%u Hz, power-up delay %u ms
", err(ret), props.f_min, props.f_max, props.power_delay); printk("[props] 4 bit bus %d, 8 bit bus %d, high speed %d, 3.3 V %d, 3.0 V %d, 1.8 V %d, SDR50 %d, DDR50 %d, SPI mode %d
", props.host_caps.bus_4_bit_support, props.host_caps.bus_8_bit_support, props.host_caps.high_spd_support, props.host_caps.vol_330_support, props.host_caps.vol_300_support, props.host_caps.vol_180_support, props.host_caps.sdr50_support, props.host_caps.ddr50_support, props.is_spi); printk("[props] SDIO card interrupt %d, max current at 3.3 V %u mA
", props.host_caps.sdio_async_interrupt_support, props.max_current_330); } /* sdhc_card_present: the card detect line (cd-gpios) */ static void demo_card_present(void) { int ret = sdhc_card_present(sdhc); printk("[present] sdhc_card_present = %d
", ret); } /* sdhc_hw_reset: reset the controller, the card keeps its state */ static void demo_hw_reset(void) { int ret = sdhc_hw_reset(sdhc); printk("[reset] sdhc_hw_reset = %s
", err(ret)); } /* sdhc_set_io: power, clock, bus width and timing. A card starts in 1 bit mode at 400 kHz or less. */ static void demo_set_io(void) { struct sdhc_io io = { .clock = 400000, .bus_mode = SDHC_BUSMODE_PUSHPULL, .power_mode = SDHC_POWER_ON, .bus_width = SDHC_BUS_WIDTH1BIT, .timing = SDHC_TIMING_LEGACY, .signal_voltage = SD_VOL_3_3_V, }; int ret; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] power on, 400 kHz, 1 bit, legacy timing = %s
", err(ret)); k_msleep(10); io.clock = 25000000; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 25 MHz = %s
", err(ret)); io.clock = 50000000; io.timing = SDHC_TIMING_HS; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 50 MHz, high speed timing = %s
", err(ret)); io.clock = 100000000; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 100 MHz (above the maximum) = %s
", err(ret)); io.clock = 100000; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 100 kHz (below the minimum) = %s
", err(ret)); io.clock = 400000; io.timing = SDHC_TIMING_LEGACY; io.signal_voltage = SD_VOL_1_8_V; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] 1.8 V signalling = %s
", err(ret)); io.signal_voltage = SD_VOL_3_3_V; io.bus_width = 3; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] a bus width of 3 = %s
", err(ret)); io.bus_width = SDHC_BUS_WIDTH1BIT; ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); printk("[io] back to 400 kHz, 1 bit, 3.3 V = %s
", err(ret)); } /* sdhc_request without data: the identification of the card. Every step prints the response. */ static int bring_up_card(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd; int ret; ret = send(SD_GO_IDLE_STATE, 0, SD_RSP_TYPE_NONE, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD0 go idle = %s
", err(ret)); /* CMD8: 2.7..3.6 V and a check pattern that the card repeats */ ret = send(SD_SEND_IF_COND, SD_IF_COND_VHS_3V3 | SD_IF_COND_CHECK, SD_RSP_TYPE_R7, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD8 interface condition = %s: R7 %08x
", err(ret), cmd.response[0]); if (ret != 0) { return ret; } /* ACMD41: CMD55 first, then the operating condition, until the card says it is powered up */ for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) { ret = send(SD_APP_CMD, 0, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); if (ret == 0) { ret = send(SD_APP_SEND_OP_COND, SD_OCR_HOST_CAP_FLAG | 0x00ff8000, SD_RSP_TYPE_R3, &cmd); } if (ret != 0 || (cmd.response[0] & SD_OCR_PWR_BUSY_FLAG)) { break; } k_msleep(10); } block_addressed = (cmd.response[0] & SD_OCR_CARD_CAP_FLAG) != 0; printk("[card] ACMD41 operating condition = %s: OCR %08x, %s
", err(ret), cmd.response[0], block_addressed ? "block addressed (SDHC/SDXC)" : "byte addressed"); if (ret != 0) { return ret; } ret = send(SD_ALL_SEND_CID, 0, SD_RSP_TYPE_R2, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD2 CID = %s: %08x %08x %08x %08x
", err(ret), cmd.response[0], cmd.response[1], cmd.response[2], cmd.response[3]); ret = send(SD_SEND_RELATIVE_ADDR, 0, SD_RSP_TYPE_R6, &cmd); rca = cmd.response[0] >> 16; printk("[card] CMD3 relative address = %s: RCA %04x
", err(ret), rca); ret = send(SD_SEND_CSD, rca << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R2, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD9 CSD = %s: %08x %08x %08x %08x
", err(ret), cmd.response[0], cmd.response[1], cmd.response[2], cmd.response[3]); ret = send(SD_SELECT_CARD, rca << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1b, &cmd); printk("[card] CMD7 select the card = %s
", err(ret)); return ret; } /* switch to 4 data lines: ACMD6 tells the card, sdhc_set_io tells the controller */ static void bus_width_4(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd; struct sdhc_io io = { .clock = 25000000, .bus_mode = SDHC_BUSMODE_PUSHPULL, .power_mode = SDHC_POWER_ON, .bus_width = SDHC_BUS_WIDTH4BIT, .timing = SDHC_TIMING_LEGACY, .signal_voltage = SD_VOL_3_3_V, }; int ret = send(SD_APP_CMD, rca << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); if (ret == 0) { ret = send(SD_APP_SET_BUS_WIDTH, 2, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); /* 2 = 4 bit bus */ } if (ret == 0) { ret = sdhc_set_io(sdhc, &io); } printk("[card] ACMD6 4 bit bus, 25 MHz = %s
", err(ret)); } /* sdhc_request with data: CMD17 reads one block. The buffer is 64 byte aligned for the DMA. */ static uint8_t blocks[8 * 512] __aligned(64); static void demo_request_read_one(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd = { .opcode = SD_READ_SINGLE_BLOCK, .response_type = SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, .retries = 2, .timeout_ms = 200 }; struct sdhc_data data = { .block_addr = 0, .block_size = 512, .blocks = 1, .data = blocks, .timeout_ms = 500 }; int ret; cmd.arg = block_addressed ? 0 : 0 * 512; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[read1] CMD17 block 0 = %s: %u bytes, R1 %08x, signature %02x %02x
", err(ret), data.bytes_xfered, cmd.response[0], blocks[510], blocks[511]); } /* CMD18 reads several blocks; the controller ends the transfer itself, no CMD12 is needed. */ static void demo_request_read_many(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd = { .opcode = SD_READ_MULTIPLE_BLOCK, .response_type = SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, .retries = 2, .timeout_ms = 200 }; struct sdhc_data data = { .block_addr = 0, .block_size = 512, .blocks = 8, .data = blocks, .timeout_ms = 1000 }; static uint8_t first[512]; int ret; memcpy(first, blocks, sizeof(first)); memset(blocks, 0, sizeof(blocks)); cmd.arg = block_addressed ? 0 : 0; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[readN] CMD18 8 blocks from 0 = %s: %u bytes, first block %s
", err(ret), data.bytes_xfered, memcmp(first, blocks, 512) == 0 ? "same as CMD17" : "DIFFERENT"); } /* the card state after all this: CMD13 returns the status register */ static void demo_request_status(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd; int ret = send(SD_SEND_STATUS, rca << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); printk("[status] CMD13 card status = %s: R1 %08x, state %u (4 = transfer)
", err(ret), cmd.response[0], (cmd.response[0] >> 9) & 0xf); } /* requests the controller or the card refuses */ static void demo_request_errors(void) { struct sdhc_command cmd = { .opcode = SD_READ_SINGLE_BLOCK, .response_type = SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, .retries = 0, .timeout_ms = 200 }; struct sdhc_data data = { .block_addr = 0, .block_size = 512, .blocks = 1, .data = NULL, .timeout_ms = 500 }; int ret; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[request] data without a buffer = %s
", err(ret)); data.data = blocks; data.blocks = 0; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[request] zero blocks = %s
", err(ret)); /* the card has RCA 0x0001; a command addressed to another RCA is ignored by it, so no response comes */ ret = send(SD_SEND_STATUS, 0x1234 << 16, SD_RSP_TYPE_R1, &cmd); printk("[request] CMD13 to an address nobody has = %s
", err(ret)); /* a block far beyond the end of the card: the card does not send the data */ cmd.opcode = SD_READ_SINGLE_BLOCK; cmd.arg = 0xfffffff0; cmd.response_type = SD_RSP_TYPE_R1; data.blocks = 1; ret = sdhc_request(sdhc, &cmd, &data); printk("[request] CMD17 beyond the end of the card = %s
", err(ret)); } /* sdhc_card_busy: 1 while the card holds DAT0 low (during a write or a programming step) */ static void demo_card_busy(void) { int ret = sdhc_card_busy(sdhc); printk("[busy] sdhc_card_busy = %d
", ret); } /* sdhc_execute_tuning: only the UHS modes at 1.8 V need it, which this controller does not do */ static void demo_execute_tuning(void) { int ret = sdhc_execute_tuning(sdhc); printk("[tuning] sdhc_execute_tuning = %s
", err(ret)); } /* sdhc_enable_interrupt: a callback for card insertion and removal (the card detect line) */ static volatile int events; static void on_card_event(const struct device *dev, int reason, const void *user_data) { events++; } static void demo_enable_interrupt(void) { int ret = sdhc_enable_interrupt(sdhc, on_card_event, SDHC_INT_INSERTED | SDHC_INT_REMOVED, NULL); printk("[irq] sdhc_enable_interrupt(inserted | removed) = %s
", err(ret)); k_msleep(100); printk("[irq] events in 100 ms with the card left alone = %d
", events); } /* sdhc_disable_interrupt: switch the events off again */ static void demo_disable_interrupt(void) { int ret = sdhc_disable_interrupt(sdhc, SDHC_INT_INSERTED | SDHC_INT_REMOVED); printk("[irq] sdhc_disable_interrupt = %s
", err(ret)); } int main(void) { if (!device_is_ready(sdhc)) { printk("sdhc not ready

"); return 0; }

F101 有 2 个 SPI 控制器，在 Zephyr 里是 spi0 和 spi1，接口是标准的 <zephyr/drivers/spi.h>，驱动是 drivers/spi/spi_sunxi.c，另外有一个扩展头文件 <zephyr/drivers/spi/spi_sunxi.h>。 项目 内容 设备 spi0（PC0…PC5，板载 SPI NOR）、spi1（PD0…PD5，和 LCD 引脚共用） 角色 只做主机 字长 8 位 模式 4 种 SPI 模式（CPOL、CPHA），可选低位在前 片选 硬件片选 0…3，或者设备树里的 cs-gpios 数据线 单线；打开 CONFIG_SPI_EXTENDED_MODES 后读数据阶段可以用四线 频率 3 kHz 以下返回 -EINVAL；24 MHz 以内用控制器自己的分频；更高的由 PLL 分频得到 传输方式 轮询；256 字节及以上、64 字节（缓存行）对齐的读缓冲走 DMA 不支持 从机模式、环回（SPI_MODE_LOOP）、SPI_HOLD_ON_CS、非 8 位字长

文件 作用 dts/bindings/spi/allwinner,sunxi-spi.yaml 绑定：规定 allwinner,sunxi-spi 节点的属性 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 设备树：spi0、spi1，默认 disabled boards/yuzukihd/yuzukineko/yuzukineko.dts 板级设备树：引脚组，打开 spi0

spi0 和 spi1 只有寄存器、时钟、复位、DMA 通道不同。下面是 spi0： spi0: spi@4025000 { /* 匹配驱动 spi_sunxi.c 里的 DT_DRV_COMPAT allwinner_sunxi_spi */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-spi"; /* 子节点（从设备）用 1 个格子的地址，也就是片选号 */ #address-cells = <1>; #size-cells = <0>; /* 寄存器窗口：基址 0x04025000，长度 0x400 */ reg = <0x04025000 0x400>; /* 模块时钟和总线时钟，顺序和 clock-names 对应 */ clocks = <&cctl CLK_SPI0>, <&cctl CLK_BUS_SPI0>; clock-names = "mod", "bus"; /* 总线复位 */ resets = <&rctl RST_BUS_SPI0>; /* 初始化时使用的时钟频率 */ clock-frequency = <10000000>; /* 模块时钟寄存器在 CCU 里的偏移 */ clock-reg = <0x940>; /* 接收 DMA：DMA 控制器的 7 号通道，SPI 接收 FIFO 的请求线是 22 */ dmas = <&dma 7>; dma-names = "rx"; dma-slot = <22>; status = "disabled"; }; 节点 标签 寄存器 模块时钟 clock-reg DMA 通道 请求线 spi@4025000 spi0 0x04025000 CLK_SPI0 0x940 7 22 spi@4026000 spi1 0x04026000 CLK_SPI1 0x944 8 23

&pio { /* SPI0 在 PC0…PC5，复用功能 3。板载 NOR 闪存和 SPIF 控制器用的是同一组脚 */ spi0_pins: spi0_pins { spi0_data { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PC, 0, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PC, 4, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PC, 2, 3)>; bias-disable; }; spi0_control { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PC, 1, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PC, 3, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PC, 5, 3)>; bias-pull-up; }; }; /* SPI1 在 PD0…PD5，复用功能 3：PD0 CS0，PD1 CLK，PD2 MOSI，PD3 MISO，PD4 HOLD，PD5 WP */ spi1_pins: spi1_pins { spi1_data { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 1, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 2, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 3, 3)>; bias-disable; }; spi1_control { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 0, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 4, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 5, 3)>; bias-pull-up; }; }; }; &spi0 { status = "okay"; pinctrl-0 = <&spi0_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; }; spi1 在本板没有打开：PD0…PD5 被触摸屏的 I2C、复位、中断脚和 LED、功放使能占用了。

给一个从设备写一个子节点，reg 是片选号，spi-max-frequency 是它能接受的最高频率。例如把一个 SPI NOR 接在 spi0 的片选 0 上： &spi0 { status = "okay"; pinctrl-0 = <&spi0_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; flash0: flash@0 { compatible = "jedec,spi-nor"; reg = <0>; spi-max-frequency = <24000000>; jedec-id = [85 20 18]; size = <DT_SIZE_M(128)>; /* 以位为单位：16 MiB */ }; }; 使用硬件片选就不要写 cs-gpios。要用 GPIO 当片选，在控制器节点里写 cs-gpios = <&gpiod 4 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>;，子节点的 reg 是它在列表里的序号，驱动就用软件控制这个脚。

# Copyright (c) 2026 Yuzuki Tsuru # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 description: Allwinner sunxi SPI controller compatible: "allwinner,sunxi-spi" include: [spi-controller.yaml, pinctrl-device.yaml] properties: reg: required: true clocks: required: true clock-names: required: true resets: type: phandle-array required: true clock-frequency: type: int required: true clock-reg: type: int required: true dmas: description: | Optional DMA channel for the receive data of long reads ("rx"). The FIFO is drained by the DMA in 32 bit units; what is left below the FIFO trigger level at the end of a transfer is read by the CPU. dma-names: description: '"rx"' dma-slot: type: int description: request line (DRQ) of the SPI receive FIFO 属性 必填 含义 reg 是 寄存器窗口 clocks、clock-names 是 模块时钟 mod 和总线时钟 bus resets 是 总线复位 clock-frequency 是 初始化时的时钟频率 clock-reg 是 模块时钟寄存器在 CCU 里的偏移 dmas、dma-names、dma-slot 否 接收 DMA；不写则所有读都由 CPU 完成 cs-gpios 否 来自 spi-controller.yaml，用 GPIO 做片选 pinctrl-0、pinctrl-names 否 引脚，见 GPIO 页的 pinctrl 一节

选项 默认 含义 CONFIG_SPI 板级 defconfig 里是 y 打开 SPI 子系统 CONFIG_SPI_SUNXI y（依赖 DT_HAS_ALLWINNER_SUNXI_SPI_ENABLED） 编译这个驱动，并选中 CONFIG_PINCTRL CONFIG_SPI_SUNXI_INIT_PRIORITY 81 驱动的初始化优先级 CONFIG_SPI_SUNXI_DMA y（依赖 DMA） 长读用 DMA CONFIG_SPI_SUNXI_DMA_MIN_LEN 256 至少读多少字节才用 DMA CONFIG_SPI_EXTENDED_MODES 否 打开后 SPI_LINES_QUAD 可用：命令走一根线，读数据走四根线

下面每个接口一个小标题：原型、驱动的行为、示例函数和它在板子上的输出。演示在 spi0 上读板载的 SPI NOR 闪存（16 MiB，JEDEC ID 85 20 18）；闪存里放着启动加载器，所以只发读命令，不发写和擦除。示例来自文末的完整演示程序，里面的 err() 把返回值转成名字。 所有示例用同一个函数生成 struct spi_config：片选 0（硬件片选脚），8 位字，高位在前。 /* chip select 0 (the hardware CS pin), mode 0, 8 bit words, most significant bit first */ static struct spi_config cfg_at(uint32_t hz, uint32_t mode) { return (struct spi_config){ .frequency = hz, .operation = SPI_OP_MODE_MASTER | SPI_WORD_SET(8) | mode, .slave = 0, }; }

int spi_transceive(const struct device *dev, const struct spi_config *config, const struct spi_buf_set *tx_bufs, const struct spi_buf_set *rx_bufs); tx_bufs 和 rx_bufs 总长度是否相等，决定驱动怎么走： tx 总长度 rx 总长度 传输 等于 等于 全双工：每发出一个字节就收进一个字节，两边一一对应 不等于 不等于 命令加数据：先发 tx，发 tx 的同时收到的字节丢掉；rx 里是发完 tx 之后的 rx 个字节 SPI NOR 一类“发命令、读数据”的器件用第二种，一次调用完成，片选在整个过程里保持有效。一次调用最多传 16777215（0xFFFFFF）个字节，超过返回 -EMSGSIZE。 示例：命令加数据​ /* * spi_transceive with a command phase: tx is 1 byte, rx is 3 bytes. When the two lengths differ the * driver throws away what comes in while the tx bytes go out, so rx[0] is the first byte after the * command. (With the same length on both sides it is a plain full duplex transfer, see below.) */ static void demo_command_read(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; uint8_t id[3] = { 0 }; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[command] JEDEC ID (tx 1 byte, rx 3 bytes) = %s: %02x %02x %02x
", err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); } [command] JEDEC ID (tx 1 byte, rx 3 bytes) = 0: 85 20 18 示例：全双工​ 收发长度相等，rx[0] 是发命令时收到的字节，不是数据。要读状态寄存器这样的 1 个字节，就双向各发 2 个字节，答案在第二个。 /* * spi_transceive with equal lengths is a plain full duplex transfer: every tx byte clocks one rx * byte in, so the byte received while the command goes out is not data. */ static void demo_full_duplex(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t out[4] = { CMD_JEDEC_ID, 0, 0, 0 }; uint8_t in[4] = { 0xaa, 0xaa, 0xaa, 0xaa }; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = out, .len = sizeof(out) }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = in, .len = sizeof(in) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[duplex] JEDEC ID (4 bytes both ways) = %s: %02x %02x %02x %02x
", err(ret), in[0], in[1], in[2], in[3]); /* a command and one byte of answer: two bytes both ways, the answer is the second one */ out[0] = CMD_READ_STATUS; out[1] = 0; tx_buf.len = 2; rx_buf.len = 2; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[duplex] status register (2 bytes both ways) = %s: 0x%02x
", err(ret), in[1]); } [duplex] JEDEC ID (4 bytes both ways) = 0: ff 85 20 18 [duplex] status register (2 bytes both ways) = 0: 0x00 示例：长读和 DMA​ 读缓冲至少 CONFIG_SPI_SUNXI_DMA_MIN_LEN（256）字节、地址按 64 字节（缓存行）对齐时，数据由 DMA 搬运；否则由 CPU 从接收 FIFO 里读。两种方式读到的数据一样。下面读 4 KiB，并换几个时钟频率看耗时。 /* A longer read: the first 16 bytes of the flash, and the speed at several clocks. * Reads of 256 bytes or more into a 64 byte (cache line) aligned buffer go through the DMA controller. */ static void demo_read_flash(void) { static uint8_t page[4096] __aligned(64); static uint8_t first[4096]; struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t cmd[4] = { CMD_READ_DATA, 0, 0, 0 }; /* 24 bit address 0 */ struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = cmd, .len = sizeof(cmd) }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = page, .len = sizeof(page) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; static const uint32_t rates[] = { 1000000, 6000000, 24000000, 48000000 }; int ret; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[read] 4096 bytes at address 0 at 1 MHz = %s
", err(ret)); printk("[read] first 16 bytes:"); for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { printk(" %02x", page[i]); } printk("
"); memcpy(first, page, sizeof(page)); for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(rates); i++) { cfg = cfg_at(rates[i], 0); memset(page, 0, sizeof(page)); int64_t t0 = k_uptime_ticks(); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); int64_t us = k_ticks_to_us_near64(k_uptime_ticks() - t0); printk("[read] 4096 bytes at %2u MHz = %s, %lld us, %s
", rates[i] / 1000000, err(ret), us, memcmp(first, page, sizeof(page)) == 0 ? "same data" : "DIFFERENT data"); } /* a buffer that is not 64 byte aligned is read by the CPU */ static uint8_t odd[1 + 512] __aligned(64); rx_buf.buf = odd + 1; rx_buf.len = 512; cfg = cfg_at(24000000, 0); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[read] 512 bytes into an unaligned buffer = %s, %s
", err(ret), memcmp(first, odd + 1, 512) == 0 ? "same data" : "DIFFERENT data"); } [read] 4096 bytes at address 0 at 1 MHz = 0 [read] first 16 bytes: ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff [read] 4096 bytes at 1 MHz = 0, 87500 us, same data [read] 4096 bytes at 6 MHz = 0, 21900 us, same data [read] 4096 bytes at 24 MHz = 0, 1400 us, same data [read] 4096 bytes at 48 MHz = 0, 800 us, same data [read] 512 bytes into an unaligned buffer = 0, same data 闪存起始地址是空的（全 ff），启动加载器在后面的地址。频率超过 24 MHz 时驱动不再用控制器自己的分频，改用 PLL 分频；超过 60 MHz 时回来的数据要延迟采样，见 sunxi_spi_set_sample。 示例：SPI 模式​ spi_config.operation 里的 SPI_MODE_CPOL、SPI_MODE_CPHA 组合出 4 种模式，SPI_TRANSFER_LSB 选低位在前。 /* SPI mode 0 (CPOL 0, CPHA 0) and mode 3 (CPOL 1, CPHA 1) both work with a NOR flash */ static void demo_modes(void) { uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; uint8_t id[3]; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; static const struct { const char *name; uint32_t mode; } modes[] = { { "mode 0 (CPOL 0, CPHA 0)", 0 }, { "mode 1 (CPOL 0, CPHA 1)", SPI_MODE_CPHA }, { "mode 2 (CPOL 1, CPHA 0)", SPI_MODE_CPOL }, { "mode 3 (CPOL 1, CPHA 1)", SPI_MODE_CPOL | SPI_MODE_CPHA }, }; for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(modes); i++) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, modes[i].mode); int ret; memset(id, 0, sizeof(id)); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[mode] %s = %s: %02x %02x %02x
", modes[i].name, err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); } } [mode] mode 0 (CPOL 0, CPHA 0) = 0: 85 20 18 [mode] mode 1 (CPOL 0, CPHA 1) = 0: 85 20 18 [mode] mode 2 (CPOL 1, CPHA 0) = 0: ff ff ff [mode] mode 3 (CPOL 1, CPHA 1) = 0: 85 20 18 SPI NOR 只规定模式 0 和模式 3，模式 2 读不到数据是器件的原因。 示例：驱动拒绝的配置​ /* what the driver refuses */ static void demo_unsupported(void) { uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; uint8_t id[3]; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_config cfg; int ret; cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); cfg.operation = SPI_OP_MODE_MASTER | SPI_WORD_SET(16); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] 16 bit words = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000000, SPI_MODE_LOOP); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] SPI_MODE_LOOP = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000000, SPI_HOLD_ON_CS); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] SPI_HOLD_ON_CS = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); cfg.operation = SPI_OP_MODE_SLAVE | SPI_WORD_SET(8); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] slave mode = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); cfg.slave = 4; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] chip select 4 = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000, 0); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] 1 kHz = %s
", err(ret)); /* nothing to send or receive */ struct spi_buf_set none = { .buffers = NULL, .count = 0 }; cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &none, &none); printk("[refuse] empty transfer = %s
", err(ret)); } [refuse] 16 bit words = -ENOTSUP [refuse] SPI_MODE_LOOP = -ENOTSUP [refuse] SPI_HOLD_ON_CS = -ENOTSUP [refuse] slave mode = -ENOTSUP [refuse] chip select 4 = -ENOTSUP [refuse] 1 kHz = -EINVAL [refuse] empty transfer = 0

int spi_write(const struct device *dev, const struct spi_config *config, const struct spi_buf_set *tx_bufs); 只发送，等于 rx 为空的 spi_transceive，每次调用有自己的片选周期。 /* spi_write: only sends. A write of the command alone and then a separate read is not what a NOR flash * wants (it needs the command and the read in the same chip select), but it is what spi_write does. */ static void demo_spi_write(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret = spi_write(spi, &cfg, &tx); printk("[split] spi_write(command) = %s\n", err(ret)); } [split] spi_write(command) = 0

int spi_read(const struct device *dev, const struct spi_config *config, const struct spi_buf_set *rx_bufs); 只接收，tx 为空。闪存要求命令和读数据在同一次片选里，所以先 spi_write 命令再单独 spi_read，读到的是 ff ff ff： /* spi_read: only receives, the chip select is a new one, so the flash has not seen a command */ static void demo_spi_read(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t id[3] = { 0 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret = spi_read(spi, &cfg, &rx); printk("[split] spi_read(3 bytes), chip select again = %s: %02x %02x %02x\n", err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); } [split] spi_read(3 bytes), chip select again = 0: ff ff ff

int spi_release(const struct device *dev, const struct spi_config *config); operation 里带 SPI_LOCK_ON 的传输结束后总线仍然被这个配置占着，别的线程的传输要等；spi_release 释放它。 /* spi_release unlocks the bus that a spi_config with SPI_LOCK_ON holds. */ static void demo_release(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, SPI_LOCK_ON); uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; uint8_t id[3] = { 0 }; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[release] transfer with SPI_LOCK_ON = %s: %02x %02x %02x\n", err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); ret = spi_release(spi, &cfg); printk("[release] spi_release = %s\n", err(ret)); } [release] transfer with SPI_LOCK_ON = 0: 85 20 18 [release] spi_release = 0

int sunxi_spi_set_sample(const struct device *dev, uint8_t mode, uint8_t delay); 头文件 <zephyr/drivers/spi/spi_sunxi.h>，是这个驱动自己的扩展。选采样点：mode 是采样延后的半周期数（0…6），delay 是在此之上再加的延迟线级数（0…63），下一次传输起生效。不调用的话 60 MHz 以上自动延后一个周期。参数超范围返回 -EINVAL。 /* sunxi_spi_set_sample: choose the sample point of the returning data (mode 0..6, delay 0..63) */ static void demo_set_sample(void) { int ret; ret = sunxi_spi_set_sample(spi, 7, 0); printk("[sample] sunxi_spi_set_sample(mode 7) = %s
", err(ret)); ret = sunxi_spi_set_sample(spi, 0, 64); printk("[sample] sunxi_spi_set_sample(delay 64) = %s
", err(ret)); ret = sunxi_spi_set_sample(spi, 0, 0); printk("[sample] sunxi_spi_set_sample(mode 0, delay 0) = %s
", err(ret)); } [sample] sunxi_spi_set_sample(mode 7) = -EINVAL [sample] sunxi_spi_set_sample(delay 64) = -EINVAL [sample] sunxi_spi_set_sample(mode 0, delay 0) = 0
