cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0) find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE}) project(spi_api) target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)
CONFIG_SPI=y CONFIG_PRINTK=y CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096 CONFIG_SHELL=n CONFIG_DEVMEM_SHELL=n CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n

/* * Calls the functions of <zephyr/drivers/spi.h> on SPI0 of the YuzukiNeko, where the 16 MiB SPI NOR flash * of the board sits on PC0..PC5. Only read commands are sent, the flash holds the boot loader. */ #include <errno.h> #include <string.h> #include <zephyr/device.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/spi.h> #include <zephyr/drivers/spi/spi_sunxi.h> #include <zephyr/kernel.h> #include <zephyr/sys/printk.h> static const struct device *const spi = DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(spi0)); /* SPI NOR commands */ #define CMD_READ_STATUS 0x05 #define CMD_READ_DATA 0x03 #define CMD_JEDEC_ID 0x9f /* chip select 0 (the hardware CS pin), mode 0, 8 bit words, most significant bit first */ static struct spi_config cfg_at(uint32_t hz, uint32_t mode) { return (struct spi_config){ .frequency = hz, .operation = SPI_OP_MODE_MASTER | SPI_WORD_SET(8) | mode, .slave = 0, }; } static const char *err(int ret) { switch (ret) { case 0: return "0"; case -ENOTSUP: return "-ENOTSUP"; case -EINVAL: return "-EINVAL"; case -EIO: return "-EIO"; case -ETIMEDOUT: return "-ETIMEDOUT"; default: return "?"; } } /* * spi_transceive with a command phase: tx is 1 byte, rx is 3 bytes. When the two lengths differ the * driver throws away what comes in while the tx bytes go out, so rx[0] is the first byte after the * command. (With the same length on both sides it is a plain full duplex transfer, see below.) */ static void demo_command_read(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; uint8_t id[3] = { 0 }; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[command] JEDEC ID (tx 1 byte, rx 3 bytes) = %s: %02x %02x %02x
", err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); } /* * spi_transceive with equal lengths is a plain full duplex transfer: every tx byte clocks one rx * byte in, so the byte received while the command goes out is not data. */ static void demo_full_duplex(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t out[4] = { CMD_JEDEC_ID, 0, 0, 0 }; uint8_t in[4] = { 0xaa, 0xaa, 0xaa, 0xaa }; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = out, .len = sizeof(out) }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = in, .len = sizeof(in) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[duplex] JEDEC ID (4 bytes both ways) = %s: %02x %02x %02x %02x
", err(ret), in[0], in[1], in[2], in[3]); /* a command and one byte of answer: two bytes both ways, the answer is the second one */ out[0] = CMD_READ_STATUS; out[1] = 0; tx_buf.len = 2; rx_buf.len = 2; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[duplex] status register (2 bytes both ways) = %s: 0x%02x
", err(ret), in[1]); } /* spi_write: only sends. A write of the command alone and then a separate read is not what a NOR flash * wants (it needs the command and the read in the same chip select), but it is what spi_write does. */ static void demo_spi_write(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret = spi_write(spi, &cfg, &tx); printk("[split] spi_write(command) = %s
", err(ret)); } /* spi_read: only receives, the chip select is a new one, so the flash has not seen a command */ static void demo_spi_read(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t id[3] = { 0 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret = spi_read(spi, &cfg, &rx); printk("[split] spi_read(3 bytes), chip select again = %s: %02x %02x %02x
", err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); } /* A longer read: the first 16 bytes of the flash, and the speed at several clocks. * Reads of 256 bytes or more into a 64 byte (cache line) aligned buffer go through the DMA controller. */ static void demo_read_flash(void) { static uint8_t page[4096] __aligned(64); static uint8_t first[4096]; struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); uint8_t cmd[4] = { CMD_READ_DATA, 0, 0, 0 }; /* 24 bit address 0 */ struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = cmd, .len = sizeof(cmd) }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = page, .len = sizeof(page) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; static const uint32_t rates[] = { 1000000, 6000000, 24000000, 48000000 }; int ret; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[read] 4096 bytes at address 0 at 1 MHz = %s
", err(ret)); printk("[read] first 16 bytes:"); for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { printk(" %02x", page[i]); } printk("
"); memcpy(first, page, sizeof(page)); for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(rates); i++) { cfg = cfg_at(rates[i], 0); memset(page, 0, sizeof(page)); int64_t t0 = k_uptime_ticks(); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); int64_t us = k_ticks_to_us_near64(k_uptime_ticks() - t0); printk("[read] 4096 bytes at %2u MHz = %s, %lld us, %s
", rates[i] / 1000000, err(ret), us, memcmp(first, page, sizeof(page)) == 0 ? "same data" : "DIFFERENT data"); } /* a buffer that is not 64 byte aligned is read by the CPU */ static uint8_t odd[1 + 512] __aligned(64); rx_buf.buf = odd + 1; rx_buf.len = 512; cfg = cfg_at(24000000, 0); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[read] 512 bytes into an unaligned buffer = %s, %s
", err(ret), memcmp(first, odd + 1, 512) == 0 ? "same data" : "DIFFERENT data"); } /* SPI mode 0 (CPOL 0, CPHA 0) and mode 3 (CPOL 1, CPHA 1) both work with a NOR flash */ static void demo_modes(void) { uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; uint8_t id[3]; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; static const struct { const char *name; uint32_t mode; } modes[] = { { "mode 0 (CPOL 0, CPHA 0)", 0 }, { "mode 1 (CPOL 0, CPHA 1)", SPI_MODE_CPHA }, { "mode 2 (CPOL 1, CPHA 0)", SPI_MODE_CPOL }, { "mode 3 (CPOL 1, CPHA 1)", SPI_MODE_CPOL | SPI_MODE_CPHA }, }; for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(modes); i++) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, modes[i].mode); int ret; memset(id, 0, sizeof(id)); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[mode] %s = %s: %02x %02x %02x
", modes[i].name, err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); } } /* what the driver refuses */ static void demo_unsupported(void) { uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; uint8_t id[3]; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_config cfg; int ret; cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); cfg.operation = SPI_OP_MODE_MASTER | SPI_WORD_SET(16); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] 16 bit words = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000000, SPI_MODE_LOOP); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] SPI_MODE_LOOP = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000000, SPI_HOLD_ON_CS); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] SPI_HOLD_ON_CS = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); cfg.operation = SPI_OP_MODE_SLAVE | SPI_WORD_SET(8); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] slave mode = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); cfg.slave = 4; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] chip select 4 = %s
", err(ret)); cfg = cfg_at(1000, 0); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[refuse] 1 kHz = %s
", err(ret)); /* nothing to send or receive */ struct spi_buf_set none = { .buffers = NULL, .count = 0 }; cfg = cfg_at(1000000, 0); ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &none, &none); printk("[refuse] empty transfer = %s
", err(ret)); } /* sunxi_spi_set_sample: choose the sample point of the returning data (mode 0..6, delay 0..63) */ static void demo_set_sample(void) { int ret; ret = sunxi_spi_set_sample(spi, 7, 0); printk("[sample] sunxi_spi_set_sample(mode 7) = %s
", err(ret)); ret = sunxi_spi_set_sample(spi, 0, 64); printk("[sample] sunxi_spi_set_sample(delay 64) = %s
", err(ret)); ret = sunxi_spi_set_sample(spi, 0, 0); printk("[sample] sunxi_spi_set_sample(mode 0, delay 0) = %s
", err(ret)); } /* spi_release unlocks the bus that a spi_config with SPI_LOCK_ON holds. */ static void demo_release(void) { struct spi_config cfg = cfg_at(1000000, SPI_LOCK_ON); uint8_t cmd = CMD_JEDEC_ID; uint8_t id[3] = { 0 }; struct spi_buf tx_buf = { .buf = &cmd, .len = 1 }; struct spi_buf rx_buf = { .buf = id, .len = sizeof(id) }; struct spi_buf_set tx = { .buffers = &tx_buf, .count = 1 }; struct spi_buf_set rx = { .buffers = &rx_buf, .count = 1 }; int ret; ret = spi_transceive(spi, &cfg, &tx, &rx); printk("[release] transfer with SPI_LOCK_ON = %s: %02x %02x %02x
", err(ret), id[0], id[1], id[2]); ret = spi_release(spi, &cfg); printk("[release] spi_release = %s
", err(ret)); } int main(void) { if (!device_is_ready(spi)) { printk("spi not ready
"); return 0; } demo_command_read(); demo_full_duplex(); demo_spi_write(); demo_spi_read(); demo_read_flash(); demo_modes(); demo_unsupported(); demo_set_sample(); demo_release(); printk("spi_api done
"); return 0; }

F101 有 6 个 UART（uart0…uart5）。Zephyr 里用的是上游的 NS16550 驱动（drivers/serial/uart_ns16550.c），因为 F101 的 UART 是 Synopsys DesignWare APB UART（16550 兼容）。F101 的移植只做了三件事：设备树节点、时钟/复位、让 SoC 默认选中 UART_NS16550_DW8250_DW_APB。接口是标准的 <zephyr/drivers/uart.h>。 项目 内容 设备 uart0…uart5 数据位 5、6、7、8 停止位 1、2（1.5 位返回 -ENOTSUP） 校验 无、偶校验（奇校验返回 -ENOTSUP） 流控 uart_configure 接受无、RTS/CTS、DTR/DSR 并记录；硬件自动流控见下面的说明 接口 轮询（uart_poll_in/uart_poll_out）、中断（uart_irq_*、uart_fifo_*）

文件 作用 dts/bindings/serial/ns16550.yaml 绑定（上游），uart-controller.yaml 提供 current-speed 等通用属性 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 设备树：uart0…uart5，默认 disabled boards/yuzukihd/yuzukineko/yuzukineko.dts 板级设备树：引脚组，打开 uart1、uart2、uart4，选控制台

六个节点的差别是寄存器地址、中断号、时钟和复位位。下面是 uart1： uart1: serial@2500400 { /* 两个 compatible：先匹配 ns16550 驱动，snps,dw-apb-uart 告诉它这是 DW APB 变种 */ compatible = "ns16550", "snps,dw-apb-uart"; /* 寄存器窗口：基址 0x02500400，长度 0x400 */ reg = <0x02500400 0x400>; /* 寄存器按 4 字节排布，偏移要左移 2 位 */ reg-shift = <2>; /* 中断：PLIC 的 3 号，优先级 1 */ interrupts = <3 1>; interrupt-parent = <&plic>; /* 总线时钟的开关和总线复位。波特率的参考时钟由 CCU 驱动给出 */ clocks = <&cctl CLK_BUS_UART1>; resets = <&rctl RST_BUS_UART1>; status = "disabled"; }; 节点 标签 寄存器 PLIC 中断号 时钟宏 serial@2500000 uart0 0x02500000 2 CLK_BUS_UART0 serial@2500400 uart1 0x02500400 3 CLK_BUS_UART1 serial@2500800 uart2 0x02500800 4 CLK_BUS_UART2 serial@2500c00 uart3 0x02500c00 5 CLK_BUS_UART3 serial@2501000 uart4 0x02501000 6 CLK_BUS_UART4 serial@2501400 uart5 0x02501400 7 CLK_BUS_UART5

/ { chosen { /* 控制台和 shell 用 UART1 */ zephyr,console = &uart1; zephyr,shell-uart = &uart1; }; }; &pio { /* UART1 控制台：PB00 是 TX，PB01 是 RX，复用功能 4 */ uart1_pins: uart1_pins { uart1_tx_rx { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PB, 0, 4) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PB, 1, 4)>; }; }; /* UART2 蓝牙 HCI：TX PE6、RX PE7、RTS PE8、CTS PE9，复用功能 3，带上拉 */ uart2_pins: uart2_pins { uart2_group { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PE, 6, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PE, 7, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PE, 8, 3) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PE, 9, 3)>; bias-pull-up; }; }; /* UART4 通用串口：PD6 是 TX，PD7 是 RX，复用功能 5，带上拉 */ uart4_pins: uart4_pins { uart4_group { pinmux = <ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 6, 5) ALLWINNER_PINMUX(ALLWINNER_PIO_PD, 7, 5)>; bias-pull-up; }; }; }; &uart1 { status = "okay"; /* 波特率 */ current-speed = <115200>; pinctrl-0 = <&uart1_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; }; /* AIC8800D40 的蓝牙 HCI：带硬件流控 */ &uart2 { status = "okay"; current-speed = <115200>; hw-flow-control; pinctrl-0 = <&uart2_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; bt_hci: bt-hci { compatible = "zephyr,bt-hci-uart"; status = "okay"; }; }; &uart4 { status = "okay"; current-speed = <115200>; pinctrl-0 = <&uart4_pins>; pinctrl-names = "default"; }; 引脚的详细复用关系见引脚复用表，各 UART 可选的引脚组见外设引脚分组。

属性 必填 含义 reg 是 寄存器窗口 reg-shift 是 寄存器偏移左移位数，F101 是 2 interrupts 是 中断 clocks、resets 是 总线时钟和复位 current-speed 是 波特率 hw-flow-control 否 把初始流控记为 RTS/CTS；是否真的打开硬件自动流控见下面 parity 否 0 无、1 奇、2 偶；这个移植里奇校验不能用 stop-bits、data-bits 否 停止位、数据位 pinctrl-0、pinctrl-names 否 引脚，见 GPIO 页的 pinctrl 一节

选项 默认 含义 CONFIG_SERIAL 板级 defconfig 里是 y 打开串口子系统 CONFIG_UART_NS16550 SoC 默认 y NS16550 驱动 CONFIG_UART_NS16550_DW8250_DW_APB SoC 默认 y Synopsys DesignWare 8250 UART 控制器的支持 CONFIG_UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN 板级 defconfig 里是 y 中断接口 uart_irq_*、uart_fifo_* CONFIG_UART_CONSOLE 板级 defconfig 里是 y printk 从 zephyr,console 输出

下面每个接口一个小标题：原型、驱动的行为、示例函数和它在板子上的输出。示例来自文末的完整演示程序，里面的 err() 把返回值转成名字。演示用到两个串口： 串口 位置 用途 UART1 PB00/PB01，板子的控制台 主机在另一头，可以真的发字符进来 UART4 PD6/PD7 板子上没有接任何东西，只演示发送 UART1 也是 printk 的输出口，所以演示里改波特率要小心：改配置期间不输出，先把发送器里还没发完的字符等完，改完恢复再打印，否则最后几个字符会按错的波特率发出去。

int uart_config_get(const struct device *dev, struct uart_config *cfg); 读当前的波特率、校验、停止位、数据位和流控。枚举取值：校验 0 无、1 奇、2 偶；停止位 0 半位、1 一位、2 一位半、3 两位；数据位 0…3 对应 5…8 位；流控 0 无、1 RTS/CTS、2 DTR/DSR。 /* uart_config_get: the current baud rate, parity, stop bits, data bits and flow control. * The enum values: parity 0 none, 1 odd, 2 even; stop bits 0 half, 1 one, 2 one and a half, 3 two; * data bits 0..3 are 5..8; flow control 0 none, 1 RTS/CTS, 2 DTR/DSR. */ static void demo_config_get(void) { struct uart_config now; int ret = uart_config_get(uart, &now); printk("[config] uart_config_get = %s: %u baud, parity %d, stop bits %d, data bits %d, flow control %d\n", err(ret), now.baudrate, now.parity, now.stop_bits, now.data_bits, now.flow_ctrl); } [config] uart_config_get = 0: 115200 baud, parity 0, stop bits 1, data bits 3, flow control 0

int uart_configure(const struct device *dev, const struct uart_config *cfg); 应用新的设置。成功后 uart_config_get 读回新的配置，失败时配置保持不变。 /* uart_configure: apply a new setting, and read it back with uart_config_get */ static void demo_configure(void) { static const struct uart_config table[] = { { .baudrate = 9600, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 921600, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_EVEN, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_ODD, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_2, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1_5, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_7, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_RTS_CTS }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_DTR_DSR }, }; struct uart_config now, back[ARRAY_SIZE(table)]; int ret[ARRAY_SIZE(table)]; uart_config_get(uart, &now); /* The console is this very UART, so nothing is printed while a different setting is active, * and the transmitter is given time to send what is still in it before the first change. * Each setting is applied and read back, then the original is restored and the results printed. */ k_msleep(50); for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(table); i++) { ret[i] = uart_configure(uart, &table[i]); uart_config_get(uart, &back[i]); } uart_configure(uart, &now); for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(table); i++) { printk("[config] %6u baud, parity %d, stop bits %d, data bits %d, flow %d = %s; read back %u, %d, %d, %d, %d\n", table[i].baudrate, table[i].parity, table[i].stop_bits, table[i].data_bits, table[i].flow_ctrl, err(ret[i]), back[i].baudrate, back[i].parity, back[i].stop_bits, back[i].data_bits, back[i].flow_ctrl); } } [config] 9600 baud, parity 0, stop bits 1, data bits 3, flow 0 = 0; read back 9600, 0, 1, 3, 0 [config] 921600 baud, parity 0, stop bits 1, data bits 3, flow 0 = 0; read back 921600, 0, 1, 3, 0 [config] 115200 baud, parity 2, stop bits 1, data bits 3, flow 0 = 0; read back 115200, 2, 1, 3, 0 [config] 115200 baud, parity 1, stop bits 1, data bits 3, flow 0 = -ENOTSUP; read back 115200, 2, 1, 3, 0 [config] 115200 baud, parity 0, stop bits 3, data bits 3, flow 0 = 0; read back 115200, 0, 3, 3, 0 [config] 115200 baud, parity 0, stop bits 1, data bits 2, flow 0 = 0; read back 115200, 0, 1, 2, 0 [config] 115200 baud, parity 0, stop bits 1, data bits 3, flow 1 = 0; read back 115200, 0, 1, 3, 1 [config] 115200 baud, parity 0, stop bits 1, data bits 3, flow 2 = 0; read back 115200, 0, 1, 3, 2 第 4 行是奇校验，返回 -ENOTSUP，读回的还是上一次成功的偶校验。第 6 行是 1.5 位停止位，驱动只接受 1 位和 2 位，同样返回 -ENOTSUP，配置保持不变。最后两行流控读回 1、2，只说明设置被记下了：uart_ns16550.c 只在选了 UART_NS16550_VARIANT_NS16750 或 UART_NS16550_VARIANT_NS16950 时才会置 MCR 的自动流控位（AFCE），F101 用的是默认的 NS16550 变体，所以 hw-flow-control 和 UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_RTS_CTS 现在不会打开硬件流控。这一点来自驱动源码，没有在板上用示波器或对端设备验证。

void uart_poll_out(const struct device *dev, unsigned char out_char); 发一个字符，发送器没有空位就等。 /* uart_poll_out: one character, waits until the transmitter has room */ static void demo_poll_out(void) { static const char text[] = "[poll_out] Hello from uart_poll_out\r\n"; for (int i = 0; text[i] != '\0'; i++) { uart_poll_out(uart, text[i]); } } [poll_out] Hello from uart_poll_out

int uart_poll_in(const struct device *dev, unsigned char *p_char); 收到字符返回 0 并把字符放进 p_char，没有字符返回 -1，不会等。演示里先调一次（还没有人发，返回 -1），然后在 20 秒内等主机发来 5 个字符。 /* uart_poll_in: returns 0 with the character, or -1 when nothing has arrived */ static void demo_poll_in(void) { unsigned char c = 0; char got[16] = { 0 }; int n = 0; int ret = uart_poll_in(uart, &c); printk("[poll_in] nothing sent yet: uart_poll_in = %s
", err(ret)); printk("[poll_in] waiting up to 20 s for 5 characters on the console
"); for (int64_t end = k_uptime_get() + 20000; n < 5 && k_uptime_get() < end;) { if (uart_poll_in(uart, &c) == 0) { got[n++] = c; } else { k_msleep(1); } } printk("[poll_in] got %d characters: "%s"
", n, got); } 主机用 write_serial 发 hello： [poll_in] nothing sent yet: uart_poll_in = -1 [poll_in] waiting up to 20 s for 5 characters on the console hello[poll_in] got 5 characters: "hello" hello 是主机发出的 5 个字符，也会出现在串口记录里，不是板子打印的。
中断方式的几个示例共用下面的变量：接收的数据放进环形缓冲区，发送的数据放在全局变量里。 RING_BUF_DECLARE(rx_ring, 64); static const char *tx_text; static int tx_left; static volatile int rx_irqs, tx_irqs;

int uart_irq_callback_user_data_set(const struct device *dev, uart_irq_callback_user_data_t cb, void *user_data); 设置 UART 中断调用的处理函数。处理函数的固定写法是 uart_irq_update() 之后循环处理 uart_irq_is_pending()：uart_irq_rx_ready() 为真就收，uart_irq_tx_ready() 为真就发。 /* the interrupt handler: uart_irq_update latches the interrupt state, uart_irq_is_pending says * whether there is anything to do, uart_irq_rx_ready and uart_irq_tx_ready say what */ static void uart_isr(const struct device *dev, void *user_data) { ARG_UNUSED(user_data); while (uart_irq_update(dev) && uart_irq_is_pending(dev)) { if (uart_irq_rx_ready(dev)) { rx_ready(dev); } if (uart_irq_tx_ready(dev)) { tx_ready(dev); } } } /* uart_irq_callback_user_data_set: the handler that the UART interrupt calls */ static void demo_irq_callback_set(void) { int ret = uart_irq_callback_user_data_set(uart, uart_isr, NULL); printk("[irq] uart_irq_callback_user_data_set = %s\n", err(ret)); } [irq] uart_irq_callback_user_data_set = 0

int uart_fifo_read(const struct device *dev, uint8_t *rx_data, const int size); 从接收 FIFO 里最多取 size 个字节，返回实际取到的个数。接收就绪时调用，演示把数据放进环形缓冲区。 /* uart_fifo_read: take what the receiver has out of its FIFO */ static void rx_ready(const struct device *dev) { uint8_t buf[16]; int n = uart_fifo_read(dev, buf, sizeof(buf)); ring_buf_put(&rx_ring, buf, n); rx_irqs++; }

int uart_fifo_fill(const struct device *dev, const uint8_t *tx_data, int size); 往发送 FIFO 里填最多 size 个字节，返回实际填进去的个数；填不下的等下一次发送中断。发完以后调用 uart_irq_tx_disable()，否则发送中断会一直来。 /* uart_fifo_fill: put as much as fits into the transmit FIFO; the rest waits for the next interrupt */ static void tx_ready(const struct device *dev) { tx_irqs++; if (tx_left > 0) { int n = uart_fifo_fill(dev, (const uint8_t *)tx_text, tx_left); tx_text += n; tx_left -= n; } if (tx_left == 0) { uart_irq_tx_disable(dev); } }

void uart_irq_tx_enable(const struct device *dev); 打开发送中断，处理函数里的 uart_fifo_fill 开始工作。 /* uart_irq_tx_enable: the handler fills the FIFO whenever it has room */ static void demo_irq_tx_enable(void) { static const char msg[] = "[irq] sent by the interrupt handler, 64 bytes at the most per fill ........\r\n"; tx_text = msg; tx_left = strlen(msg); uart_irq_tx_enable(uart); k_msleep(100); printk("[irq] transmit: %d interrupt(s), %d byte(s) left\n", tx_irqs, tx_left); } [irq] sent by the interrupt handler, 64 bytes at the most per fill ........ [irq] transmit: 5 interrupt(s), 0 byte(s) left 这个 77 个字节的字符串用了 5 次发送中断发完。

void uart_irq_rx_enable(const struct device *dev); 打开接收中断（uart_irq_rx_disable() 关掉）。演示打开后等主机发 4 个字符，它们在 1 次接收中断里一起取走。 /* uart_irq_rx_enable: the host sends 4 characters; the handler puts them in a ring buffer. * uart_irq_rx_disable stops the receive interrupt again. */ static void demo_irq_rx_enable(void) { uint8_t buf[32]; uart_irq_rx_enable(uart); printk("[irq] waiting up to 20 s for 4 characters on the console\n"); for (int64_t end = k_uptime_get() + 20000; ring_buf_size_get(&rx_ring) < 4 && k_uptime_get() < end;) { k_msleep(10); } k_msleep(20); int n = ring_buf_get(&rx_ring, buf, sizeof(buf) - 1); buf[n] = '\0'; uart_irq_rx_disable(uart); printk("[irq] receive: %d interrupt(s), got %d characters: \"%s\"\n", rx_irqs, n, buf); } [irq] waiting up to 20 s for 4 characters on the console ping[irq] receive: 1 interrupt(s), got 4 characters: "ping"

int uart_err_check(const struct device *dev); 返回自上次调用以来遇到的错误位（溢出、校验、帧、break）；没有错误是 0。 /* uart_err_check: a bit mask of the errors seen since the last call */ static void demo_errors(void) { int ret = uart_err_check(uart); printk("[error] uart_err_check = 0x%x (0 = no overrun, parity, framing or break error)\n", ret); } [error] uart_err_check = 0x0 (0 = no overrun, parity, framing or break error)

UART4 在板级文件里是打开的，但 PD6/PD7 上没有接东西。演示发送 7 个字节，再读接收器： /* UART4 on PD6 (TX) and PD7 (RX): nothing is connected there on the board */ static void demo_uart4(void) { static const char text[] = "uart4
"; unsigned char c; struct uart_config cfg; int ret; printk("[uart4] device_is_ready = %d
", device_is_ready(uart4)); ret = uart_config_get(uart4, &cfg); printk("[uart4] uart_config_get = %s: %u baud
", err(ret), cfg.baudrate); for (int i = 0; text[i] != '\0'; i++) { uart_poll_out(uart4, text[i]); } printk("[uart4] sent %d bytes on PD6
", (int)strlen(text)); /* PD7 is not connected: take whatever is in the receiver and ask for the line errors */ int n = 0; c = 0; while (n < 64 && uart_poll_in(uart4, &c) == 0) { n++; } ret = uart_poll_in(uart4, &c); printk("[uart4] %d byte(s) were waiting in the receiver, then uart_poll_in = %s
", n, err(ret)); printk("[uart4] uart_err_check = 0x%x
", uart_err_check(uart4)); } [uart4] device_is_ready = 1 [uart4] uart_config_get = 0: 115200 baud [uart4] sent 7 bytes on PD6 [uart4] 1 byte(s) were waiting in the receiver, then uart_poll_in = -1 [uart4] uart_err_check = 0x0

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0) find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE}) project(uart_api) target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c)
CONFIG_SERIAL=y CONFIG_UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN=y CONFIG_PRINTK=y CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096 CONFIG_SHELL=n CONFIG_DEVMEM_SHELL=n CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n

", err(ret), now.baudrate, now.parity, now.stop_bits, now.data_bits, now.flow_ctrl); } /* uart_configure: apply a new setting, and read it back with uart_config_get */ static void demo_configure(void) { static const struct uart_config table[] = { { .baudrate = 9600, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 921600, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_EVEN, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_ODD, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_2, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1_5, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_7, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_NONE }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_RTS_CTS }, { .baudrate = 115200, .parity = UART_CFG_PARITY_NONE, .stop_bits = UART_CFG_STOP_BITS_1, .data_bits = UART_CFG_DATA_BITS_8, .flow_ctrl = UART_CFG_FLOW_CTRL_DTR_DSR }, }; struct uart_config now, back[ARRAY_SIZE(table)]; int ret[ARRAY_SIZE(table)]; uart_config_get(uart, &now); /* The console is this very UART, so nothing is printed while a different setting is active, * and the transmitter is given time to send what is still in it before the first change. * Each setting is applied and read back, then the original is restored and the results printed. */ k_msleep(50); for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(table); i++) { ret[i] = uart_configure(uart, &table[i]); uart_config_get(uart, &back[i]); } uart_configure(uart, &now); for (int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(table); i++) { printk("[config] %6u baud, parity %d, stop bits %d, data bits %d, flow %d = %s; read back %u, %d, %d, %d, %d
", table[i].baudrate, table[i].parity, table[i].stop_bits, table[i].data_bits, table[i].flow_ctrl, err(ret[i]), back[i].baudrate, back[i].parity, back[i].stop_bits, back[i].data_bits, back[i].flow_ctrl); } } /* uart_poll_out: one character, waits until the transmitter has room */ static void demo_poll_out(void) { static const char text[] = "[poll_out] Hello from uart_poll_out
"; for (int i = 0; text[i] != '\0'; i++) { uart_poll_out(uart, text[i]); } } /* uart_poll_in: returns 0 with the character, or -1 when nothing has arrived */ static void demo_poll_in(void) { unsigned char c = 0; char got[16] = { 0 }; int n = 0; int ret = uart_poll_in(uart, &c); printk("[poll_in] nothing sent yet: uart_poll_in = %s
", err(ret)); printk("[poll_in] waiting up to 20 s for 5 characters on the console
"); for (int64_t end = k_uptime_get() + 20000; n < 5 && k_uptime_get() < end;) { if (uart_poll_in(uart, &c) == 0) { got[n++] = c; } else { k_msleep(1); } } printk("[poll_in] got %d characters: "%s"
", n, got); } /* interrupt driven receive and transmit */ RING_BUF_DECLARE(rx_ring, 64); static const char *tx_text; static int tx_left; static volatile int rx_irqs, tx_irqs; /* uart_fifo_read: take what the receiver has out of its FIFO */ static void rx_ready(const struct device *dev) { uint8_t buf[16]; int n = uart_fifo_read(dev, buf, sizeof(buf)); ring_buf_put(&rx_ring, buf, n); rx_irqs++; } /* uart_fifo_fill: put as much as fits into the transmit FIFO; the rest waits for the next interrupt */ static void tx_ready(const struct device *dev) { tx_irqs++; if (tx_left > 0) { int n = uart_fifo_fill(dev, (const uint8_t *)tx_text, tx_left); tx_text += n; tx_left -= n; } if (tx_left == 0) { uart_irq_tx_disable(dev); } } /* the interrupt handler: uart_irq_update latches the interrupt state, uart_irq_is_pending says * whether there is anything to do, uart_irq_rx_ready and uart_irq_tx_ready say what */ static void uart_isr(const struct device *dev, void *user_data) { ARG_UNUSED(user_data); while (uart_irq_update(dev) && uart_irq_is_pending(dev)) { if (uart_irq_rx_ready(dev)) { rx_ready(dev); } if (uart_irq_tx_ready(dev)) { tx_ready(dev); } } } /* uart_irq_callback_user_data_set: the handler that the UART interrupt calls */ static void demo_irq_callback_set(void) { int ret = uart_irq_callback_user_data_set(uart, uart_isr, NULL); printk("[irq] uart_irq_callback_user_data_set = %s
", err(ret)); } /* uart_irq_tx_enable: the handler fills the FIFO whenever it has room */ static void demo_irq_tx_enable(void) { static const char msg[] = "[irq] sent by the interrupt handler, 64 bytes at the most per fill ........
"; tx_text = msg; tx_left = strlen(msg); uart_irq_tx_enable(uart); k_msleep(100); printk("[irq] transmit: %d interrupt(s), %d byte(s) left
", tx_irqs, tx_left); } /* uart_irq_rx_enable: the host sends 4 characters; the handler puts them in a ring buffer. * uart_irq_rx_disable stops the receive interrupt again. */ static void demo_irq_rx_enable(void) { uint8_t buf[32]; uart_irq_rx_enable(uart); printk("[irq] waiting up to 20 s for 4 characters on the console
"); for (int64_t end = k_uptime_get() + 20000; ring_buf_size_get(&rx_ring) < 4 && k_uptime_get() < end;) { k_msleep(10); } k_msleep(20); int n = ring_buf_get(&rx_ring, buf, sizeof(buf) - 1); buf[n] = '\0'; uart_irq_rx_disable(uart); printk("[irq] receive: %d interrupt(s), got %d characters: "%s"

", ret); } /* UART4 on PD6 (TX) and PD7 (RX): nothing is connected there on the board */ static void demo_uart4(void) { static const char text[] = "uart4
"; unsigned char c; struct uart_config cfg; int ret; printk("[uart4] device_is_ready = %d
", device_is_ready(uart4)); ret = uart_config_get(uart4, &cfg); printk("[uart4] uart_config_get = %s: %u baud
", err(ret), cfg.baudrate); for (int i = 0; text[i] != '\0'; i++) { uart_poll_out(uart4, text[i]); } printk("[uart4] sent %d bytes on PD6

", uart_err_check(uart4)); } int main(void) { if (!device_is_ready(uart) || !device_is_ready(uart4)) { printk("uart not ready
"); return 0; } demo_config_get(); demo_configure(); demo_poll_out(); demo_poll_in(); demo_irq_callback_set(); demo_irq_tx_enable(); demo_irq_rx_enable(); demo_errors(); demo_uart4(); printk("uart_api done
"); return 0; }

F101 有一个 USB 2.0 OTG 控制器（Mentor MUSB 内核）和一个 EHCI/OHCI 主机控制器，共用同一个 UTMI PHY。Zephyr 里没有走上游的 USB 设备栈，而是用 CherryUSB 协议栈，F101 这边提供板级胶水（drivers/usb/cherryusb/）和 PHY 驱动（drivers/usb/phy/usb_phy_sunxi.c）。 项目 内容 设备模式 OTG 控制器，高速（480 Mbit/s）或全速，CherryUSB 的 CDC ACM、MSC、HID、音频、视频、RNDIS/ECM/NCM、DFU 类，以及 F101 自己的 vendor display 类 主机模式 EHCI（高速）加 OHCI（低速、全速）；CherryUSB 主机的 CDC ACM、HID、MSC 等类 PHY 同一时间只给一个角色用：设备或主机。sunxi_usb_phy_acquire() 取，sunxi_usb_phy_release() 放，另一个角色占着时返回 -EBUSY yuzukineko 只开设备模式。VBUS 开关用的 PE2 被 WiFi 的 SDIO 时钟占了，没有给主机口供电的开关，所以 EHCI/OHCI 不开 传输 设备模式由 CPU 搬运 FIFO 数据（VEND0 寄存器的 PIO 位），不用 USB 自带的 DMA 本文演示的是设备模式：一个 CDC ACM 虚拟串口，主机往里写什么，板子就原样回什么。

文件 作用 dts/bindings/usb/allwinner,sunxi-musb.yaml OTG 设备控制器的绑定 dts/bindings/usb/allwinner,sunxi-usb-phy.yaml PHY 的绑定 dts/bindings/usb/allwinner,sunxi-ehci.yaml 主机控制器的绑定 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 设备树：usbphy、usbotg、usbhci，默认 disabled boards/yuzukihd/yuzukineko/yuzukineko.dts 板级设备树：打开 usbphy 和 usbotg

usbphy: usb-phy@4100400 { /* 匹配 usb_phy_sunxi.c */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-usb-phy"; #phy-cells = <0>; /* 两块寄存器：OTG 里的 PHY 胶水逻辑，以及主机窗口里的 PHY/SIE */ reg = <0x04100400 0x40>, <0x04101800 0x40>; reg-names = "otg", "hci"; /* USB 总线时钟同时给 PHY 供时钟，PHY 复位 */ clocks = <&cctl CLK_BUS_USB>; resets = <&rctl RST_USB_PHY0>; /* 系统寄存器 0x03000004 里的这些位，把 FIFO 用的 SRAM 交给 USB 控制器 */ sram-remap-reg = <0x03000004>; sram-remap-clear = <0x0a000000>; status = "disabled"; }; usbotg: usb@4100000 { /* 匹配 CherryUSB 胶水 usb_glue_sunxi.c 里的 DT_DRV_COMPAT allwinner_sunxi_musb */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-musb"; reg = <0x04100000 0x400>; /* 中断：PLIC 的 29 号，优先级 1 */ interrupts = <29 1>; interrupt-parent = <&plic>; clocks = <&cctl CLK_BUS_USB_OTG>; resets = <&rctl RST_BUS_USB_OTG>; /* 用哪个 PHY */ phys = <&usbphy>; status = "disabled"; }; usbhci: usb@4101000 { compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-ehci"; /* EHCI 和 OHCI 各一个寄存器窗口，各一个中断 */ reg = <0x04101000 0x100>, <0x04101400 0x100>; reg-names = "ehci", "ohci"; interrupts = <30 1>, <31 1>; interrupt-names = "ehci", "ohci"; interrupt-parent = <&plic>; clocks = <&cctl CLK_BUS_USB_EHCI>, <&cctl CLK_BUS_USB_OHCI>; clock-names = "ehci", "ohci"; resets = <&rctl RST_BUS_USB_EHCI>, <&rctl RST_BUS_USB_OHCI>; phys = <&usbphy>; status = "disabled"; };

/* * USB 2.0 口只做设备：OTG 控制器加 PHY。PE2 是 WiFi 的 SDIO 时钟，没有 VBUS 开关， * 所以 EHCI/OHCI 主机控制器不打开。 */ &usbphy { status = "okay"; }; &usbotg { status = "okay"; }; 要在自己的板子上用主机模式，在 usbphy 里写 vbus-gpios（驱动在主机运行期间拉高它），并打开 usbhci： &usbphy { status = "okay"; vbus-gpios = <&gpioe 2 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>; /* 你的板子上给 USB 口供电的开关 */ }; &usbhci { status = "okay"; };

allwinner,sunxi-usb-phy： 属性 必填 含义 reg、reg-names 是 otg 和 hci 两块寄存器 clocks、resets 是 USB 总线时钟（同时给 PHY 供时钟）、PHY 复位 sram-remap-reg、sram-remap-clear 是 系统寄存器地址，以及要清掉的位，把 FIFO 用的 SRAM 交给 USB 控制器 vbus-gpios 否 主机控制器运行期间拉高的 VBUS 开关 allwinner,sunxi-musb： 属性 必填 含义 reg、interrupts 是 寄存器窗口、中断 clocks、resets 是 OTG 总线时钟和复位 phys 是 用的 PHY allwinner,sunxi-ehci：reg、reg-names（ehci、ohci）、interrupts、interrupt-names、clocks、clock-names、resets、phys，含义和上面类似。

选项 默认 含义 CONFIG_USB_PHY_SUNXI y（依赖 DT_HAS_ALLWINNER_SUNXI_USB_PHY_ENABLED） PHY 驱动 CONFIG_USB_PHY_SUNXI_INIT_PRIORITY 40 PHY 的初始化优先级，必须早于用它的控制器 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB n 打开 CherryUSB 协议栈 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE n 设备模式 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE_SPEED_HS 速度选项三选一，默认 SPEED_FS 高速。另外两个是 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE_SPEED_FS 全速、CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE_SPEED_AUTO 自动 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE_MUSB_SUNXI 控制器类型选一个 全志的 MUSB 控制器 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE_CDC_ACM n CDC ACM 类 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE_MSC、_HID、_AUDIO、_VIDEO、_CDC_RNDIS、_CDC_ECM、_CDC_NCM、_DFU、_DISPLAY n 其他设备类 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_HOST n 主机模式 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_HOST_EHCI_CUSTOM 主机控制器类型选一个 本移植的 EHCI/OHCI 胶水 CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_HOST_CDC_ACM、_HID、_MSC 等 n 主机模式的类驱动 CONFIG_SYSTEM_WORKQUEUE_STACK_SIZE 应用里设 2048 CherryUSB 的底半部在系统工作队列里跑 CONFIG_HEAP_MEM_POOL_SIZE 应用里设 65536 CherryUSB 用内核堆

CherryUSB 的接口是 usbd_*（设备）和 usbh_*（主机）。设备的使用顺序是：注册描述符，添加接口和端点，初始化控制器。下面每个接口一个小标题：原型、行为和示例函数。示例来自文末的完整演示程序。 演示由两个源文件组成。CherryUSB 的头文件和 Zephyr 的头文件有同名的宏（比如 __PACKED），不能放在同一个源文件里包含，所以 CherryUSB 相关的代码在 cdc_echo.c，Zephyr 相关的在 main.c，两边用几个外部函数连接。CherryUSB 的日志宏 USB_LOG_RAW 被板子的 usb_config.h 映射到 printk。

主机靠描述符认识设备：设备描述符（VID/PID 和类）、配置描述符（接口和端点）、字符串描述符。高速设备还要提供设备限定描述符和“另一种速度”的配置描述符。描述符放在 config_descriptor_hs、config_descriptor_fs 等数组里，用 CherryUSB 的宏拼出来：USB_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR_INIT、USB_CONFIG_DESCRIPTOR_INIT、CDC_ACM_DESCRIPTOR_INIT。三个端点： 端点 地址 类型 用途 IN 0x81 批量 设备到主机的数据 OUT 0x02 批量 主机到设备的数据 IN 0x83 中断 CDC 的通知 批量端点的最大包长高速是 512 字节（USB_BULK_EP_MPS_HS），全速是 64 字节（USB_BULK_EP_MPS_FS）。栈在需要的时候调用下面这些回调取描述符，它们收集在一个 struct usb_descriptor 里： static const uint8_t *device_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed) { (void)speed; return device_descriptor; } static const uint8_t *config_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed) { return speed == USB_SPEED_HIGH ? config_descriptor_hs : speed == USB_SPEED_FULL ? config_descriptor_fs : NULL; } static const uint8_t *device_quality_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed) { (void)speed; return device_quality_descriptor; } static const uint8_t *other_speed_config_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed) { return speed == USB_SPEED_HIGH ? other_speed_config_descriptor_hs : speed == USB_SPEED_FULL ? other_speed_config_descriptor_fs : NULL; } static const char *string_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed, uint8_t index) { (void)speed; return index < (sizeof(string_descriptors) / sizeof(string_descriptors[0])) ? string_descriptors[index] : NULL; }

void usbd_desc_register(uint8_t busid, const struct usb_descriptor *desc); 把上面那组描述符回调交给栈。busid 是 USB 总线的编号，只有一个控制器，是 0。 /* usbd_desc_register: hand the descriptors to the stack */ static void cdc_register_descriptors(void) { usbd_desc_register(0, &cdc_descriptor); }

void usbd_add_interface(uint8_t busid, struct usbd_interface *intf); 登记一个接口。CDC ACM 有两个接口（控制接口和数据接口），所以 usbd_cdc_acm_init_intf 调用两次，它初始化接口并返回它，交给 usbd_add_interface。 /* usbd_add_interface: the two interfaces of a CDC function, control and data */ static void cdc_add_interfaces(void) { usbd_add_interface(0, usbd_cdc_acm_init_intf(0, &intf0)); usbd_add_interface(0, usbd_cdc_acm_init_intf(0, &intf1)); }

void usbd_add_endpoint(uint8_t busid, struct usbd_endpoint *ep); 登记端点和它的完成回调：ep_addr 是端点地址，ep_cb 在这个端点上的一次传输完成时调用，参数里有实际传输的字节数。演示登记批量 OUT 和批量 IN。 /* usbd_add_endpoint: the callbacks of the bulk endpoints */ static void cdc_add_endpoints(void) { usbd_add_endpoint(0, &cdc_out_ep); usbd_add_endpoint(0, &cdc_in_ep); }

int usbd_initialize(uint8_t busid, uintptr_t reg_base, usbd_event_handler_t event_handler); 启动控制器；从这里开始主机可以枚举设备。reg_base 是 OTG 寄存器基址，由板子的胶水函数 usb_sunxi_otg_base() 给出。它调用 usb_dc_low_level_init()：打开时钟、释放复位、取得 PHY、设置 PIO 模式、连接并打开中断。event_handler 接收总线事件。 /* usbd_initialize: start the controller; from here on the host can enumerate the device */ static void cdc_start(uintptr_t reg_base) { usbd_initialize(0, reg_base, usbd_event_handler); } void cdc_echo_init(uintptr_t reg_base) { cdc_register_descriptors(); cdc_add_interfaces(); cdc_add_endpoints(); cdc_start(reg_base); } main.c 里调用它的地方： int main(void) { cdc_echo_init(usb_sunxi_otg_base()); printk("usb_api started
"); /* report once a second while there is traffic; stop after the host has gone quiet */ uint32_t last = 0; int quiet = 0; while (quiet < 5) { k_msleep(1000); if (cdc_echo_rx_bytes() != last) { last = cdc_echo_rx_bytes(); printk("[echo] received %u bytes in %u transfer(s), sent back %u bytes
", last, cdc_echo_transfers(), cdc_echo_tx_bytes()); quiet = 0; } else if (last != 0) { quiet++; } } printk("usb_api done
"); return 0; }

typedef void (*usbd_event_handler_t)(uint8_t busid, uint8_t event); 总线事件：USBD_EVENT_RESET、CONNECTED、DISCONNECTED、SUSPEND、RESUME、CONFIGURED 等。收到 CONFIGURED 就是主机选定了配置，端点可以用了，演示在这里发出第一次读。 /* the events of the bus */ static void usbd_event_handler(uint8_t busid, uint8_t event) { switch (event) { case USBD_EVENT_RESET: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] reset
"); break; case USBD_EVENT_CONNECTED: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] connected
"); break; case USBD_EVENT_DISCONNECTED: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] disconnected
"); configured = false; break; case USBD_EVENT_SUSPEND: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] suspend
"); break; case USBD_EVENT_RESUME: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] resume
"); break; case USBD_EVENT_CONFIGURED: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] configured, bulk packet size %u
", usbd_get_ep_mps(busid, CDC_OUT_EP)); configured = true; /* the first read: wait for data from the host */ cdc_start_read(busid); break; default: break; } }

int usbd_ep_start_read(uint8_t busid, const uint8_t ep, uint8_t *data, uint32_t data_len); 在 OUT 端点上等主机发数据，最多 data_len 个字节，收到后调用这个端点的回调。缓冲区放在非缓存的内存里并对齐（USB_NOCACHE_RAM_SECTION USB_MEM_ALIGNX）。 USB_NOCACHE_RAM_SECTION USB_MEM_ALIGNX static uint8_t read_buffer[BUF_SIZE]; USB_NOCACHE_RAM_SECTION USB_MEM_ALIGNX static uint8_t write_buffer[BUF_SIZE]; /* usbd_ep_start_read: wait for the host to send up to BUF_SIZE bytes; the OUT endpoint callback * runs when they have arrived */ static void cdc_start_read(uint8_t busid) { usbd_ep_start_read(busid, CDC_OUT_EP, read_buffer, BUF_SIZE); } /* data from the host arrived: copy it to the write buffer and send it back */ static void usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_out(uint8_t busid, uint8_t ep, uint32_t nbytes) { rx_bytes += nbytes; rx_transfers++; memcpy(write_buffer, read_buffer, nbytes); cdc_start_write(busid, nbytes); }

int usbd_ep_start_write(uint8_t busid, const uint8_t ep, const uint8_t *data, uint32_t data_len); 在 IN 端点上把数据发给主机，发完调用这个端点的回调。写的数据正好是整数个最大包长时，要再发一个长度为 0 的包告诉主机这次传输结束，这就是 usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_in 里 nbytes % mps == 0 的分支。 /* usbd_ep_start_write: send nbytes of the write buffer to the host; the IN endpoint callback runs * when they are out */ static void cdc_start_write(uint8_t busid, uint32_t nbytes) { usbd_ep_start_write(busid, CDC_IN_EP, write_buffer, nbytes); } /* the data went out: end the transfer with a zero length packet when it filled whole packets, then * listen again */ static void usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_in(uint8_t busid, uint8_t ep, uint32_t nbytes) { if ((nbytes % usbd_get_ep_mps(busid, ep)) == 0 && nbytes) { usbd_ep_start_write(busid, CDC_IN_EP, NULL, 0); return; } tx_bytes += nbytes; cdc_start_read(busid); }

void usbd_cdc_acm_set_dtr(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, bool state); 主机设置 DTR 控制线（串口工具打开端口时置位）时，类驱动调用它；应用定义这个函数即可。 /* the class driver calls these when the host sets the control lines and the line coding */ void usbd_cdc_acm_set_dtr(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, bool state) { dtr = state; USB_LOG_RAW("[cdc] DTR %d\r\n", state); }
void usbd_cdc_acm_set_rts(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, bool state); 主机设置 RTS 控制线时调用。 void usbd_cdc_acm_set_rts(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, bool state) { USB_LOG_RAW("[cdc] RTS %d\r\n", state); }

void usbd_cdc_acm_set_line_coding(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, struct cdc_line_coding *line_coding); 主机设置线路参数（波特率、数据位、校验、停止位）时调用。CDC ACM 的“波特率”只是主机和设备之间约定的数字，对 USB 传输速度没有影响。 void usbd_cdc_acm_set_line_coding(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, struct cdc_line_coding *line_coding) { USB_LOG_RAW("[cdc] line coding: %u baud, %u data bits, parity %u, stop bits %u\r\n", (unsigned int)line_coding->dwDTERate, line_coding->bDataBits, line_coding->bParityType, line_coding->bCharFormat); }

主机是一台 Windows 电脑，板子的 USB 口接在它上面（和 xfel 下载用的是同一个口）。程序运行后，板子的 USB 口重新枚举，主机上出现一个新的 COM 口。下面的 PowerShell 脚本等设备出现，打开这个 COM 口，发 19 个字节和 1000 个字节，检查原样回来的数据： # Windows PowerShell: wait for the YuzukiNeko CDC ACM device (VID 1209, PID 0001), then send text # to its COM port and check that the same bytes come back. $end = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(25) $dev = $null while ((Get-Date) -lt $end -and -not $dev) { Start-Sleep 1 $dev = Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity | Where-Object { $_.PNPDeviceID -like '*VID_1209&PID_0001*' -and $_.Name -match 'COM\d+' } | Select-Object -First 1 } if (-not $dev) { Write-Output "device not found"; exit 1 } Write-Output ("device: " + $dev.Name + " / " + $dev.PNPDeviceID) $com = [regex]::Match($dev.Name, 'COM\d+').Value $p = New-Object System.IO.Ports.SerialPort $com, 115200, 'None', 8, 'One' $p.DtrEnable = $true $p.RtsEnable = $true $p.ReadTimeout = 3000 $p.Open() Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 $p.Write("hello from the host") Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800 Write-Output ("echo 1: " + $p.ReadExisting()) $big = "0123456789" * 100 $p.Write($big) Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1500 $back = $p.ReadExisting() Write-Output ("echo 2: sent " + $big.Length + " bytes, got " + $back.Length + " bytes, same = " + ($back -eq $big)) $p.Close() 主机一侧的输出： device: USB 串行设备 (COM12) / USB\VID_1209&PID_0001&MI_00\A&29BE0475&0&0000 echo 1: hello from the host echo 2: sent 1000 bytes, got 1000 bytes, same = True 板子一侧（控制台 UART1）的输出： usb_api started [usb] reset [E/usbd_core] descriptor <type:3,index:ee> not found! [E/usbd_core] standard request error [E/usbd_core] Setup: bmRequestType 0x80, bRequest 0x06, wValue 0x03ee, wIndex 0x0000, wLength 0x0012 [usb] configured, bulk packet size 512 [cdc] DTR 0 [cdc] RTS 0 [cdc] line coding: 2000000 baud, 8 data bits, parity 0, stop bits 0 [cdc] line coding: 115200 baud, 8 data bits, parity 0, stop bits 0 [cdc] DTR 0 [cdc] RTS 1 [cdc] line coding: 2000000 baud, 8 data bits, parity 0, stop bits 0 [cdc] line coding: 115200 baud, 8 data bits, parity 0, stop bits 0 [cdc] DTR 1 [cdc] RTS 1 [cdc] line coding: 2000000 baud, 8 data bits, parity 0, stop bits 0 [cdc] DTR 1 [cdc] RTS 1 [echo] received 1019 bytes in 2 transfer(s), sent back 1019 bytes [cdc] DTR 0 [cdc] RTS 1 [cdc] DTR 0 [cdc] RTS 1 usb_api done 行 说明 [usb] reset 主机复位总线 [E/usbd_core] descriptor <type:3,index:ee> not found! 这三行 Windows 会请求一个字符串索引 0xEE（微软的 OS 字符串描述符），设备没有，所以 CherryUSB 记一条错误并让这次请求失败。设备照常工作 [usb] configured, bulk packet size 512 主机选了配置，协商到高速，批量包长 512 [cdc] line coding: 2000000 baud ... 与 115200 baud 交替出现 Windows 的串口驱动打开端口时设置线路参数，COM 口工具设了 115200；CDC ACM 的“波特率”只是主机和设备之间约定的数字，对 USB 传输速度没有影响 [cdc] DTR 1、RTS 1 脚本设了 DtrEnable、RtsEnable [echo] received 1019 bytes in 2 transfer(s) 19 字节和 1000 字节各一次传输，一共收到 1019 字节并全部发回 最后的 DTR 0 脚本关闭了端口

上面所有示例和日志都来自这一个程序。建一个目录，放进下面的文件，就可以像其他 Zephyr 应用一样编译。 usb_api/ ├── CMakeLists.txt ├── prj.conf ├── src/ │ ├── cdc_echo.c CherryUSB：描述符、端点、类回调 │ └── main.c Zephyr：启动和统计 └── host/ └── usbtest.ps1 主机一侧的验证脚本，见上
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0) find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE}) project(usb_api) target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c src/cdc_echo.c)

CONFIG_CHERRYUSB=y CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE=y CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE_SPEED_HS=y CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE_MUSB_SUNXI=y CONFIG_CHERRYUSB_DEVICE_CDC_ACM=y CONFIG_PRINTK=y CONFIG_MAIN_STACK_SIZE=4096 CONFIG_SYSTEM_WORKQUEUE_STACK_SIZE=2048 CONFIG_HEAP_MEM_POOL_SIZE=65536 CONFIG_SHELL=n CONFIG_DEVMEM_SHELL=n CONFIG_LOG_PRINTK=n

/* * The CDC ACM (virtual serial port) function of usb_api, built on CherryUSB. Everything the host sends * to the port is sent back. This file includes no Zephyr header: the CherryUSB headers and the * Zephyr ones define some of the same names, so they are kept in separate source files. CherryUSB * prints with USB_LOG_RAW, which the board's usb_config.h maps to printk. */ #include <string.h> #include "usbd_core.h" #include "usbd_cdc_acm.h" /* endpoint addresses: bit 7 set is IN (device to host) */ #define CDC_IN_EP 0x81 #define CDC_OUT_EP 0x02 #define CDC_INT_EP 0x83 #define USBD_VID 0x1209 /* a vendor ID is needed for a product; this one is for test products */ #define USBD_PID 0x0001 #define USBD_MAX_POWER 100 /* in 2 mA units of bMaxPower: 100 mA */ #define USB_CONFIG_SIZE (9 + CDC_ACM_DESCRIPTOR_LEN) /* device descriptor: USB 2.0, class 0xEF/2/1 = interface association (a CDC function) */ static const uint8_t device_descriptor[] = { USB_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(USB_2_0, 0xEF, 0x02, 0x01, USBD_VID, USBD_PID, 0x0100, 0x01) }; /* configuration descriptor: one configuration with the two CDC interfaces and three endpoints. * The bulk packet size is 512 bytes at high speed and 64 bytes at full speed. */ static const uint8_t config_descriptor_hs[] = { USB_CONFIG_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(USB_CONFIG_SIZE, 0x02, 0x01, USB_CONFIG_BUS_POWERED, USBD_MAX_POWER), CDC_ACM_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(0x00, CDC_INT_EP, CDC_OUT_EP, CDC_IN_EP, USB_BULK_EP_MPS_HS, 0x02) }; static const uint8_t config_descriptor_fs[] = { USB_CONFIG_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(USB_CONFIG_SIZE, 0x02, 0x01, USB_CONFIG_BUS_POWERED, USBD_MAX_POWER), CDC_ACM_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(0x00, CDC_INT_EP, CDC_OUT_EP, CDC_IN_EP, USB_BULK_EP_MPS_FS, 0x02) }; /* a high speed device also describes how it would look at full speed, and the other way round */ static const uint8_t device_quality_descriptor[] = { USB_DEVICE_QUALIFIER_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(USB_2_0, 0xEF, 0x02, 0x01, 0x01), }; static const uint8_t other_speed_config_descriptor_hs[] = { USB_OTHER_SPEED_CONFIG_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(USB_CONFIG_SIZE, 0x02, 0x01, USB_CONFIG_BUS_POWERED, USBD_MAX_POWER), CDC_ACM_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(0x00, CDC_INT_EP, CDC_OUT_EP, CDC_IN_EP, USB_BULK_EP_MPS_FS, 0x02) }; static const uint8_t other_speed_config_descriptor_fs[] = { USB_OTHER_SPEED_CONFIG_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(USB_CONFIG_SIZE, 0x02, 0x01, USB_CONFIG_BUS_POWERED, USBD_MAX_POWER), CDC_ACM_DESCRIPTOR_INIT(0x00, CDC_INT_EP, CDC_OUT_EP, CDC_IN_EP, USB_BULK_EP_MPS_HS, 0x02) }; /* strings: index 0 is the language (0x0409, English), then the three that the descriptors name */ static const char *string_descriptors[] = { (const char[]){ 0x09, 0x04 }, "YuzukiHD", "YuzukiNeko CDC ACM", "F101-0001", }; static const uint8_t *device_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed) { (void)speed; return device_descriptor; } static const uint8_t *config_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed) { return speed == USB_SPEED_HIGH ? config_descriptor_hs : speed == USB_SPEED_FULL ? config_descriptor_fs : NULL; } static const uint8_t *device_quality_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed) { (void)speed; return device_quality_descriptor; } static const uint8_t *other_speed_config_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed) { return speed == USB_SPEED_HIGH ? other_speed_config_descriptor_hs : speed == USB_SPEED_FULL ? other_speed_config_descriptor_fs : NULL; } static const char *string_descriptor_callback(uint8_t speed, uint8_t index) { (void)speed; return index < (sizeof(string_descriptors) / sizeof(string_descriptors[0])) ? string_descriptors[index] : NULL; } static const struct usb_descriptor cdc_descriptor = { .device_descriptor_callback = device_descriptor_callback, .config_descriptor_callback = config_descriptor_callback, .device_quality_descriptor_callback = device_quality_descriptor_callback, .other_speed_descriptor_callback = other_speed_config_descriptor_callback, .string_descriptor_callback = string_descriptor_callback }; /* the transfer buffers live in non-cached memory and are aligned for the DMA/FIFO access */ #define BUF_SIZE 2048 USB_NOCACHE_RAM_SECTION USB_MEM_ALIGNX static uint8_t read_buffer[BUF_SIZE]; USB_NOCACHE_RAM_SECTION USB_MEM_ALIGNX static uint8_t write_buffer[BUF_SIZE]; static volatile uint32_t rx_bytes, tx_bytes, rx_transfers; static volatile bool configured, dtr; uint32_t cdc_echo_rx_bytes(void) { return rx_bytes; } uint32_t cdc_echo_tx_bytes(void) { return tx_bytes; } uint32_t cdc_echo_transfers(void) { return rx_transfers; } /* usbd_ep_start_read: wait for the host to send up to BUF_SIZE bytes; the OUT endpoint callback * runs when they have arrived */ static void cdc_start_read(uint8_t busid) { usbd_ep_start_read(busid, CDC_OUT_EP, read_buffer, BUF_SIZE); } /* usbd_ep_start_write: send nbytes of the write buffer to the host; the IN endpoint callback runs * when they are out */ static void cdc_start_write(uint8_t busid, uint32_t nbytes) { usbd_ep_start_write(busid, CDC_IN_EP, write_buffer, nbytes); } /* the events of the bus */ static void usbd_event_handler(uint8_t busid, uint8_t event) { switch (event) { case USBD_EVENT_RESET: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] reset
"); break; case USBD_EVENT_CONNECTED: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] connected
"); break; case USBD_EVENT_DISCONNECTED: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] disconnected
"); configured = false; break; case USBD_EVENT_SUSPEND: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] suspend
"); break; case USBD_EVENT_RESUME: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] resume
"); break; case USBD_EVENT_CONFIGURED: USB_LOG_RAW("[usb] configured, bulk packet size %u
", usbd_get_ep_mps(busid, CDC_OUT_EP)); configured = true; /* the first read: wait for data from the host */ cdc_start_read(busid); break; default: break; } } /* data from the host arrived: copy it to the write buffer and send it back */ static void usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_out(uint8_t busid, uint8_t ep, uint32_t nbytes) { rx_bytes += nbytes; rx_transfers++; memcpy(write_buffer, read_buffer, nbytes); cdc_start_write(busid, nbytes); } /* the data went out: end the transfer with a zero length packet when it filled whole packets, then * listen again */ static void usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_in(uint8_t busid, uint8_t ep, uint32_t nbytes) { if ((nbytes % usbd_get_ep_mps(busid, ep)) == 0 && nbytes) { usbd_ep_start_write(busid, CDC_IN_EP, NULL, 0); return; } tx_bytes += nbytes; cdc_start_read(busid); } static struct usbd_endpoint cdc_out_ep = { .ep_addr = CDC_OUT_EP, .ep_cb = usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_out }; static struct usbd_endpoint cdc_in_ep = { .ep_addr = CDC_IN_EP, .ep_cb = usbd_cdc_acm_bulk_in }; static struct usbd_interface intf0; static struct usbd_interface intf1; /* the class driver calls these when the host sets the control lines and the line coding */ void usbd_cdc_acm_set_dtr(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, bool state) { dtr = state; USB_LOG_RAW("[cdc] DTR %d
", state); } void usbd_cdc_acm_set_rts(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, bool state) { USB_LOG_RAW("[cdc] RTS %d
", state); } void usbd_cdc_acm_set_line_coding(uint8_t busid, uint8_t intf, struct cdc_line_coding *line_coding) { USB_LOG_RAW("[cdc] line coding: %u baud, %u data bits, parity %u, stop bits %u
", (unsigned int)line_coding->dwDTERate, line_coding->bDataBits, line_coding->bParityType, line_coding->bCharFormat); } /* usbd_desc_register: hand the descriptors to the stack */ static void cdc_register_descriptors(void) { usbd_desc_register(0, &cdc_descriptor); } /* usbd_add_interface: the two interfaces of a CDC function, control and data */ static void cdc_add_interfaces(void) { usbd_add_interface(0, usbd_cdc_acm_init_intf(0, &intf0)); usbd_add_interface(0, usbd_cdc_acm_init_intf(0, &intf1)); } /* usbd_add_endpoint: the callbacks of the bulk endpoints */ static void cdc_add_endpoints(void) { usbd_add_endpoint(0, &cdc_out_ep); usbd_add_endpoint(0, &cdc_in_ep); } /* usbd_initialize: start the controller; from here on the host can enumerate the device */ static void cdc_start(uintptr_t reg_base) { usbd_initialize(0, reg_base, usbd_event_handler); } void cdc_echo_init(uintptr_t reg_base) { cdc_register_descriptors(); cdc_add_interfaces(); cdc_add_endpoints(); cdc_start(reg_base); }

. ~/f101-zephyr/env.sh cd ~/f101-zephyr west build -b yuzukineko -d build/usb-api usb_api 下载运行的方法见编译与运行。注意：用 xfel 下载到 RAM 时，板子是通过同一个 USB 口进入 FEL 的；程序一运行，这个口就变成了 CDC ACM 设备，FEL 设备消失。 另外还有三个示例：samples/drivers/usb/cherryusb_cdc_acm（CherryUSB 自带的 CDC ACM 演示）、cherryusb_display（vendor display 类，把屏幕投给主机上的程序）、cherryusb_host（主机模式，读 U 盘等；需要有 VBUS 开关的板子，如 f101_evb）。

F101 片上的视频引擎（video engine）可以用硬件解码 JPEG、PNG 和 H.264。Zephyr 里把它做成一个设备，接口是 <zephyr/drivers/vdec.h>，驱动在 drivers/vdec/sunxi/。 编码 用法 输出格式 JPEG 单张图片，vdec_decode_image() VDEC_FORMAT_NV12 或 VDEC_FORMAT_NV21 PNG 单张图片，vdec_decode_image() VDEC_FORMAT_RGBA8888 MJPEG 一连串 JPEG，vdec_stream_*()，codec 用 VDEC_CODEC_JPEG VDEC_FORMAT_NV12 或 VDEC_FORMAT_NV21 H.264 视频流，vdec_stream_*() VDEC_FORMAT_NV12 或 VDEC_FORMAT_NV21 输出格式的含义： 格式 内存布局 VDEC_FORMAT_NV12 8 位亮度平面，后面接半分辨率的 Cb/Cr 交错平面 VDEC_FORMAT_NV21 同上，但交错顺序是 Cr/Cb VDEC_FORMAT_RGBA8888 32 位小端字，R 在最高字节、A 在最低字节（内存里的字节顺序是 A、B、G、R）

视频引擎涉及三个文件，从下到上依次是： 文件 作用 dts/bindings/video/allwinner,sunxi-ve.yaml 绑定：规定 allwinner,sunxi-ve 节点必须有哪些属性 dts/riscv/allwinner/sun252i_f101.dtsi SoC 的设备树：定义 ve 节点和它的寄存器、中断、时钟、复位，默认 disabled boards/yuzukihd/yuzukineko/yuzukineko.dts、boards/yuzukihd/f101_evb/f101_evb.dts 板级设备树：把 ve 改成 okay ve 节点不启用，CONFIG_VDEC_SUNXI 就不会被选中（它依赖 DT_HAS_ALLWINNER_SUNXI_VE_ENABLED），驱动不会编进去。

下面是 sun252i_f101.dtsi 里的 ve 节点，说明写在注释里（这些中文注释是加的，节点内容和源文件一致）： /* 在 soc 节点下，464–474 行 */ ve: video-codec@1c0e000 { /* 标签 ve：应用里用 DT_NODELABEL(ve) 取这个设备 */ /* 匹配驱动 vdec_sunxi.c 里的 DT_DRV_COMPAT allwinner_sunxi_ve */ compatible = "allwinner,sunxi-ve"; /* 寄存器窗口：基址 0x01c0e000，长度 0x1000（4 KiB） */ reg = <0x01c0e000 0x1000>; /* 中断：PLIC 的 66 号，优先级 1。PLIC 的 #interrupt-cells 是 2，两个格子依次是 irq、priority */ interrupts = <66 1>; interrupt-parent = <&plic>; /* 三个时钟，顺序和 clock-names 一一对应：模块时钟、总线时钟、MBUS 时钟 */ clocks = <&cctl CLK_VE>, <&cctl CLK_BUS_VE>, <&cctl CLK_BUS_VE_M>; clock-names = "mod", "bus", "mbus"; /* 总线复位 */ resets = <&rctl RST_BUS_VE>; /* 模块时钟寄存器在 CCU 里的偏移：时钟源选择、分频和门控都在这个寄存器 */ clock-reg = <0x690>; /* 系统控制块的基址，里面有把共享 SRAM 交给视频引擎的控制位 */ sram-ctrl-reg = <0x03000000>; /* 默认关闭，由板级打开 */ status = "disabled"; }; CLK_VE 这些宏定义在 include/zephyr/dt-bindings/clock/sun252i-f101-ccu.h，由 ALLWINNER_CCU_ID(base, reg, bit) 把“哪个 CCU、寄存器偏移、位”打包成一个整数，打包方式是 (base << 20) | (reg << 8) | bit： 宏 CCU 寄存器偏移 位 CLK_VE ALLWINNER_CCU_MAIN 0x0690 31 CLK_BUS_VE ALLWINNER_CCU_MAIN 0x069c 0 RST_BUS_VE ALLWINNER_CCU_MAIN 0x069c 16 CLK_BUS_VE_M ALLWINNER_CCU_MAIN 0x0804 1

两个板级都只做一件事，把节点打开。yuzukineko.dts 第 409–412 行： /* Video engine: hardware JPEG, PNG and H.264 decoder */ &ve { status = "okay"; }; f101_evb.dts 第 278–281 行写法完全一样。&ve 是按标签引用 SoC 设备树里的 ve 节点，status = "okay" 把 disabled 覆盖掉，其余属性继承自 dtsi。 在自己的板子或应用里使用，同样的覆盖写在应用的 boards/<板级>.overlay 里即可： &ve { status = "okay"; };
